proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have H11 := kdv_orbit_control h_exists h_unique
  have H12 := kdv_Hm1_uniform_cauchy h_exists h_unique
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := toHm1_clm
  choose sol hsol hsol0 using h_exists
  
  haveI : CompleteSpace Hm1 := by
    show CompleteSpace (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range toHm1)).topologicalClosure
    infer_instance
  
  have hseq : ∀ x : Hm1, ∃ a : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ι (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) := by
    intro x
    have h1 : ((LinearMap.range (L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))) :
        Set (Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))) = Set.range toHm1 := by
      ext y
      simp only [LinearMap.coe_range, Set.mem_range, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, hL]
    have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range toHm1) =
        LinearMap.range (L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
      rw [← h1, Submodule.span_eq]
    have hmem : (x : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) ∈
        (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range toHm1)).topologicalClosure := x.2
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe, hspan, h1] at hmem
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbt⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.1 hmem
    choose a ha using hb
    refine ⟨a, tendsto_subtype_rng.2 ?_⟩
    have hab : (fun n => ((ι (a n) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))) = b :=
      funext fun n => ha n
    rw [hab]
    exact hbt
  have hdense : DenseRange ι := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hseq x
    exact mem_closure_of_tendsto ha (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ⟨a n, rfl⟩)
  
  have hF_cont : ∀ a : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Continuous fun t : ℝ => ι (sol a t) := by
    intro a
    have h1 := schwartz_curve_comp_clm_continuous L (sol a) (fun t => by
      obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := hsol a t
      exact ⟨v, hv⟩)
    simp only [hL] at h1
    exact h1.subtype_mk _
  
  have hF_cauchy : ∀ a : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), CauchySeq (fun n => ι (a n)) →
      ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
        dist (ι (sol (a m) t)) (ι (sol (a n) t)) < ε := by
    intro a ha
    have ha' : CauchySeq (fun n => ι (sol (a n) 0)) := by
      simpa only [hsol0] using ha
    exact H12 (fun n => sol (a n)) (fun n => hsol (a n)) ha'
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦc, hΦe, hΦlim⟩ :=
    dense_extension_of_uniform_cauchy ι hdense (fun t a => ι (sol a t)) hF_cont hF_cauchy
  have hΦe' : ∀ (t : ℝ) (a : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Φ (t, ι a) = ι (sol a t) := hΦe
  have hΦlim' : ∀ (x : Hm1) (a : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ι (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ι (sol (a n) t)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x))) :=
    hΦlim
  
  have horbit : ∀ x : Hm1, ∃ a : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ι (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) ∧
      ∃ C ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ κ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
        ‖ι (sol (a n) t)‖ ≤ C ∧ ∀ κ ≥ κ₀,
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) *
              ‖((ι (sol (a n) t) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
            C * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) *
              ‖((ι (a n) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hseq x
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.1 (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto _ ha)
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, hctrl⟩ := H11 (max R 0) (le_max_right _ _)
    refine ⟨a, ha, C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, fun n t => ?_⟩
    have h0 : ‖ι (sol (a n) 0)‖ ≤ max R 0 := by
      rw [hsol0]
      exact le_trans (hR _ ⟨n, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hc := hctrl (sol (a n)) (hsol _) h0 t
    rw [hsol0] at hc
    exact hc
  refine ⟨Φ, hΦc, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro u hu t
    have heq : sol (u 0) = u := h_unique _ _ (hsol (u 0)) hu (hsol0 (u 0))
    rw [hΦe', heq]
  · 
    intro Ψ hΨc hΨe
    have hagree : ∀ (t : ℝ) (a : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Ψ (t, ι a) = Φ (t, ι a) := by
      intro t a
      have h1 := hΨe (sol a) (hsol a) t
      rw [hsol0] at h1
      rw [h1, hΦe']
    have hd : DenseRange (Prod.map id ι : ℝ × 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → ℝ × Hm1) :=
      DenseRange.prodMap denseRange_id hdense
    refine Continuous.ext_on hd hΨc hΦc ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨t, a⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hagree t a
  · 
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha, C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, hctrl⟩ := horbit x
    have hbd : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖Φ (t, x)‖ ≤ C := by
      intro t
      refine le_of_tendsto' ((continuous_norm.tendsto _).comp (hΦlim' x a ha t)) ?_
      intro n
      exact (hctrl n t).1
    exact isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.2 ⟨C, by rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩; exact hbd t⟩
  · 
    intro x ε hε
    obtain ⟨a, ha, C, hC0, κ₀, hκ₀, hctrl⟩ := horbit x
    have hf : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ((ι (a n) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (x : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))) := tendsto_subtype_rng.1 ha
    have hC1 : 0 < C + 1 := by linarith
    have hη : 0 < ε / (80 * (C + 1)) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁, hW⟩ := Hm1_weight_uniform_decay _ _ hf (ε / (80 * (C + 1))) hη
    obtain ⟨K, hKK₁, hKκ⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K₁ ≤ K ∧ κ₀ ≤ K :=
      ⟨max K₁ κ₀, le_max_left _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
    have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := le_trans hK₁ hKK₁
    have hD : 0 < K * (C + 1) := mul_pos (by linarith) hC1
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδsq⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), δ ^ 2 * (K * (C + 1)) ^ 2 = ε / 4 := by
      refine ⟨Real.sqrt (ε / 4) / (K * (C + 1)),
        div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)) hD, ?_⟩
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_pos hD 2).ne']
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩ h hh
    show translateDiffSq ((Φ (t, x) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) h < ε
    have hh2 : h ^ 2 < δ ^ 2 := by
      have := abs_lt.1 hh
      exact sq_lt_sq' this.1 this.2
    have hCη : C * (ε / (80 * (C + 1))) ≤ ε / 80 := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    have hn : ∀ n : ℕ,
        translateDiffSq ((ι (sol (a n) t) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) h ≤ ε / 2 := by
      intro n
      have hT := translateDiffSq_bounds.1
        ((ι (sol (a n) t) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) K hK1 h
      have hgC : ‖((ι (sol (a n) t) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))‖ ≤ C :=
        (hctrl n t).1
      have hWg := (hctrl n t).2 K hKκ
      have hWf : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2)) *
          ‖((ι (a n) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) <
            ε / (80 * (C + 1)) := hW K hKK₁ n
      have hg2 : ‖((ι (sol (a n) t) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ (C + 1) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith) 2
      have e1 : K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 *
          ‖((ι (sol (a n) t) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 4 := by
        calc K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 * ‖((ι (sol (a n) t) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))‖ ^ 2
            ≤ K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 * (C + 1) ^ 2 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg2 (by positivity)
          _ = h ^ 2 * (K * (C + 1)) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ δ ^ 2 * (K * (C + 1)) ^ 2 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh2.le (by positivity)
          _ = ε / 4 := hδsq
      have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWf.le hC0
      linarith
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => translateDiffSq ((ι (sol (a n) t) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) h)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds (translateDiffSq ((Φ (t, x) : Hm1) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) h)) :=
      ((translateDiffSq_bounds.2 h).tendsto _).comp (tendsto_subtype_rng.1 (hΦlim' x a ha t))
    have hle := le_of_tendsto' hlim hn
    linarith

subgoal_signatures.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] E) (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hu : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt u v t) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => L (u t)

subgoal_signatures.name: dense_extension_of_uniform_cauchy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X A : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (e : A → X) (he : DenseRange e) (F : ℝ → A → X)
    (hF_cont : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t : ℝ => F t a)
    (hF_cauchy : ∀ a : ℕ → A, CauchySeq (fun n => e (a n)) →
      ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
        dist (F t (a m)) (F t (a n)) < ε) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ × X → X, Continuous Φ ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (a : A), Φ (t, e a) = F t a) ∧
      ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F t (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x)))

subgoal_signatures.name: Hm1_weight_uniform_decay
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(f : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hf : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds g)) :
    ∀ η > (0 : ℝ), ∃ K ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ K, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(f n : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 < η

subgoal_signatures.name: translateDiffSq_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ (f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (K : ℝ), 1 ≤ K → ∀ h : ℝ,
      translateDiffSq f h ≤ K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 +
        20 * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2)) * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ h : ℝ, Continuous fun g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) => translateDiffSq g h)

    (h_unique : ∀ u v : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      IsSchwartzSolution u → IsSchwartzSolution v → u 0 = v 0 → u = v) :
    ∀ R ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ C ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∃ κ₀ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u →
      ‖ι (u 0)‖ ≤ R → ∀ t : ℝ,

signature.statement: ∃ L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), L q = toHm1 q

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hn : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
    intro q ξ x
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
  have hcx : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro q ξ
    fun_prop
  have hqi : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖q x‖) volume :=
    fun q => (q.integrable (μ := volume)).norm
  
  have s1 : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume :=
    fun q ξ => Integrable.mono' (hqi q) (hcx q ξ).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => (hn q ξ x).le)
  
  have s2 : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), hm1Profile ⇑(f + g) = hm1Profile ⇑f + hm1Profile ⇑g := by
    intro f g
    funext ξ
    simp only [hm1Profile, fourierLine, Pi.add_apply, SchwartzMap.add_apply, Complex.ofReal_add,
      mul_add]
    rw [integral_add (s1 f ξ) (s1 g ξ)]
    ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), hm1Profile ⇑(c • f) = c • hm1Profile ⇑f := by
    intro c f
    funext ξ
    simp only [hm1Profile, fourierLine, Pi.smul_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.real_smul]
    have : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((c : ℂ) * (f x : ℂ))) =
        fun x : ℝ => (c : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [this, integral_const_mul]
    ring
  
  have hsq : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (a + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹) := by
    intro a ha
    exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop)).inv₀
      (fun ξ => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)).ne')
  have s4 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Continuous (hm1Profile ⇑q) := by
    intro q
    have h1 : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) := by
      have := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hsq 4 (by norm_num))
      refine this.congr fun ξ => ?_
      simp
    have h2 : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      refine continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun x => ‖q x‖)
        (fun ξ => (hcx q ξ).aestronglyMeasurable) (fun ξ => ae_of_all _ fun x => (hn q ξ x).le)
        (hqi q) (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
      fun_prop
    have : hm1Profile ⇑q = fun ξ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact h1.mul (continuous_const.mul h2)
  
  have s5 : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ), ‖hm1Profile ⇑q ξ‖ ≤
      ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) * (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
    intro q ξ
    have hI : ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
        ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
      refine (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact hn q ξ x
    have hw : (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity))
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hA : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
    show ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    calc (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ *
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖)
        ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) :=
          mul_le_mul hw (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI (by positivity))
            (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
      _ = ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) * (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by ring
  
  have s6 : MemLp (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹) 2 volume := by
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hsq 1 one_pos).aestronglyMeasurable]
    refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.congr (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
    simp only
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  
  have s7 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile ⇑q) 2 volume := by
    intro q
    have hA : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    refine MemLp.of_le (s6.const_mul ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖))
      (s4 q).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
    refine (s5 q ξ).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA (by positivity))]
  have hT : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (s7 q).toLp _ := by
    intro q
    unfold toHm1
    rw [dif_pos (s7 q)]
  
  have s10 : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 (f + g) = toHm1 f + toHm1 g := by
    intro f g
    rw [hT, hT, hT, ← MemLp.toLp_add]
    exact MemLp.toLp_congr _ _ (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => congrFun (s2 f g) ξ)
  have s11 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), toHm1 (c • f) = c • toHm1 f := by
    intro c f
    rw [hT, hT, ← MemLp.toLp_const_smul]
    exact MemLp.toLp_congr _ _ (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => congrFun (s3 c f) ξ)
  
  have s9 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖toHm1 q‖ ≤ ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ‖s6.toLp _‖) * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
    intro q
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    have key : ‖toHm1 q‖ ≤ ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) • s6.toLp _‖ := by
      rw [hT q]
      apply Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le
      filter_upwards [MemLp.coeFn_toLp (s7 q), MemLp.coeFn_toLp s6,
        Lp.coeFn_smul ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) (s6.toLp _)] with ξ h1 h2 h3
      rw [h1, h3, Pi.smul_apply, h2, smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA0 (by positivity))]
      exact s5 q ξ
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hA0] at key
    calc ‖toHm1 q‖ ≤ _ := key
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have s8 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ ≤
      π * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 q) := by
    intro q
    have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ ≤
        (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 q) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro x
      have h0 := SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ q x
      have h2 := SchwartzMap.norm_pow_mul_le_seminorm ℝ q 2 x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs x, sq_abs] at h2
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    calc ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
        ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 q) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          integral_mono (hqi q) (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul _) hpt
      _ = π * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 q) := by
          rw [integral_const_mul, integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq, mul_comm]
  
  set C : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ‖s6.toLp _‖ with hCdef
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hbound : ∃ (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (C' : ℝ), 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      ‖toHm1 f‖ ≤ C' * (s.sup (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℝ)) f := by
    refine ⟨{(0, 0), (2, 0)}, C * π * 2, by positivity, fun f => ?_⟩
    have hle : ∀ k : ℕ × ℕ, k ∈ ({(0, 0), (2, 0)} : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) →
        schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℝ k f ≤
          (({(0, 0), (2, 0)} : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)).sup (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℝ)) f :=
      fun k hk => Seminorm.le_def.1 (Finset.le_sup hk) f
    have e0 := hle (0, 0) (by simp)
    have e2 := hle (2, 0) (by simp)
    rw [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply] at e0 e2
    have := s8 f
    have h9 := s9 f
    have hπ : 0 < π := Real.pi_pos
    calc ‖toHm1 f‖ ≤ C * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ := h9
      _ ≤ C * (π * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 f)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hC0
      _ ≤ C * (π * (2 * (({(0, 0), (2, 0)} : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)).sup
            (schwartzSeminormFamily ℝ ℝ ℝ)) f)) := by
          gcongr
          linarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  refine ⟨SchwartzMap.mkCLMtoNormedSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (𝕜' := ℝ) (σ := RingHom.id ℝ) (D := ℝ) (E := ℝ)
    (G := Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) toHm1 s10 (fun a f => by simpa using s11 a f) hbound,
    fun q => rfl⟩

signature.name: schwartz_curve_comp_clm_continuous
signature.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] E) (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hu : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt u v t) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => L (u t)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcont : Continuous u := by
    refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => ?_
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu t
    have h2 := (HasFDerivAtFilter.isLittleOTVS hv.hasFDerivAt).tendsto_inv_smul
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] at h2
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x - t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.2 Filter.tendsto_id
    have h4 : ∀ x : ℝ, u x - u t - (x - t) • v =
        (x - t) • ((x - t)⁻¹ • (u x - u t - (x - t) • v)) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x = t
      · subst hx
        simp
      · rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hx)]
    have h5 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => u x - u t - (x - t) • v) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have := h3.smul h2
      rw [smul_zero] at this
      exact this.congr (fun x => (h4 x).symm)
    have h6 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (x - t) • v) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have := h3.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := v))
      rwa [zero_smul] at this
    have h7 := h5.add h6
    rw [add_zero] at h7
    have h8 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => u x - u t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) :=
      h7.congr (fun x => sub_add_cancel _ _)
    exact tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.1 h8
  exact L.continuous.comp hcont

informal_problem.statement:
{X A : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (e : A → X) (he : DenseRange e) (F : ℝ → A → X)
    (hF_cont : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t : ℝ => F t a)
    (hF_cauchy : ∀ a : ℕ → A, CauchySeq (fun n => e (a n)) →
      ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
        dist (F t (a m)) (F t (a n)) < ε) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ × X → X, Continuous Φ ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (a : A), Φ (t, e a) = F t a) ∧
      ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F t (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x)))

signature.name: dense_extension_of_uniform_cauchy
signature.statement:
{X A : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (e : A → X) (he : DenseRange e) (F : ℝ → A → X)
    (hF_cont : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t : ℝ => F t a)
    (hF_cauchy : ∀ a : ℕ → A, CauchySeq (fun n => e (a n)) →
      ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
        dist (F t (a m)) (F t (a n)) < ε) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ × X → X, Continuous Φ ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (a : A), Φ (t, e a) = F t a) ∧
      ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F t (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x)))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hloc : ∀ x₀ : X, ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ a b : A,
      dist (e a) x₀ < δ → dist (e b) x₀ < δ → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →
        dist (F t a) (F t b) < ε := by
    intro x₀ T hT ε hε
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have h' : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : A, ∃ t : ℝ, dist (e a) x₀ < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ∧
        dist (e b) x₀ < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ∧ |t| ≤ T ∧ ε ≤ dist (F t a) (F t b) := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, t, ht, hd⟩ := hcon (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat
      exact ⟨a, b, t, ha, hb, ht, hd⟩
    choose α β τ hα hβ hτ hd using h'
    let c : ℕ → A := fun k => if k % 2 = 0 then α (k / 2) else β (k / 2)
    have hc_bound : ∀ k, dist (e (c k)) x₀ < 1 / (((k / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) := by
      intro k
      simp only [c]
      split_ifs
      · exact hα _
      · exact hβ _
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => e (c k)) Filter.atTop (nhds x₀) := by
      rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
      refine squeeze_zero (fun k => dist_nonneg) (fun k => (hc_bound k).le) ?_
      exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.comp
        (Nat.tendsto_div_const_atTop two_ne_zero)
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hF_cauchy c hlim.cauchySeq T hT ε hε
    have h1 : c (2 * N) = α N := by
      simp only [c]
      rw [if_pos (by omega)]
      congr 1
      omega
    have h2 : c (2 * N + 1) = β N := by
      simp only [c]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      congr 1
      omega
    have h3 := hN (2 * N) (by omega) (2 * N + 1) (by omega) (τ N) (hτ N)
    rw [h1, h2] at h3
    exact absurd h3 (not_lt.2 (hd N))
  
  have hseq : ∀ x : X, ∃ s : ℕ → A,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (s n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbt⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.1 (he x)
    choose s hs using hb
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    have hsb : (fun n => e (s n)) = b := funext hs
    rw [hsb]
    exact hbt
  choose s hs using hseq
  have hcauchy : ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, CauchySeq (fun n => F t (a n)) := by
    intro x a ha t
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hD⟩ := hloc x (|t| + 1) (by positivity) ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 ha δ hδ
    exact ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => hD _ _ (hN m hm) (hN n hn) t (by linarith)⟩
  have hex : ∀ p : ℝ × X, ∃ y : X,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F p.1 (s p.2 n)) Filter.atTop (nhds y) :=
    fun p => cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (hcauchy p.2 (s p.2) (hs p.2) p.1)
  choose Φ hΦ using hex
  have hlimit : ∀ (x : X) (a : ℕ → A),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F t (a n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Φ (t, x))) := by
    intro x a ha t
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hD⟩ := hloc x (|t| + 1) (by positivity) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 ha δ hδ
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 (hs x) δ hδ
    obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 (hΦ (t, x)) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨max N₁ (max N₂ N₃), fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have g1 := hD (a n) (s x n) (hN₁ n (by omega)) (hN₂ n (by omega)) t (by linarith)
    have g3 : dist (F t (s x n)) (Φ (t, x)) < ε / 2 := hN₃ n (by omega)
    calc dist (F t (a n)) (Φ (t, x))
        ≤ dist (F t (a n)) (F t (s x n)) + dist (F t (s x n)) (Φ (t, x)) :=
          dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add g1 g3
      _ = ε := by ring
  
  have hcont : Continuous Φ := by
    rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
    rintro ⟨t₀, x₀⟩ ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hD⟩ := hloc x₀ (|t₀| + 1) (by positivity) (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    have claimC : ∀ x : X, dist x x₀ < δ₁ → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ |t₀| + 1 → ∀ a : A,
        dist (e a) x₀ < δ₁ → dist (Φ (t, x)) (F t a) ≤ ε / 4 := by
      intro x hx t ht a ha
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 (hs x) (δ₁ - dist x x₀) (by linarith)
      have hT := (hlimit x (s x) (hs x) t).dist
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => F t a) Filter.atTop (nhds (F t a)))
      refine le_of_tendsto hT (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩)
      have k1 := hN n hn
      have k2 : dist (e (s x n)) x₀ < δ₁ := by
        calc dist (e (s x n)) x₀ ≤ dist (e (s x n)) x + dist x x₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ < δ₁ := by linarith
      exact (hD _ _ k2 ha t ht).le
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := he.exists_dist_lt x₀ hδ₁
    rw [dist_comm] at ha
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηc⟩ := Metric.continuous_iff.1 (hF_cont a) t₀ (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨min (min δ₁ η) 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨t, x⟩ hp
    rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hp
    have ht' : dist t t₀ < min (min δ₁ η) 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp
    have hx' : dist x x₀ < min (min δ₁ η) 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hp
    simp only [lt_min_iff] at ht' hx'
    have htT : |t| ≤ |t₀| + 1 := by
      have hh := ht'.2
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hh
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub t t₀
      linarith
    have c1 := claimC x hx'.1.1 t htT a ha
    have c2 := hηc t ht'.1.2
    have hx0 : dist x₀ x₀ < δ₁ := by rw [dist_self]; exact hδ₁
    have c3 := claimC x₀ hx0 t₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg t₀]) a ha
    rw [dist_comm] at c3
    calc dist (Φ (t, x)) (Φ (t₀, x₀))
        ≤ dist (Φ (t, x)) (F t a) + dist (F t a) (F t₀ a) + dist (F t₀ a) (Φ (t₀, x₀)) :=
          dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
  
  refine ⟨Φ, hcont, fun t a => ?_, hlimit⟩
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hlimit (e a) (fun _ => a) tendsto_const_nhds t) tendsto_const_nhds

signature.name: Hm1_weight_uniform_decay
signature.statement:
(f : ℕ → Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hf : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds g)) :
    ∀ η > (0 : ℝ), ∃ K ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ K, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(f n : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 < η

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hw_nonneg : ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2) := by
    intro κ _ ξ; positivity
  have hw_le : ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro κ hκ ξ
    have hpos : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ]
    rw [div_le_one hpos]
    nlinarith
  have hw_meas : ∀ κ : ℝ, Measurable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) := by
    intro κ; fun_prop
  have hsq_int : ∀ h : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro h
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable h)).1 (Lp.memLp h)
  have hbound : ∀ h : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      ‖((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2‖ ≤ ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro h κ hκ ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw_nonneg κ hκ ξ) (by positivity))]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) (hw_le κ hκ ξ)
  have hw_aesm : ∀ h : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ κ : ℝ,
      AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
    intro h κ
    exact (hw_meas κ).aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hsq_int h).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hw_int : ∀ h : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ →

    intro u v κ hκ

      rw [hξ, Pi.sub_apply]

      have hw1 := hw_le κ hκ ξ
      have htri := norm_sub_norm_le ((u : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) ((v : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
      have ha : 0 ≤ ‖(u : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ := norm_nonneg _

by
  
  have hL2 : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖f‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    rw [norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) f, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def,
      ← integral_re (MeasureTheory.L2.integrable_inner f f)]
    congr 1
    funext ξ
    exact (inner_self_eq_norm_sq _).symm
  have hsq : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
    fun f => (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).1 (Lp.memLp f)
  
  have hphi2 : ∀ h ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro h ξ
    have e : (ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = ((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e]
    calc ‖Complex.exp (((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) - 1‖
        ≤ ‖Complex.exp (((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _

  have hphiabs : ∀ h ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ≤ |ξ| * |h| := by
    intro h ξ
    have e : (ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = I * ((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e]
    calc ‖Complex.exp (I * ((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ)) - 1‖ ≤ ‖ξ * h‖ :=
          Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le
      _ = |ξ| * |h| := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  have hphicont : ∀ h : ℝ, Continuous fun ξ : ℝ => Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1 := by
    intro h
    fun_prop
  constructor
  · 
    intro f K hK h
    have hK2 : 1 ≤ K ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hD : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2 := fun ξ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ]
    have hw0 : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) :=

      intro ξ
      have hz0 := norm_nonneg (Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1)
      have hz2 := hphi2 h ξ
      have hza := hphiabs h ξ
      have hwξ := hw0 ξ
      by_cases hc : ξ ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2

          pow_le_pow_left₀ hz0 hza 2
        have h2 : (|ξ| * |h|) ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by rw [mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs]
        have h3 : ξ ^ 2 * h ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg h)
        linarith
      · push_neg at hc
        have h1 : ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hz0 hz2 2

          rw [mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ (hD ξ)]; nlinarith
        have h5 : 0 ≤ K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 := by positivity

    have hle : translateDiffSq f h ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, (K ^ 2 * h ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
        20 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2)) := by
      unfold translateDiffSq
      apply integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => by positivity)
        (((hsq f).const_mul (K ^ 2 * h ^ 2)).add (hwint.const_mul 20))
      refine ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_

      rw [norm_mul, mul_pow]

    rw [integral_add ((hsq f).const_mul _) (hwint.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,

    intro h

        MemLp (fun ξ : ℝ => (Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1) * (g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) 2

    have hT : ∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
        translateDiffSq g h = ‖MemLp.toLp _ (hmem g)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro g
      rw [← hL2 (MemLp.toLp _ (hmem g))]
      unfold translateDiffSq
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(hmem g).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
      simp only [hξ]
    have hLip : LipschitzWith 2
        (fun g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) => MemLp.toLp _ (hmem g)) := by
      apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro g₁ g₂
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
      apply Lp.norm_le_mul_norm_of_ae_le_mul
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (MemLp.toLp _ (hmem g₁)) (MemLp.toLp _ (hmem g₂)),
        Lp.coeFn_sub g₁ g₂, (hmem g₁).coeFn_toLp, (hmem g₂).coeFn_toLp] with ξ h1 h2 h3 h4
      rw [h1, h2, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, h3, h4, ← mul_sub, norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hphi2 h ξ) (norm_nonneg _)
    have heq : (fun g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) => translateDiffSq g h) =
        fun g => ‖MemLp.toLp _ (hmem g)‖ ^ 2 := funext hT
    rw [heq]
    exact (continuous_norm.comp hLip.continuous).pow 2

The CRUX riccati_kdv_orthogonal is placed in its own named child, and I re-derived its identity F'' = X + 2kappa F' - 2wF' with F = -q' + (2q-4kappa^2)(w-kappa) from w' = q + 2kappa w - w^2; F' then equals z by the 1/16 contraction, and the integral of wF' vanishes as three total derivatives (F tends to 4kappa^3 at both ends). The glue compiled and uses every child (c1 in hB, c3 in hD, c5 and c6 in hC); the bootstrap arithmetic holds, since 81/(49*256) < 1/100. Divergences from the blueprint are documented and improve it: the bootstrap is proved inline, and riccatiK_bounds and schwartz_curve_comp_clm_hasDerivAt are left as inputs for the c1/c3/c5/c6 provers, which avoids a flattened chain. Blueprint sections 4 and 5 carry real numerics, including a wrong-sign negative control. No child duplicates a proved lemma or restates an ancestor.

The CRUX sits in the named child riccati_hk_orthogonal. That child is a static identity at one fixed q, with no time, flow, bootstrap or smallness, and the blueprint O1-O9 route checks out by hand: K-operator inverts d/dx - 2K; the adjoint identity (Hz)' = wz/K + Hf holds; G''' = 2q'G + 4(q+K^2)G' follows from a' = q + K^2 - a^2; the Phi total-derivative identity holds; the scaffold GreenODE expands to gamma''' = q'/k + 2q'gamma + 4q gamma' + 4k^2 gamma'; and the junk value greenOffset = 0 is covered by O6. riccatiK_sq_integral, riccati_fixed_point and riccati_alpha_hasDerivAt are generic nodes shared with the sibling kdv_small_data_weight_control, and the dependency runs in the right direction. The other three children are proved lemmas from section 10, cited rather than re-proved. The glue uses every child and handles both hkFlow branches. The diagonal kappa' = kappa is handled by doubling at 2kappa, and the bootstrap runs at an energy kb in {1,2} with kb different from kappa. The constants are derived, not guessed: delta = 1/30, 4*81/44100 below 1/100, C = 324/49. signature.name: hk_flow_Hm1_continuity
signature.statement:
∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ a : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ n, ‖ι (a n)‖ ≤ δ) →
      CauchySeq (fun n => ι (a n)) →
      ∀ T > (0 : ℝ), ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T →

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Lc, hLc⟩ := toHm1_clm
  
  
  
  have hn : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
    intro q ξ x
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
  have hcx : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro q ξ
    fun_prop
  have hqi : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖q x‖) volume :=
    fun q => (q.integrable (μ := volume)).norm
  have hint : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume :=
    fun q ξ => Integrable.mono' (hqi q) (hcx q ξ).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => (hn q ξ x).le)
  have hsq : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (a + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹) := by
    intro a ha
    exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop)).inv₀
      (fun ξ => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)).ne')
  have hcont : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Continuous (hm1Profile ⇑q) := by
    intro q
    have h1 : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) := by
      have := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hsq 4 (by norm_num))
      refine this.congr fun ξ => ?_
      simp
    have h2 : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      refine continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun x => ‖q x‖)
        (fun ξ => (hcx q ξ).aestronglyMeasurable) (fun ξ => ae_of_all _ fun x => (hn q ξ x).le)
        (hqi q) (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
      fun_prop
    have : hm1Profile ⇑q = fun ξ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact h1.mul (continuous_const.mul h2)
  have hpt : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ), ‖hm1Profile ⇑q ξ‖ ≤
      ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) * (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
    intro q ξ
    have hI : ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
        ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
      refine (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact hn q ξ x
    have hw : (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity))
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hA : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
    show ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    calc (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ *
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖)
        ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) :=
          mul_le_mul hw (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI (by positivity))
            (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
      _ = ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) * (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by ring
  have hwL2 : MemLp (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹) 2 volume := by
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hsq 1 one_pos).aestronglyMeasurable]
    refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.congr (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
    simp only
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have hmem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile ⇑q) 2 volume := by
    intro q
    have hA : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    refine MemLp.of_le (hwL2.const_mul ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖))
      (hcont q).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
    refine (hpt q ξ).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA (by positivity))]
  have hT : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (hmem q).toLp _ := by
    intro q
    unfold toHm1
    rw [dif_pos (hmem q)]
  
  
  
  have s5 : ∀ f w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, w x = deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) x) →
      (toHm1 w : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] fun ξ : ℝ => ((ξ : ℂ) * I) * (toHm1 f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ := by
    intro f w hw
    have key : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          ((ξ : ℂ) * I) * ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((f x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro ξ
      have hu : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I))
          (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (-(ξ : ℂ) * I)) x := by
        intro x
        have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) (-(ξ : ℂ) * I) x := by
          have := (((hasDerivAt_id x).ofReal_comp).const_mul (ξ : ℂ)).neg.mul_const I

        exact h0.cexp
      have hv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ((f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((w x : ℝ) : ℂ) x := by
        intro x
        rw [hw x]
        exact (f.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).ofReal_comp
      have hint2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ =>
          (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (-(ξ : ℂ) * I)) * ((f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume := by
        refine ((hint f ξ).const_mul (-(ξ : ℂ) * I)).congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
        simp only
        ring
      have hibp := integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul_of_integrable hu hv (hint w ξ) hint2 (hint f ξ)
      rw [hibp]
      have : (fun x : ℝ =>
          (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (-(ξ : ℂ) * I)) * ((f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          fun x : ℝ => (-(ξ : ℂ) * I) *
            (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        funext x; ring
      rw [this, integral_const_mul]
      ring
    have hprof : ∀ ξ : ℝ, hm1Profile w ξ = ((ξ : ℂ) * I) * hm1Profile f ξ := by
      intro ξ
      simp only [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
      rw [key ξ]
      ring
    rw [hT w, hT f]
    filter_upwards [MemLp.coeFn_toLp (hmem w), MemLp.coeFn_toLp (hmem f)] with ξ h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact hprof ξ
  
  
  
  have s6 : ∀ u v : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      (v : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] (fun ξ : ℝ => ((ξ : ℂ) * I) * (u : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) →
      inner ℝ u v = 0 := by
    intro u v h
    rw [MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    have h0 : (fun ξ : ℝ => inner ℝ ((u : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) ((v : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)) =ᵐ[volume]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [h] with ξ hξ
      rw [hξ]
      simp [Complex.inner, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
      ring
    rw [integral_congr_ae h0, integral_zero]
  
  
  
  have s7 : ∀ (D D' : ℝ → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ), (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt D (D' t) t) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, |D' t| ≤ Λ * D t) → ∀ t : ℝ, D t ≤ Real.exp (Λ * |t|) * D 0 := by
    intro D D' Λ hD hb t
    rcases le_or_gt 0 t with ht | ht
    · have hE : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (-Λ * s) * D s)
          (Real.exp (-Λ * s) * (-Λ) * D s + Real.exp (-Λ * s) * D' s) s := by
        intro s
        have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -Λ * s) (-Λ) s := by
          have := (hasDerivAt_id' s).const_mul (-Λ)
          rwa [mul_one] at this
        exact h0.exp.mul (hD s)
      have hanti : Antitone (fun s => Real.exp (-Λ * s) * D s) := by
        apply antitone_of_deriv_nonpos (fun s => (hE s).differentiableAt)
        intro s
        rw [(hE s).deriv]
        have hpos := Real.exp_pos (-Λ * s)
        have h1 := (le_abs_self (D' s)).trans (hb s)
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hpos.le (sub_nonneg.2 h1)]
      have h := hanti ht
      simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul] at h
      rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
      have e : Real.exp (Λ * t) * Real.exp (-Λ * t) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf; exact Real.exp_zero
      have hp := Real.exp_pos (Λ * t)
      calc D t = Real.exp (Λ * t) * (Real.exp (-Λ * t) * D t) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, e, one_mul]
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Λ * t) * D 0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hp.le
    · have hF : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (Λ * s) * D s)
          (Real.exp (Λ * s) * Λ * D s + Real.exp (Λ * s) * D' s) s := by
        intro s
        have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Λ * s) Λ s := by
          have := (hasDerivAt_id' s).const_mul Λ
          rwa [mul_one] at this
        exact h0.exp.mul (hD s)
      have hmono : Monotone (fun s => Real.exp (Λ * s) * D s) := by
        apply monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun s => (hF s).differentiableAt)
        intro s
        rw [(hF s).deriv]
        have hpos := Real.exp_pos (Λ * s)
        have h1 := (neg_le_abs (D' s)).trans (hb s)
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hpos.le (sub_nonneg.2 h1)]
      have h := hmono ht.le
      simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul] at h
      rw [abs_of_neg ht]
      have e : Real.exp (Λ * -t) * Real.exp (Λ * t) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf; exact Real.exp_zero
      have hp := Real.exp_pos (Λ * -t)
      calc D t = Real.exp (Λ * -t) * (Real.exp (Λ * t) * D t) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, e, one_mul]
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Λ * -t) * D 0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hp.le
  
  
  
  have s8 : ∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt u v t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => Lc (u s)) (Lc v) t := by
    intro u v t hu
    have h0 := HasFDerivAtFilter.isLittleOTVS hu
    have h1 := h0.tendsto_inv_smul
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Lc ((x - t)⁻¹ • (u x - u t - (x - t) • v)))
        (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have := (Lc.continuous.tendsto 0).comp h1
      rw [map_zero] at this
      refine this.congr (fun x => ?_)
      simp only [Function.comp, ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope]
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Lc ((x - t)⁻¹ • (u x - u t - (x - t) • v)) + Lc v)
        (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds (0 + Lc v)) :=
      (h2.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).add tendsto_const_nhds
    rw [zero_add] at h3
    refine h3.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
    have hx' : x - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hx
    rw [slope_def_module]
    simp only [map_smul, map_sub, smul_sub, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx', one_smul]
    abel
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨δE, hδE, hE⟩ := hk_flow_exists
  obtain ⟨δW, hδW, CW, hCW, hW⟩ := hk_flow_weight_control
  obtain ⟨δU, hδU, hU⟩ := green_exists_unique
  obtain ⟨δG, hδG, hG⟩ := green_solution_deriv_lipschitz
  obtain ⟨δs, hδsdef⟩ : ∃ δs : ℝ, δs = min δU δG := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδs : 0 < δs := by rw [hδsdef]; exact lt_min hδU hδG
  have hsU : δs ≤ δU := by rw [hδsdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hsG : δs ≤ δG := by rw [hδsdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hCW0 : 0 < CW := by linarith
  refine ⟨min δE (min δW (δs / CW)), lt_min hδE (lt_min hδW (div_pos hδs hCW0)), ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ a ha hc T hT ε hε
  have haE : ∀ n, ‖ι (a n)‖ ≤ δE := fun n => le_trans (ha n) (min_le_left _ _)
  have haW : ∀ n, ‖ι (a n)‖ ≤ δW :=
    fun n => le_trans (ha n) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have haS : ∀ n, ‖ι (a n)‖ ≤ δs / CW :=
    fun n => le_trans (ha n) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  obtain ⟨Lk, hLk0, hGk⟩ := hG κ hκ
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛdef⟩ : ∃ Λ : ℝ, Λ = 32 * κ ^ 5 * Lk := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ := by rw [hΛdef]; positivity
  
  
  
  have hkFlow_zero : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), hkFlow κ 0 q = q := by
    intro q
    unfold hkFlow
    split_ifs with h
    · exact (Classical.choose_spec h).2
    · rfl
  have hdist : ∀ p q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), dist (ι p) (ι q) = ‖toHm1 p - toHm1 q‖ := by
    intro p q
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    rfl
  
  
  
  have hsmall : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖ι (hkFlow κ t (a n))‖ ≤ δs := by
    intro n t
    have h1 := hW κ hκ (a n) (haW n) t 1 le_rfl
    rw [(Hm1_weight_basic _).1, (Hm1_weight_basic _).1] at h1
    have h2 : ‖(ι (a n) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ (δs / CW) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (haS n) 2
    have h3 : CW * (δs / CW) ^ 2 ≤ δs ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_pow, mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCW0.le (sq_nonneg δs)) (sub_nonneg.2 hCW)]
    have h4 : ‖(ι (hkFlow κ t (a n)) : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ δs ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hCW0.le]
    exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h4 hδs.le).2
  
  
  
  have hgreen : ∀ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι p‖ ≤ δU → GreenODE κ p (greenOffset κ p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hex := (hU κ hκ p hp).exists
    unfold greenOffset
    rw [dif_pos hex]
    exact Classical.choose_spec hex
  
  
  
  have hlip : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), dist (ι (hkFlow κ t (a m))) (ι (hkFlow κ t (a n))) ^ 2 ≤
      Real.exp (Λ * |t|) * dist (ι (a m)) (ι (a n)) ^ 2 := by
    intro m n
    have hE1 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun t => hkFlow κ t (a m)) v t ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, v x = hkRHS κ (hkFlow κ t (a m)) x := hE κ hκ (a m) (haE m)
    have hE2 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun t => hkFlow κ t (a n)) v t ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, v x = hkRHS κ (hkFlow κ t (a n)) x := hE κ hκ (a n) (haE n)
    choose V₁ hV₁d hV₁e using hE1
    choose V₂ hV₂d hV₂e using hE2
    have hD : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun s => ‖toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a m)) - toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a n))‖ ^ 2)
        (2 * inner ℝ (toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a m)) - toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a n)))
          (toHm1 (V₁ s) - toHm1 (V₂ s))) s := by
      intro s
      have h1 := s8 _ _ s (hV₁d s)
      have h2 := s8 _ _ s (hV₂d s)
      simp only [hLc] at h1 h2
      exact (h1.sub h2).norm_sq
    have hbd : ∀ s : ℝ, |2 * inner ℝ (toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a m)) - toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a n)))
          (toHm1 (V₁ s) - toHm1 (V₂ s))| ≤
        Λ * ‖toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a m)) - toHm1 (hkFlow κ s (a n))‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro s
      have e1 := hV₁e s
      have e2 := hV₂e s
      have hp₁s := hsmall m s
      have hp₂s := hsmall n s
      generalize hkFlow κ s (a m) = p₁ at e1 hp₁s ⊢
      generalize hkFlow κ s (a n) = p₂ at e2 hp₂s ⊢
      obtain ⟨w, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          w = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (greenOffset κ p₁ - greenOffset κ p₂) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨f', hf'def⟩ : ∃ f' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), f' = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (p₁ - p₂) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hw : ∀ x : ℝ, w x = deriv (greenOffset κ p₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x -
          deriv (greenOffset κ p₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
        intro x
        rw [hwdef, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
        have : ((greenOffset κ p₁ - greenOffset κ p₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) =
            fun y => greenOffset κ p₁ y - greenOffset κ p₂ y := by
          funext y; simp
        rw [this]
        exact deriv_sub (greenOffset κ p₁).differentiableAt (greenOffset κ p₂).differentiableAt
      have hf'2 : ∀ x : ℝ, f' x = deriv ((p₁ - p₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
        intro x
        rw [hf'def, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
      have hf' : ∀ x : ℝ, f' x = deriv (p₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (p₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
        intro x
        rw [hf'2]
        have : ((p₁ - p₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => p₁ y - p₂ y := by
          funext y; simp
        rw [this]
        exact deriv_sub p₁.differentiableAt p₂.differentiableAt
      have hVdiff : V₁ s - V₂ s = (16 * κ ^ 5) • w + (4 * κ ^ 2) • f' := by
        ext x
        simp only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply,
          smul_eq_mul]
        rw [e1 x, e2 x, hw x, hf' x]

  have hFG : ∀ ξ : ℝ, FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ =
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ /
        (2 * (π : ℂ) * I * (ξ : ℂ) - 2 * (κ : ℂ)) := by
    intro ξ
    rw [hrel ξ, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (hD0 ξ)]
  have hFGsq : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ‖ ^ 2 /
          (4 * π ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2) := by
    intro ξ
    rw [hFG ξ, norm_div, div_pow, hDn ξ]
  have hFGle : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ‖ ≤
        ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ‖ / (2 * κ) := by
    intro ξ
    rw [hFG ξ, norm_div]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) (hDpos ξ)
  
  have hFGc : Continuous (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
    have he : FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        fun ξ : ℝ => FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ξ /
          (2 * (π : ℂ) * I * (ξ : ℂ) - 2 * (κ : ℂ)) := funext hFG
    rw [he]
    exact hQc.div (by fun_prop) hD0
  have hFGi : Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
    Integrable.mono' (hQi.norm.div_const (2 * κ)) hFGc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ hFGle)
  
  have plancherel : ∀ G : ℝ → ℂ, Continuous G → Integrable G (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier G) (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      ∫ x : ℝ, ‖G x‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖FourierTransform.fourier G ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro G hc hi hF
    have hin : ∀ a b : ℝ, inner ℝ a b = b * a := fun a b => by simp
    have hinv : ∀ x : ℝ, G x = ∫ ξ : ℝ, cexp (↑(2 * π * (x * ξ)) * I) *
        FourierTransform.fourier G ξ := by
      intro x
      have h1 := congrFun (Continuous.fourierInv_fourier_eq hc hi hF) x
      rw [Real.fourierInv_eq'] at h1
      simp only [hin, smul_eq_mul] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have hHeq : ∀ ξ : ℝ, FourierTransform.fourier G ξ =
        ∫ x : ℝ, cexp (↑(-2 * π * x * ξ) * I) * G x := by
      intro ξ
      rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    have hHc : Continuous (FourierTransform.fourier G) :=
      VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_continuous (e := Real.fourierChar) (L := innerₗ ℝ)
        Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner hi
    have hsq : ∀ f : ℝ → ℂ, ((∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, (starRingEnd ℂ) (f x) * f x := by
      intro f
      rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [RCLike.conj_mul]
      norm_cast
    have h2 : ∫ x : ℝ, (starRingEnd ℂ) (G x) * G x =
        ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, (starRingEnd ℂ) (G x) *
          (cexp (↑(2 * π * (x * ξ)) * I) * FourierTransform.fourier G ξ) := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [integral_const_mul, ← hinv x]
    have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun x ξ : ℝ => (starRingEnd ℂ) (G x) *
        (cexp (↑(2 * π * (x * ξ)) * I) * FourierTransform.fourier G ξ))
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
      have hb := (hi.norm).mul_prod (hF.norm)
      refine hb.mono' ?_ (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
      · have hcz : Continuous fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (starRingEnd ℂ) (G z.1) *
            (cexp (↑(2 * π * (z.1 * z.2)) * I) * FourierTransform.fourier G z.2) :=
          (Complex.continuous_conj.comp (hc.comp continuous_fst)).mul
            ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun z : ℝ × ℝ => cexp (↑(2 * π * (z.1 * z.2)) * I)).mul
              (hHc.comp continuous_snd))
        exact hcz.aestronglyMeasurable
      · show ‖(starRingEnd ℂ) (G z.1) *
            (cexp (↑(2 * π * (z.1 * z.2)) * I) * FourierTransform.fourier G z.2)‖ ≤ _
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, RCLike.norm_conj, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
    have h3 : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, (starRingEnd ℂ) (G x) *
        (cexp (↑(2 * π * (x * ξ)) * I) * FourierTransform.fourier G ξ) =
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (FourierTransform.fourier G ξ) * FourierTransform.fourier G ξ := by
      intro ξ
      have e1 : ∀ x : ℝ, (starRingEnd ℂ) (G x) *
          (cexp (↑(2 * π * (x * ξ)) * I) * FourierTransform.fourier G ξ) =
          (starRingEnd ℂ) (cexp (↑(-2 * π * x * ξ) * I) * G x) *
            FourierTransform.fourier G ξ := by
        intro x
        have hc1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) (↑(-2 * π * x * ξ) * I) = ↑(2 * π * (x * ξ)) * I := by
          rw [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [map_mul, ← Complex.exp_conj, hc1]
        ring
      simp_rw [e1]
      rw [integral_mul_const, integral_conj, ← hHeq ξ]
    have key : ((∫ x : ℝ, ‖G x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖FourierTransform.fourier G ξ‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hsq, h2, integral_integral_swap hint, hsq]
      congr 1
      funext ξ
      exact h3 ξ
    exact_mod_cast key
  have hP := plancherel (fun x : ℝ => ((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ))
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hgc) hgi.ofReal hFGi
  
  have hL : (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, ‖((riccatiK κ q x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  have hWeq : ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ η : ℝ, ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) η‖ ^ 2 /
        (4 * π ^ 2 * η ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2) := by
    have hn : ∀ (r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = ‖r x‖ := by
      intro r ξ x
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real]
      have : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [this, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
    have hcx : ∀ (r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      intro r ξ
      fun_prop
    have hqi : ∀ r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖r x‖) volume :=
      fun r => (r.integrable (μ := volume)).norm
    have hsq : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (a + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹) := by
      intro a ha
      exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop)).inv₀
        (fun ξ => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)).ne')
    have s4 : ∀ r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Continuous (hm1Profile ⇑r) := by
      intro r
      have h1 : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) := by
        have := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hsq 4 (by norm_num))
        refine this.congr fun ξ => ?_
        simp
      have h2 : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ =>
          ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        refine continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun x => ‖r x‖)
          (fun ξ => (hcx r ξ).aestronglyMeasurable) (fun ξ => ae_of_all _ fun x => (hn r ξ x).le)
          (hqi r) (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
        fun_prop
      have : hm1Profile ⇑r = fun ξ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := rfl
      rw [this]
      exact h1.mul (continuous_const.mul h2)
    have s5 : ∀ (r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ), ‖hm1Profile ⇑r ξ‖ ≤
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖r x‖) * (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      intro r ξ
      have hI : ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          ∫ x : ℝ, ‖r x‖ := by
        refine (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
        congr 1
        funext x
        exact hn r ξ x
      have hw : (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        apply inv_anti₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity))
        exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
      have hA : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖r x‖ := integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
      show ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤ _
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      calc (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ *
            ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖)
          ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖r x‖) :=
            mul_le_mul hw (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI (by positivity))
              (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
        _ = ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖r x‖) * (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by ring
    have s6 : MemLp (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹) 2 volume := by
      rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (hsq 1 one_pos).aestronglyMeasurable]
      refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.congr (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
      simp only
      rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    have s7 : ∀ r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile ⇑r) 2 volume := by
      intro r
      have hA : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖r x‖ :=
        mul_nonneg (by positivity) (integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
      refine MemLp.of_le (s6.const_mul ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖r x‖))
        (s4 r).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
      refine (s5 r ξ).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA (by positivity))]
    have hae : ∀ r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (toHm1 r : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] hm1Profile ⇑r := by
      intro r
      have hT : toHm1 r = (s7 r).toLp _ := by
        unfold toHm1
        rw [dif_pos (s7 r)]
      rw [hT]
      exact MemLp.coeFn_toLp (s7 r)
    have hprof : ∀ (r : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ),
        ‖hm1Profile r ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      intro r ξ
      show ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 = _
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
        mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      ring
    
    have hconv : ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine (⇑q) ξ = ((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) (ξ / (2 * π)) := by
      intro ξ
      unfold fourierLine
      rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
      congr 1
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      congr 2
      have hπ : (π : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.2 Real.pi_ne_zero
      push_cast
      field_simp
    have hconvn : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (⇑q) ξ‖ ^ 2 = (2 * π)⁻¹ *
        ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) (ξ / (2 * π))‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      rw [hconv ξ, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), mul_pow, inv_pow,
        Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ,
        φ η = ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) η‖ ^ 2 /
          (4 * π ^ 2 * η ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have L1 : ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 =
        ∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * π)⁻¹ * φ ((2 * π)⁻¹ * ξ) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hae q] with ξ hξ
      rw [hξ, hprof, hconvn, hφ, show (2 * π)⁻¹ * ξ = ξ / (2 * π) from inv_mul_eq_div _ _]
      generalize ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) (ξ / (2 * π))‖ = A
      have h4 : (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h5 : ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hπ : π ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
      have e : 4 * π ^ 2 * (ξ / (2 * π)) ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [e]
      field_simp
    have L2 : ∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * π)⁻¹ * φ ((2 * π)⁻¹ * ξ) = ∫ η : ℝ, φ η := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left φ (2 * π)⁻¹, inv_inv,
        abs_of_pos (by positivity), smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]
    rw [L1, L2]
    congr 1
    funext η
    exact hφ η
  rw [hL, hP, hWeq]
  congr 1
  funext ξ
  exact hFGsq ξ

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hmem : MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hsmall : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 64) :
    (∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w) ∧
    (∀ w v : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → IsRiccatiSol κ q v → w = v) ∧
    (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → riccatiAlpha κ q = ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2) ∧
    49 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 81 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q

signature.name: riccati_fixed_point
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hmem : MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hsmall : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 64) :
    (∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w) ∧
    (∀ w v : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → IsRiccatiSol κ q v → w = v) ∧
    (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → riccatiAlpha κ q = ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2) ∧
    49 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 81 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ0 : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hsub, hcongr⟩ := riccatiK_sub_congr κ hκ0
  
  have huniq : ∀ w v : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → IsRiccatiSol κ q v → w = v := by
    intro w v hw hv
    obtain ⟨hwm, hw2, hwe⟩ := hw
    obtain ⟨hvm, hv2, hve⟩ := hv
    have hdiff : ∀ x, w x - v x = riccatiK κ (fun y => (v y - w y) * (v y + w y)) x := by
      intro x
      have h1 := hsub (fun y => v y ^ 2) (fun y => w y ^ 2) hvm.integrable_sq
        hwm.integrable_sq x
      beta_reduce at h1
      have h2 : (fun y => (v y - w y) * (v y + w y)) = (fun y => v y ^ 2 - w y ^ 2) := by
        funext y; ring
      rw [h2, h1]
      linarith [hwe x, hve x]
    obtain ⟨-, hK⟩ := riccatiK_mul_bound κ hκ (fun y => v y - w y) (fun y => v y + w y)
      (hvm.sub hwm) (hvm.add hwm)
    have hE : ∫ x, riccatiK κ (fun y => (v y - w y) * (v y + w y)) x ^ 2 =
        ∫ x, (w x - v x) ^ 2 := by
      congr 1; funext x; rw [hdiff x]
    have hg2 : ∫ y, (v y - w y) ^ 2 = ∫ x, (w x - v x) ^ 2 := by
      congr 1; funext y; ring
    have hH : ∫ y, (v y + w y) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have hint1 : Integrable (fun y => (v y + w y) ^ 2) volume := (hvm.add hwm).integrable_sq
      have hint2 : Integrable (fun y => 2 * v y ^ 2 + 2 * w y ^ 2) volume :=
        (hvm.integrable_sq.const_mul 2).add (hwm.integrable_sq.const_mul 2)
      have hmono : ∫ y, (v y + w y) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ y, (2 * v y ^ 2 + 2 * w y ^ 2) :=
        integral_mono hint1 hint2 (fun y => by
          show (v y + w y) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * v y ^ 2 + 2 * w y ^ 2
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v y - w y)])
      rw [integral_add (hvm.integrable_sq.const_mul 2) (hwm.integrable_sq.const_mul 2),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hmono
      linarith
    rw [hE, hg2] at hK
    have hE0nn : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (w x - v x) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
    have hHnn : 0 ≤ ∫ y, (v y + w y) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
    have hE0le : ∫ x, (w x - v x) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hE0nn (sub_nonneg.2 hH)]
    have hE0z : ∫ x, (w x - v x) ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm hE0le hE0nn
    have hnn : (0 : ℝ → ℝ) ≤ fun x => (w x - v x) ^ 2 := fun x => sq_nonneg _
    have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnn (hwm.sub hvm).integrable_sq).1 hE0z
    have hwv : w =ᵐ[volume] v := by
      filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
      have h3 : (w x - v x) ^ 2 = 0 := hx
      exact sub_eq_zero.1 (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1 h3)
    have hsq : (fun y => w y ^ 2) =ᵐ[volume] (fun y => v y ^ 2) := by
      filter_upwards [hwv] with y hy
      rw [hy]
    funext x
    linarith [hwe x, hve x, hcongr _ _ hsq x]
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwm, hw2, hwe⟩ := riccati_exists_small κ hκ (riccatiK κ q) hmem hsmall
  have hw0 : IsRiccatiSol κ q w := ⟨hwm, hw2, hwe⟩
  
  have halpha : ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → riccatiAlpha κ q = ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2 := by
    intro w hw
    have h : ∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w := ⟨w, hw⟩
    unfold riccatiAlpha
    rw [dif_pos h, huniq _ _ (Classical.choose_spec h) hw]
  
  have hsqf : (fun y => w y ^ 2) = (fun y => w y * w y) := by funext y; ring
  have hbounds : 49 / 64 * (∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ∧
      ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 81 / 64 * ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨hd, hd2⟩ := riccatiK_mul_bound κ hκ w w hwm hwm

    by_cases h : ∃ ws : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ (u s) ws ∧ riccatiAlpha κ (u s) = ∫ x : ℝ, ws x ^ 2

      riccatiAlpha κ (u s) = ∫ x : ℝ, W s x ^ 2 := hsol.mono fun s hs => hWs s hs

  have hNw0 : 0 ≤ Nw := by rw [hNw]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

    rw [← hNz, ← hsc] at e8

    rw [← ha, ← hd] at e8
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := by rw [hd]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hsc0 : 0 ≤ sc s := by rw [hsc]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
