    · refine ⟨2 * ((Cq + κ' ^ 2) * CG) + 2 * (((Cw + κ') * (Cw + κ')) * CG) + 2 * (Cw + κ'),
        fun x => ?_⟩
      have h1 := pb _ _ _ _ (hqk x) (hCG x)
      have h2 := pb _ _ _ _ (pb _ _ _ _ (haw x) (haw x)) (hCG x)
      have h3 := haw x
      exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [(abs_le.1 h1).1, (abs_le.1 h2).1, (abs_le.1 h3).1],
        by linarith [(abs_le.1 h1).2, (abs_le.1 h2).2, (abs_le.1 h3).2]⟩
  have hHc : Continuous H := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hH x).continuousAt
  have hH1c : Continuous H1 := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hH1d x).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hH1b
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hH2b
  
  have stend : ∀ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (⇑p) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (⇑p) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    intro p
    have h : Filter.Tendsto (⇑p) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) := p.toZeroAtInfty.zero_at_infty'
    rw [cocompact_eq_atBot_atTop] at h
    exact ⟨h.mono_left le_sup_right, h.mono_left le_sup_left⟩
  have hdC : ∀ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), deriv (⇑p) = ⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ p) :=
    fun p => funext fun x => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ p x).symm
  have sabs : ∀ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, |p x| ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 p := fun p x => by
    have h := SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ p x
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  have sbd : ∀ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ‖p x‖ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 p :=
    fun p => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ p x
  have sint : ∀ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∫ x : ℝ, SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ p x = 0 := by
    intro p
    have hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (⇑p) (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ p x) x := by
      intro x
      have h := (p.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
      rwa [hdC p] at h
    have h := integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hd (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ p).integrable
      (stend p).2 (stend p).1
    simpa using h
  have pb : ∀ a b A B : ℝ, |a| ≤ A → |b| ≤ B → |a * b| ≤ A * B := fun a b A B ha hb => by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)
  have bz : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (l : Filter ℝ), (∀ x, |f x| ≤ C) →
      Filter.Tendsto g l (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l (nhds 0) := by
    intro f g C l hf hg
    refine squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => C * ‖g x‖) (fun x => ?_) ?_
    · rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hf x) (norm_nonneg _)
    · simpa using (hg.norm.const_mul C)
  have hbd : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ‖H x‖ ≤ CH :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hCH x
  have hbd1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ‖H1 x‖ ≤ C1 :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC1 x
  have hbdw : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ‖w x‖ ≤ Cw :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hCw x
  have hHqi : Integrable (fun x => H x * deriv (⇑q) x) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    rw [hdq]
    exact Integrable.bdd_mul (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ q).integrable
      hHc.aestronglyMeasurable hbd
  
  have adj : ∀ ζ h : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, HasDerivAt ζ (2 * κ' * ζ x + h x - 2 * w x * ζ x) x) →
      Integrable (fun x => w x * ζ x) (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      Integrable (fun x => H x * h x) (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      Filter.Tendsto ζ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto ζ Filter.atBot (nhds 0) →
      ∫ x : ℝ, w x * ζ x = -κ' * ∫ x : ℝ, H x * h x := by
    intro ζ h hζ hwζ hHh htop hbot
    have hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x => H x * ζ x) (w x * ζ x / κ' + H x * h x) x := by
      intro x
      have h' := (hH x).mul (hζ x)
      convert h' using 1
      rw [hH1 x]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hint : Integrable (fun x => w x * ζ x / κ' + H x * h x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      (hwζ.div_const κ').add hHh
    have h0 := integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hd hint (bz H ζ CH _ hCH hbot)
      (bz H ζ CH _ hCH htop)
    rw [integral_add (hwζ.div_const κ') hHh, integral_div, sub_self] at h0
    have hA : (∫ x : ℝ, w x * ζ x) = κ' * ((∫ x : ℝ, w x * ζ x) / κ') := by field_simp
    have hB : (∫ x : ℝ, w x * ζ x) / κ' = -(∫ x : ℝ, H x * h x) := by linarith
    rw [hA, hB]
    ring
  
  have hHq : ∫ x : ℝ, H x * deriv (⇑q) x = 0 := by
    have hζd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => q y + 2 * κ' * w y - w y * w y)
        (2 * κ' * (q x + 2 * κ' * w x - w x * w x) + deriv (⇑q) x
          - 2 * w x * (q x + 2 * κ' * w x - w x * w x)) x := by
      intro x
      have h' := ((hqd x).add ((hwd x).const_mul (2 * κ'))).sub ((hwd x).mul (hwd x))
      convert h' using 1
      ring
    have hwq : Integrable (fun x => w x * q x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul q.integrable hwc.aestronglyMeasurable hbdw
    have hww : Integrable (fun x => w x ^ 2) (volume : Measure ℝ) := hw.1.integrable_sq
    have hwww : Integrable (fun x => w x * w x ^ 2) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul hww hwc.aestronglyMeasurable hbdw
    have hwζ : Integrable (fun x => w x * (q x + 2 * κ' * w x - w x * w x))
        (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      have e : (fun x => w x * (q x + 2 * κ' * w x - w x * w x)) =
          fun x => w x * q x + 2 * κ' * w x ^ 2 - w x * w x ^ 2 := funext fun x => by ring
      rw [e]
      exact (hwq.add (hww.const_mul _)).sub hwww
    have hζtop : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => q y + 2 * κ' * w y - w y * w y) Filter.atTop
        (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using ((stend q).1.add (hwtop.const_mul (2 * κ'))).sub (hwtop.mul hwtop)
    have hζbot : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => q y + 2 * κ' * w y - w y * w y) Filter.atBot
        (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using ((stend q).2.add (hwbot.const_mul (2 * κ'))).sub (hwbot.mul hwbot)
    have hadj := adj _ (deriv (⇑q)) hζd hwζ hHqi hζtop hζbot
    have hw0 : ∫ x : ℝ, w x * (q x + 2 * κ' * w x - w x * w x) = 0 := by
      have hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => w y * w y / 2)
          (w x * (q x + 2 * κ' * w x - w x * w x)) x := by
        intro x
        have h' := ((hwd x).mul (hwd x)).div_const 2
        convert h' using 1
        ring
      have htop : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => w y * w y / 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (hwtop.mul hwtop).div_const 2
      have hbot : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => w y * w y / 2) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (hwbot.mul hwbot).div_const 2
      have h' := integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hd hwζ hbot htop
      simpa using h'
    rw [hw0] at hadj
    have hm : κ' * ∫ x : ℝ, H x * deriv (⇑q) x = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hm with h' | h'
    · exact absurd h' hK0.ne'
    · exact h'
  
  have orth : ∀ γ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), GreenODE κ q γ → ∫ x : ℝ, H x * deriv (⇑γ) x = 0 := by
    intro γ hγ
    
    have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 (⇑γ) x =
        deriv (⇑q) x / κ + 2 * deriv (⇑q) x * γ x + 4 * q x * deriv (⇑γ) x +
          4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (⇑γ) x := by
      intro x
      have h := hγ x
      have e1 : iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ y) x = iteratedDeriv 3 (⇑γ) x :=
        iteratedDeriv_const_add (by norm_num) _
      have e2 : deriv (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ y) x = deriv (⇑γ) x := deriv_const_add _
      have e3 : deriv (fun y => q y * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y)) x =
          deriv (⇑q) x * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ x) + q x * deriv (⇑γ) x :=
        ((q.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt.mul
          ((γ.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt.const_add _)).deriv
      rw [e1, e2, e3] at h
      rw [h]
      field_simp
      ring
    obtain ⟨q1, hq1def⟩ : ∃ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), p = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g1, hg1def⟩ : ∃ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), p = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g2, hg2def⟩ : ∃ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), p = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g3, hg3def⟩ : ∃ p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), p = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hq1 : deriv (⇑q) = ⇑q1 := by rw [hq1def]; exact hdC q
    have hg1 : deriv (⇑γ) = ⇑g1 := by rw [hg1def]; exact hdC γ
    have hg2 : deriv (⇑g1) = ⇑g2 := by rw [hg2def]; exact hdC g1
    have hg3 : deriv (⇑g2) = ⇑g3 := by rw [hg3def]; exact hdC g2
    have dq : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (⇑q) (q1 x) x := fun x => by
      rw [← hq1]; exact (q.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have dγ : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (⇑γ) (g1 x) x := fun x => by
      rw [← hg1]; exact (γ.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have dg1 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (⇑g1) (g2 x) x := fun x => by
      rw [← hg2]; exact (g1.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have dg2 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (⇑g2) (g3 x) x := fun x => by
      rw [← hg3]; exact (g2.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have h3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (⇑γ) = ⇑g3 := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hg1, hg2, hg3]
    have hq0 : ∫ x : ℝ, q1 x = 0 := by rw [hq1def]; exact sint q
    have hg0 : ∫ x : ℝ, g1 x = 0 := by rw [hg1def]; exact sint γ
    have hI3 : ∫ x : ℝ, g3 x = 0 := by rw [hg3def]; exact sint g2
    
    have hA1 : Integrable (fun x => γ x * q1 x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul q1.integrable γ.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (sbd γ)
    have hA2 : Integrable (fun x => q x * g1 x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul g1.integrable q.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (sbd q)
    have hprod : ∫ x : ℝ, (γ x * q1 x + q x * g1 x) = 0 := by
      have hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => q y * γ y) (γ x * q1 x + q x * g1 x) x := by
        intro x
        have h := (dq x).mul (dγ x)
        convert h using 1
        ring
      have htop : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => q y * γ y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (stend q).1.mul (stend γ).1
      have hbot : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => q y * γ y) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (stend q).2.mul (stend γ).2
      have h := integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hd (hA1.add hA2) hbot htop
      simpa using h
    have hdia : ∀ x, g3 x = q1 x / κ + 2 * (γ x * q1 x) + 4 * (q x * g1 x) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * g1 x := by
      intro x
      have h := hpt x
      rw [h3, hq1, hg1] at h
      rw [h]
      ring
    have i3 : Integrable (fun x => q1 x / κ) (volume : Measure ℝ) := q1.integrable.div_const κ
    have i5 : Integrable (fun x => 2 * (γ x * q1 x)) (volume : Measure ℝ) := hA1.const_mul _
    have i6 : Integrable (fun x => 4 * (q x * g1 x)) (volume : Measure ℝ) := hA2.const_mul _
    have i4 : Integrable (fun x => 4 * κ ^ 2 * g1 x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      g1.integrable.const_mul _
    have i35 : Integrable (fun x => q1 x / κ + 2 * (γ x * q1 x)) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      i3.add i5
    have i356 : Integrable (fun x => q1 x / κ + 2 * (γ x * q1 x) + 4 * (q x * g1 x))
        (volume : Measure ℝ) := i35.add i6
    have hfun : (fun x => g3 x) = fun x =>
        q1 x / κ + 2 * (γ x * q1 x) + 4 * (q x * g1 x) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * g1 x := funext hdia
    have hI3' : ∫ x : ℝ, (q1 x / κ + 2 * (γ x * q1 x) + 4 * (q x * g1 x) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * g1 x)
        = 0 := by rw [← hfun]; exact hI3
    rw [integral_add i356 i4, integral_add i35 i6, integral_add i3 i5, integral_div,
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hq0, hg0] at hI3'
    rw [integral_add hA1 hA2] at hprod
    simp only [zero_div, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at hI3'
    have hγq : ∫ x : ℝ, γ x * q1 x = 0 := by linarith
    
    have hH2d' : ∀ x, HasDerivAt H2
        (2 * q1 x * H x + q1 x / κ' + 4 * q x * H1 x + 4 * κ' ^ 2 * H1 x) x := by
      intro x
      have h := hH2d x
      rw [hq1] at h
      exact h
    have hΦd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => H y * g2 y - H1 y * g1 y + H2 y * γ y
        - 4 * q y * H y * γ y - 4 * κ ^ 2 * H y * γ y)
        (H x * q1 x / κ + γ x * q1 x / κ' + 4 * (κ' ^ 2 - κ ^ 2) * (H1 x * γ x)) x := by
      intro x
      have h := (((((hH x).mul (dg2 x)).sub ((hH1d x).mul (dg1 x))).add
        ((hH2d' x).mul (dγ x))).sub ((((dq x).const_mul 4).mul (hH x)).mul (dγ x))).sub
        ((((hH x).const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2))).mul (dγ x))
      convert h using 1
      try simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      rw [hdia x]
      field_simp
      ring
    have ia : Integrable (fun x => H x * q1 x / κ) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      (Integrable.bdd_mul q1.integrable hHc.aestronglyMeasurable hbd).div_const κ
    have ib : Integrable (fun x => γ x * q1 x / κ') (volume : Measure ℝ) := hA1.div_const κ'
    have ic0 : Integrable (fun x => H1 x * γ x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul γ.integrable hH1c.aestronglyMeasurable hbd1
    have ic : Integrable (fun x => 4 * (κ' ^ 2 - κ ^ 2) * (H1 x * γ x)) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      ic0.const_mul _
    have iab : Integrable (fun x => H x * q1 x / κ + γ x * q1 x / κ') (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      ia.add ib
    have hb4 : ∀ x, |4 * q x * H x| ≤ 4 * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q * CH := fun x =>
      pb _ _ _ _ (by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)]; linarith [sabs q x])
        (hCH x)
    have hb5 : ∀ x, |4 * κ ^ 2 * H x| ≤ 4 * κ ^ 2 * CH := fun x =>
      pb _ _ _ _ (abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)).le (hCH x)
    have hΦtop : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => H y * g2 y - H1 y * g1 y + H2 y * γ y
        - 4 * q y * H y * γ y - 4 * κ ^ 2 * H y * γ y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have t1 := bz H g2 CH _ hCH (stend g2).1
      have t2 := bz H1 g1 C1 _ hC1 (stend g1).1
      have t3 := bz H2 γ C2 _ hC2 (stend γ).1
      have t4 := bz (fun y => 4 * q y * H y) γ _ _ hb4 (stend γ).1
      have t5 := bz (fun y => 4 * κ ^ 2 * H y) γ _ _ hb5 (stend γ).1
      simpa using (((t1.sub t2).add t3).sub t4).sub t5
    have hΦbot : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => H y * g2 y - H1 y * g1 y + H2 y * γ y
        - 4 * q y * H y * γ y - 4 * κ ^ 2 * H y * γ y) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
      have t1 := bz H g2 CH _ hCH (stend g2).2
      have t2 := bz H1 g1 C1 _ hC1 (stend g1).2
      have t3 := bz H2 γ C2 _ hC2 (stend γ).2
      have t4 := bz (fun y => 4 * q y * H y) γ _ _ hb4 (stend γ).2
      have t5 := bz (fun y => 4 * κ ^ 2 * H y) γ _ _ hb5 (stend γ).2
      simpa using (((t1.sub t2).add t3).sub t4).sub t5
    have hW := integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hΦd (iab.add ic) hΦbot hΦtop
    have hHq' : ∫ x : ℝ, H x * q1 x = 0 := by rw [← hq1]; exact hHq
    rw [integral_add iab ic, integral_add ia ib, integral_div, integral_div, integral_const_mul,
      hHq', hγq, sub_self] at hW
    simp only [zero_div, zero_add] at hW
    have hne2 : 4 * (κ' ^ 2 - κ ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      have e : κ' ^ 2 - κ ^ 2 = (κ' - κ) * (κ' + κ) := by ring
      rw [e]
      exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.2 hne) (by linarith))
    have hH1γ : ∫ x : ℝ, H1 x * γ x = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.1 hW).resolve_left hne2
    have iHg : Integrable (fun x => H x * g1 x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul g1.integrable hHc.aestronglyMeasurable hbd
    have hd2 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => H y * γ y) (H1 x * γ x + H x * g1 x) x :=
      fun x => (hH x).mul (dγ x)
    have hfin := integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hd2 (ic0.add iHg)
      (bz H γ CH _ hCH (stend γ).2) (bz H γ CH _ hCH (stend γ).1)
    rw [integral_add ic0 iHg, hH1γ, zero_add, sub_self] at hfin
    rw [hg1]
    exact hfin
  have hHg : ∫ x : ℝ, H x * deriv (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) x = 0 := by
    by_cases hex : ∃ γ₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), GreenODE κ q γ₀
    · have hγ : GreenODE κ q (greenOffset κ q) := by
        unfold greenOffset
        rw [dif_pos hex]
        exact Classical.choose_spec hex
      exact orth _ hγ
    · have h0 : greenOffset κ q = 0 := by
        unfold greenOffset
        rw [dif_neg hex]
      rw [h0]
      simp
  
  have hHint : Integrable (fun x => H x * hkRHS κ q x) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
    Integrable.bdd_mul hfi hHc.aestronglyMeasurable hbd
  have hHgi : Integrable (fun x => H x * deriv (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) x) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    rw [hdγ]
    exact Integrable.bdd_mul (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (greenOffset κ q)).integrable
      hHc.aestronglyMeasurable hbd
  have hHf : ∫ x : ℝ, H x * hkRHS κ q x = 0 := by
    have hpt : (fun x => H x * hkRHS κ q x) = fun x =>
        16 * κ ^ 5 * (H x * deriv (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) x) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * (H x * deriv (⇑q) x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hf_eq]
      ring
    rw [hpt, integral_add (hHgi.const_mul _) (hHqi.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul, hHg, hHq]
    ring
  
  have hwz : Integrable (fun x => w x * z x) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    have h := hw.1.integrable_mul hz2
    exact h
  have hadj := adj z (hkRHS κ q) hzd hwz hHint hztop hzbot
  rw [hadj, hHf, mul_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_sol_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw : IsRiccatiSol κ q w) :
    Continuous w ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_response_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (f w z : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfi : Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hwc : Continuous w) (hw2 : MemLp w 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hz2 : MemLp z 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hz : ∀ x : ℝ, z x = riccatiK κ f x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x) :

by
  have hκ0 : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by linarith
  
  have CS : ∀ (μ : Measure ℝ) (u v : ℝ → ℝ), MemLp u 2 μ → MemLp v 2 μ →
      (∫ a, u a * v a ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ a, u a ^ 2 ∂μ) * (∫ a, v a ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    intro μ u v hu hv
    have hA := hu.integrable_sq
    have hB := hv.integrable_sq
    have hC : Integrable (fun a => u a * v a) μ := hu.integrable_mul hv
    have key : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (∫ a, u a ^ 2 ∂μ) * (t * t) + (2 * ∫ a, u a * v a ∂μ) * t +
        ∫ a, v a ^ 2 ∂μ := by
      intro t
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∫ a, (t * u a + v a) ^ 2 ∂μ := integral_nonneg (fun a => sq_nonneg _)
      have heq : (fun a => (t * u a + v a) ^ 2) =
          fun a => (t * t) * u a ^ 2 + ((2 * t) * (u a * v a) + v a ^ 2) := by
        funext a; ring
      have i1 : Integrable (fun a => (t * t) * u a ^ 2) μ := hA.const_mul _
      have i2 : Integrable (fun a => (2 * t) * (u a * v a)) μ := hC.const_mul _
      have i23 : Integrable (fun a => (2 * t) * (u a * v a) + v a ^ 2) μ := i2.add hB
      rw [heq, integral_add i1 i23, integral_add i2 hB, integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul] at h0
      nlinarith
    have hd := discrim_le_zero key
    unfold discrim at hd
    nlinarith
  
  have hS : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≤ p.2} := measurableSet_le measurable_fst measurable_snd
  have hident : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      ∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (c * (x - y)) * φ y =
        ∫ y, ({p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≤ p.2}.indicator
          (fun p => Real.exp (c * (p.1 - p.2)) * φ p.2)) (x, y) := by
    intro c φ x
    rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ici]
    congr 1
  have hFmeas : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable φ volume →
      AEStronglyMeasurable ({p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≤ p.2}.indicator
        (fun p => Real.exp (c * (p.1 - p.2)) * φ p.2)) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod volume) := by

    refine AEStronglyMeasurable.indicator ?_ hS
    have h1 : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp (c * (p.1 - p.2)) := by fun_prop
    exact h1.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hφ.comp_snd

    have h1 := (hFmeas (2 * κ) (fun y => g y * h y) (hg.1.mul hh.1)).integral_prod_right'
    have h2 : riccatiK κ (fun y => g y * h y) = fun x => -∫ y, ({p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≤ p.2}.indicator
          (fun p => Real.exp (2 * κ * (p.1 - p.2)) * (g p.2 * h p.2))) (x, y) := by

      unfold riccatiK
      rw [hident (2 * κ) (fun y => g y * h y) x]
    rw [h2]
    exact h1.neg

      · have hc : Continuous fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) := by fun_prop
        exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hh.1.restrict
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ici (fun y hy => ?_)
        have hy' : x ≤ y := hy
        have hle : Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by nlinarith)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hle
    have hcs := CS _ g (fun y => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * h y) (hg.restrict _) hv
    have e1 : riccatiK κ (fun y => g y * h y) x ^ 2 =
        (∫ y in Set.Ici x, g y * (Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * h y)) ^ 2 := by

        funext y; ring
      show (-∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * (g y * h y)) ^ 2 = _

      funext y

    rw [hF]
    exact hFmeas (4 * κ) (fun y => h y ^ 2) (hh.1.pow 2)
  have hslice_pt : ∀ x y : ℝ, F (x, y) = (Set.Iic y).indicator

    intro x y
    rw [hF]
    by_cases hxy : x ≤ y

      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_mem h2]

    · have h1 : (x, y) ∉ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≤ p.2} := hxy
      have h2 : x ∉ Set.Iic y := hxy
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
  have hslice_int : ∀ y : ℝ, Integrable (fun x => F (x, y)) volume := by

    have hon : IntegrableOn

  have hslice_val : ∀ y : ℝ, ∫ x, F (x, y) = 1 / (4 * κ) * h y ^ 2 := by
    intro y

      Real.exp_neg]
    field_simp

    rw [integrable_prod_iff' hFm]
    refine ⟨Filter.Eventually.of_forall hslice_int, ?_⟩
    have he : (fun y => ∫ x, ‖F (x, y)‖) = fun y => 1 / (4 * κ) * h y ^ 2 := by
      funext y
      have hn : (fun x => ‖F (x, y)‖) = fun x => F (x, y) :=
        funext fun x => Real.norm_of_nonneg (hFnn _)

    rw [he]
    exact hh.integrable_sq.const_mul _
  have hHeq : (fun x => ∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (4 * κ * (x - y)) * h y ^ 2) =
      fun x => ∫ y, F (x, y) := by
    funext x
    rw [hident (4 * κ) (fun y => h y ^ 2) x, hF]
  have hHint : Integrable (fun x => ∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (4 * κ * (x - y)) * h y ^ 2)
      volume := by
    rw [hHeq]
    exact hFint.integral_prod_left
  have hHval : ∫ x, (∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (4 * κ * (x - y)) * h y ^ 2) =
      1 / (4 * κ) * ∫ y, h y ^ 2 := by
    rw [hHeq, ← integral_prod F hFint, integral_prod_symm F hFint]
    simp_rw [hslice_val]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
  
  have hG : 0 ≤ ∫ y, g y ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun y => sq_nonneg _)
  have hHh : 0 ≤ ∫ y, h y ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun y => sq_nonneg _)

      ((continuous_pow 2).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hmeas) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]

  rw [integral_const_mul, hHval] at hmono
  have hk : 1 / (4 * κ) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h4κ (by norm_num)]
    linarith
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk (mul_nonneg hG hHh)

by

    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    congr 1

    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have normsq_toLp : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)),

    rw [hx]

      ‖hf.toLp f - hg.toLp g‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ, (f x - g x) ^ 2 := by
    intro f g hf hg
    rw [← MemLp.toLp_sub hf hg, normsq_toLp _ (hf.sub hg)]
    rfl
  have sq_le_of : ∀ n m : ℝ, 0 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m → n ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 → n ≤ m := by
    intro n m hn hm h
    nlinarith
  
  have hK : ∀ W : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => (W : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧

    have hb := riccatiK_mul_bound κ hκ _ _ (Lp.memLp W) (Lp.memLp W)
    rw [← e, ← normsq W] at hb
    exact hb

        riccatiK κ (fun y => (V : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2) x =
        riccatiK κ (fun y => ((W : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V : ℝ → ℝ) y) *

      intro x

      congr 1
      funext y
      ring
    have hb := riccatiK_mul_bound κ hκ (fun y => (W : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V : ℝ → ℝ) y)

    have e1 : (∫ y : ℝ, ((W : ℝ → ℝ) y - (V : ℝ → ℝ) y) ^ 2) = ‖W - V‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [normsq]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub W V] with y hy
      rw [hy, Pi.sub_apply]
    have e2 : (∫ y : ℝ, ((W : ℝ → ℝ) y + (V : ℝ → ℝ) y) ^ 2) = ‖W + V‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [normsq]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add W V] with y hy
      rw [hy, Pi.add_apply]
    rw [e1, e2] at hb
    have e3 : (fun x => (riccatiK κ (fun y => (W : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2) x -
          riccatiK κ (fun y => (V : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2) x) ^ 2) =

    rw [e3]

  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),

informal_problem.statement:

    Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, ((s - t)⁻¹ * (u s x - u t x) - v x) ^ 2)

signature.name: schwartz_curve_L2_deriv
signature.statement:
(u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ)
    (hu : HasDerivAt u v t) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, (u s x - u t x) ^ 2) (nhds t) (nhds 0) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, ((s - t)⁻¹ * (u s x - u t x) - v x) ^ 2)
      (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hbound : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2 ≤
      Real.pi * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f ^ 2 + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 1 0 f ^ 2) := by
    intro f
    set A := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f with hAdef
    set B := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 1 0 f with hBdef
    have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2 ≤ (A ^ 2 + B ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro x
      have h1 : ‖f x‖ ≤ A := SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ f x
      have h2 : |x| ^ 1 * ‖iteratedDeriv 0 (⇑f) x‖ ≤ B := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 1 0 f x
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, pow_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h2
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      have h1' : |f x| ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
      have h2' : (|x| * |f x|) ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h2 2
      have hid : (1 + x ^ 2) * f x ^ 2 = |f x| ^ 2 + (|x| * |f x|) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs]; ring
      have hpos : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      rw [le_mul_inv_iff₀ hpos]
      nlinarith
    calc ∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, (A ^ 2 + B ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => sq_nonneg _)
            (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul _) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
      _ = Real.pi * (A ^ 2 + B ^ 2) := by
          rw [integral_const_mul, integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq, mul_comm]
  
  have hsq : ∀ {α : Type} (l : Filter α) (F : α → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Filter.Tendsto F l (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun a => ∫ x : ℝ, F a x ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
    intro α l F hF
    have hc : ∀ k n : ℕ,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun a => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (F a)) l (nhds 0) := by
      intro k n
      have h : Filter.Tendsto (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n) (nhds 0)
          (nhds (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n 0)) :=
        ((schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (k, n)).tendsto 0
      rw [map_zero] at h
      exact h.comp hF
    have hg := (((hc 0 0).pow 2).add ((hc 1 0).pow 2)).const_mul Real.pi
    simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, add_zero,
      mul_zero] at hg
    exact squeeze_zero (fun a => integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _)
      (fun a => hbound (F a)) hg
  
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - t)⁻¹ • (u s - u t - (s - t) • v))
      (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
    have := (HasFDerivAtFilter.isLittleOTVS hu.hasFDerivAt).tendsto_inv_smul
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] using this
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => u s - u t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s - t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.2 Filter.tendsto_id
    have h5 := h3.smul h2
    rw [zero_smul] at h5
    have h6 := h3.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := v))
    rw [zero_smul] at h6
    have h7 := h5.add h6
    rw [add_zero] at h7
    refine h7.congr (fun s => ?_)
    by_cases hs : s = t
    · subst hs; simp
    · rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hs), sub_add_cancel]
  have hB : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - t)⁻¹ • (u s - u t) - v)
      (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds 0) := by
    refine (h2.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    rw [smul_sub, inv_smul_smul₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hs)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hsq _ _ hA
    simpa only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply] using this
  · have := hsq _ _ hB
    simpa only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw2 : MemLp w 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hw : ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 16)
    (hg : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp z 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, z x = g x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x

signature.name: riccati_linear_solve
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw2 : MemLp w 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hw : ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 16)
    (hg : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp z 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, z x = g x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
  
  have hnormF : ∀ F : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      ‖F‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ, (F : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 := by
    intro F
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnormf : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)),
      ‖MemLp.toLp f hf‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2 := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hnormF]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [MemLp.coeFn_toLp hf] with x hx
    rw [hx]
  
  have hm : MemLp (fun y => 2 * w y) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := hw2.const_mul 2
  have hmsq : (∫ y : ℝ, (2 * w y) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have hA : (∫ y : ℝ, (2 * w y) ^ 2) = 4 * ∫ y : ℝ, w y ^ 2 := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext y
      ring
    rw [hA]
    linarith
  have hmsq0 : 0 ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, (2 * w y) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun y => sq_nonneg _
  have hdiff : ∀ Z₁ Z₂ : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp Z₁ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp Z₂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₁ y)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      ∫ x : ℝ, (riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₁ y) x -
          riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₂ y) x) ^ 2 ≤
        1 / 16 * ∫ x : ℝ, (Z₁ x - Z₂ x) ^ 2 := by
    intro Z₁ Z₂ h₁ h₂
    have hK1 : MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₁ y)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      (riccatiK_mul_bound κ hκ (fun y => 2 * w y) Z₁ hm h₁).1
    refine ⟨hK1, ?_⟩
    have hi₁ : Integrable (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₁ y) (volume : Measure ℝ) := hm.integrable_mul h₁
    have hi₂ : Integrable (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₂ y) (volume : Measure ℝ) := hm.integrable_mul h₂
    have hpt : ∀ x, riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₁ y) x -
        riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₂ y) x =
        riccatiK κ (fun y => (2 * w y) * (Z₁ y - Z₂ y)) x := by
      intro x
      rw [← (riccatiK_sub_congr κ hκ0).1 _ _ hi₁ hi₂ x]
      congr 1
      funext y
      ring
    have hD : MemLp (fun y => Z₁ y - Z₂ y) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := h₁.sub h₂
    have hb : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => (2 * w y) * (Z₁ y - Z₂ y)) x ^ 2 ≤
        1 / 4 * ((∫ y : ℝ, (2 * w y) ^ 2) * (∫ y : ℝ, (Z₁ y - Z₂ y) ^ 2)) :=
      (riccatiK_mul_bound κ hκ (fun y => 2 * w y) (fun y => Z₁ y - Z₂ y) hm hD).2
    have hB : 0 ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, (Z₁ y - Z₂ y) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun y => sq_nonneg _
    have heq : (∫ x : ℝ, (riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₁ y) x -
          riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * Z₂ y) x) ^ 2) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => (2 * w y) * (Z₁ y - Z₂ y)) x ^ 2 := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [hpt x]
    rw [heq]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmsq hB
    nlinarith
  
  have hψ : ∀ Z : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), MemLp
      (fun x => g x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * (Z : ℝ → ℝ) y) x) 2
      (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
    fun Z => hg.sub (hdiff Z Z (Lp.memLp Z) (Lp.memLp Z)).1
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      ∀ Z, T Z = MemLp.toLp _ (hψ Z) := ⟨fun Z => MemLp.toLp _ (hψ Z), fun Z => rfl⟩
  have hlip : ∀ Z₁ Z₂ : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      dist (T Z₁) (T Z₂) ≤ ((1 / 4 : NNReal) : ℝ) * dist Z₁ Z₂ := by
    intro Z₁ Z₂
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 : T Z₁ - T Z₂ = MemLp.toLp _ ((hψ Z₁).sub (hψ Z₂)) := by
      rw [hTdef, hTdef]
      exact (MemLp.toLp_sub (hψ Z₁) (hψ Z₂)).symm
    have e := (hdiff Z₁ Z₂ (Lp.memLp Z₁) (Lp.memLp Z₂)).2
    have e2 : (∫ x : ℝ, ((Z₁ : ℝ → ℝ) x - (Z₂ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((Z₁ - Z₂ : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub Z₁ Z₂] with x hx
      rw [hx]
      rfl
    have h2 : ‖T Z₁ - T Z₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 16 * ‖Z₁ - Z₂‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [h1, hnormf, hnormF, ← e2]
      refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) e
      congr 1
      funext x
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    have h3 : (1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖Z₁ - Z₂‖ ^ 2 = (1 / 4 * ‖Z₁ - Z₂‖) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h3] at h2
    have h4 := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h2 (by positivity)
    have hc : ((1 / 4 : NNReal) : ℝ) = 1 / 4 := by norm_num
    rw [hc]
    linarith [h4.2]
  have hT : ContractingWith (1 / 4 : NNReal) T := by
    refine ⟨?_, LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul hlip⟩
    rw [← NNReal.coe_lt_coe]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨Zs, hfix⟩ : ∃ Zs : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), T Zs = Zs :=
    ⟨_, ContractingWith.fixedPoint_isFixedPt hT⟩
  
  obtain ⟨z, hzdef⟩ : ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ,
      z = fun x => g x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * (Zs : ℝ → ℝ) y) x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hz2 : MemLp z 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    rw [hzdef]
    exact hψ Zs
  have hae : (Zs : ℝ → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] z := by
    have h := MemLp.coeFn_toLp (hψ Zs)
    rw [← hTdef, hfix] at h
    rw [hzdef]
    exact h
  have hK : ∀ x, riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x =
      riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * (Zs : ℝ → ℝ) y) x :=
    (riccatiK_sub_congr κ hκ0).2 _ _ (hae.mono fun y hy => by
      show 2 * w y * z y = 2 * w y * (Zs : ℝ → ℝ) y
      rw [hy])
  refine ⟨z, hz2, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [hK x, hzdef]

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sub_congr
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ) → Integrable g (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => f y - g y) x = riccatiK κ f x - riccatiK κ g x) ∧
    (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, f =ᵐ[(volume : Measure ℝ)] g → ∀ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ f x = riccatiK κ g x)

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_mul_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (g h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hh : MemLp h 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => g y * h y)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => g y * h y) x ^ 2 ≤
      1 / 4 * ((∫ y : ℝ, g y ^ 2) * (∫ y : ℝ, h y ^ 2))

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h₁ : IsRiccatiSol κ q₁ w₁) (h₂ : IsRiccatiSol κ q₂ w₂) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 ≤ 4 / 9 * ∫ x : ℝ, (q₁ x - q₂ x) ^ 2

signature.name: riccati_sol_L2_lipschitz
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (h₁ : IsRiccatiSol κ q₁ w₁) (h₂ : IsRiccatiSol κ q₂ w₂) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 ≤ 4 / 9 * ∫ x : ℝ, (q₁ x - q₂ x) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ0 : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hm₁, hs₁, he₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨hm₂, hs₂, he₂⟩ := h₂
  obtain ⟨hsub, -⟩ := riccatiK_sub_congr κ hκ0
  
  have hdiff : ∀ x, w₁ x - w₂ x = riccatiK κ (fun y => q₁ y - q₂ y) x -
      riccatiK κ (fun y => (w₁ y + w₂ y) * (w₁ y - w₂ y)) x := by
    intro x
    have hq := hsub (⇑q₁) (⇑q₂) (SchwartzMap.integrable q₁) (SchwartzMap.integrable q₂) x
    have hw := hsub (fun y => w₁ y ^ 2) (fun y => w₂ y ^ 2) hm₁.integrable_sq
      hm₂.integrable_sq x
    beta_reduce at hw
    have hfun : (fun y => (w₁ y + w₂ y) * (w₁ y - w₂ y)) = (fun y => w₁ y ^ 2 - w₂ y ^ 2) := by
      funext y; ring
    rw [hfun, hw, hq]
    linarith [he₁ x, he₂ x]
  
  have hdq : MemLp (fun y => q₁ y - q₂ y) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := (q₁.memLp 2).sub (q₂.memLp 2)
  have hp : MemLp (fun y => w₁ y + w₂ y) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := hm₁.add hm₂
  have he : MemLp (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := hm₁.sub hm₂
  obtain ⟨hK1, hK2⟩ := riccatiK_sqrt_bounds κ hκ
  obtain ⟨ha, hCs⟩ := hK1 _ hdq
  obtain ⟨hb, hDs⟩ := hK2 _ _ hp he
  generalize riccatiK κ (fun y => q₁ y - q₂ y) = a at ha hCs hdiff
  generalize riccatiK κ (fun y => (w₁ y + w₂ y) * (w₁ y - w₂ y)) = b at hb hDs hdiff
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (q₁ x - q₂ x) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, a x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, b x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hCle : ∫ x, a x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 * ∫ x, (q₁ x - q₂ x) ^ 2 := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hCs 2
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hC0, Real.sq_sqrt hB0] at h
    linarith
  have hDle : ∫ x, b x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 * ((∫ x, (w₁ x + w₂ x) ^ 2) * ∫ x, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2) := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hDs 2
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hD0, Real.sq_sqrt hP0, Real.sq_sqrt hA0] at h
    linarith
  
  have hP : ∫ y, (w₁ y + w₂ y) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have hint1 : Integrable (fun y => (w₁ y + w₂ y) ^ 2) volume := (hm₁.add hm₂).integrable_sq
    have hint2 : Integrable (fun y => 2 * w₁ y ^ 2 + 2 * w₂ y ^ 2) volume :=
      (hm₁.integrable_sq.const_mul 2).add (hm₂.integrable_sq.const_mul 2)
    have hmono : ∫ y, (w₁ y + w₂ y) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ y, (2 * w₁ y ^ 2 + 2 * w₂ y ^ 2) :=
      integral_mono hint1 hint2 (fun y => by
        show (w₁ y + w₂ y) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * w₁ y ^ 2 + 2 * w₂ y ^ 2
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w₁ y - w₂ y)])
    rw [integral_add (hm₁.integrable_sq.const_mul 2) (hm₂.integrable_sq.const_mul 2),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hmono
    linarith
  
  have hAeq : ∫ x, (w₁ x - w₂ x) ^ 2 = ∫ x, (a x - b x) ^ 2 := by
    congr 1; funext x; rw [hdiff x]
  have hia := ha.integrable_sq
  have hib := hb.integrable_sq
  have hmono : ∫ x, (a x - b x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x, (4 / 3 * a x ^ 2 + 4 * b x ^ 2) :=
    integral_mono (ha.sub hb).integrable_sq ((hia.const_mul (4 / 3)).add (hib.const_mul 4))
      (fun x => by
        show (a x - b x) ^ 2 ≤ 4 / 3 * a x ^ 2 + 4 * b x ^ 2
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a x + 3 * b x)])
  rw [integral_add (hia.const_mul (4 / 3)) (hib.const_mul 4), integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul, ← hAeq] at hmono
  
  have hPA := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP hA0
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sqrt_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) :
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp (riccatiK κ f) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ f x ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sq_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 =
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_fixed_point
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hmem : MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hsmall : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 64) :
    (∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w) ∧
    (∀ w v : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → IsRiccatiSol κ q v → w = v) ∧
    (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → riccatiAlpha κ q = ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2) ∧
    49 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 81 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_sol_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw : IsRiccatiSol κ q w) :
    Continuous w ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x

subgoal_signatures.name: schwartz_sq_pairing_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    |∫ x : ℝ, q x * h x ^ 2| ≤ ‖toHm1 q‖ *
      (2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (h x * deriv (h : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2)

      rw [integral_sub hIw (hIf.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul] at hftc
      simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul] at hftc
      unfold riccatiK
      rw [integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi, integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi]
      linarith

    have hnorm : ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x, riccatiK 1 w x ^ 2 := by
      rw [hweq, (Hm1_weight_basic (toHm1 w)).1]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨hKf, hKfb⟩ := (riccatiK_sqrt_bounds 1 le_rfl).1 (⇑f) (f.memLp 2)
    have hf0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, riccatiK 1 f x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
    have hKle : ∫ x, riccatiK 1 f x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 * ∫ x, f x ^ 2 := by
      have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hKfb 2
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hK0, Real.sq_sqrt hf0] at h
      linarith

      refine integral_mono hmw.integrable_sq

      intro x
      show riccatiK 1 w x ^ 2 ≤ 2 * f x ^ 2 + 8 * riccatiK 1 f x ^ 2

      rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul]
      exact integral_add ((f.memLp 2).integrable_sq.const_mul 2) (hKf.integrable_sq.const_mul 8)

      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hf0]
      linarith
    exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hsq (by positivity)).2
  
  have hw' : ∀ x : ℝ, w x = deriv (⇑(γ₁ - γ₂)) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hw x]
    have : ((γ₁ - γ₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => γ₁ y - γ₂ y := by
      funext y; simp
    rw [this]
    exact (deriv_sub γ₁.differentiableAt γ₂.differentiableAt).symm
  have hwn := hHm1d (γ₁ - γ₂) w hw'

    funext x; simp
  rw [hfun] at hwn

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sq_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 =
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_fixed_point
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hmem : MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hsmall : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 64) :
    (∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w) ∧
    (∀ w v : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → IsRiccatiSol κ q v → w = v) ∧
    (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → riccatiAlpha κ q = ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2) ∧
    49 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 81 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sub_congr
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ) → Integrable g (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => f y - g y) x = riccatiK κ f x - riccatiK κ g x) ∧
    (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, f =ᵐ[(volume : Measure ℝ)] g → ∀ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ f x = riccatiK κ g x)

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_sol_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw : IsRiccatiSol κ q w) :
    Continuous w ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sqrt_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) :
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp (riccatiK κ f) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ f x ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => f y * g y)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => f y * g y) x ^ 2) ≤
        1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2)))

by

    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hd, hd, hd]

          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)

            (‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) v x‖ := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_

          have e5 : 0 ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) v x‖ := norm_nonneg _
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 e3) e2 e5

    intro k i
    have := (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (k, i)
    simpa [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply] using this
  
  have JC : ∀ (l : Filter ℝ) (f g : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (f₀ g₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),

    have hf0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun a => f a - f₀) l (nhds 0) := tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.2 hf
    have hg0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun a => g a - g₀) l (nhds 0) := tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.2 hg

def LinGreenODE (κ : ℝ) (q f e : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 (e : ℝ → ℝ) x - 2 * deriv (fun y => q y * e y) x
      - 2 * q x * deriv (e : ℝ → ℝ) x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (e : ℝ → ℝ) x =
    2 * deriv (fun y => f y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y)) x
      + 2 * f x * deriv (greenOffset κ q : ℝ → ℝ) x

    have : (fun y : ℝ => (2 * w y) ^ 2) = fun y => 4 * w y ^ 2 := by
      funext y; ring
    rw [this, integral_const_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (f w z : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfi : Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hwc : Continuous w) (hw2 : MemLp w 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hz2 : MemLp z 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hz : ∀ x : ℝ, z x = riccatiK κ f x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x) :
    Continuous z ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |z x| ≤ C) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto z Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto z Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt z (2 * κ * z x + f x - 2 * w x * z x) x

signature.statement:

    (hz : ∀ x : ℝ, z x = riccatiK κ f x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have h2κ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * κ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ f x y,
      F f x y = (Set.Ici x).indicator (fun y => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * f y) y :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hD : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x y : ℝ), ‖F f x y‖ ≤ |f y| := by
    intro f x y
    rw [hF]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.Ici x
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      have hxy : x ≤ y := hy
      have h1 : Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by nlinarith)
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) h1
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, norm_zero]; exact abs_nonneg _
  
  have hM : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ) → ∀ x : ℝ,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (F f x) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro f hf x
    have e : F f x = (Set.Ici x).indicator (fun y => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * f y) :=
      funext (hF f x)
    rw [e]
    exact ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y))).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      hf.aestronglyMeasurable).indicator measurableSet_Ici
  
  have hR0 : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), riccatiK κ f = fun x => -∫ y, F f x y := by
    intro f
    funext x
    have e : (fun y => F f x y) =
        (Set.Ici x).indicator (fun y => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * f y) := funext (hF f x)
    rw [e, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ici]
    rfl
  
  have s1 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      (∀ x, |riccatiK κ f x| ≤ ∫ y, |f y|) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (riccatiK κ f) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (riccatiK κ f) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hR0 f]
    refine ⟨fun x => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show |-∫ y, F f x y| ≤ ∫ y, |f y|
      rw [abs_neg, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hf.abs (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hD f x))
    · have hlim : ∀ y : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x => F f x y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        intro y
        apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop y] with x hx
        rw [hF, Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simp only [Set.mem_Ici, not_le]; exact hx)]
      have h := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun y => |f y|)
        (l := Filter.atTop) (F := fun x y => F f x y) (f := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hM f hf))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hD f x)) hf.abs
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hlim)
      have h2 := h.neg
      simp only [integral_zero, neg_zero] at h2
      exact h2
    · have hlim : ∀ y : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x => F f x y) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
        intro y
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => 2 * κ * (x - y)) Filter.atBot Filter.atBot := by
          have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x + -y) Filter.atBot Filter.atBot :=
            Filter.tendsto_atBot_add_const_right _ (-y) Filter.tendsto_id
          refine Filter.Tendsto.congr (fun x => ?_) (h0.const_mul_atBot h2κ)
          ring
        have h3 := (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp h1).mul_const (f y)
        rw [zero_mul] at h3
        apply h3.congr'
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_le_atBot y] with x hx
        rw [hF, Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ Set.Ici x from hx)]
        rfl
      have h := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun y => |f y|)
        (l := Filter.atBot) (F := fun x y => F f x y) (f := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hM f hf))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hD f x)) hf.abs
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hlim)
      have h2 := h.neg
      simp only [integral_zero, neg_zero] at h2
      exact h2
  
  have s2 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ) → Continuous (riccatiK κ f) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hR0 f]
    refine Continuous.neg (continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x₀ => ?_)
    refine continuousAt_of_dominated (bound := fun y => |f y|)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hM f hf))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hD f x)) hf.abs ?_
    filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ne volume x₀] with y hy
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hy with h | h
    · apply (continuousAt_const (y := (0 : ℝ))).congr
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds h] with x hx
      rw [hF, Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simp only [Set.mem_Ici, not_le]; exact hx)]
    · apply (show Continuous fun x => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * f y by fun_prop).continuousAt.congr
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds h] with x hx
      rw [hF, Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ Set.Ici x from le_of_lt (show x < y from hx))]
  
  have s3 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ) → Continuous f → ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (riccatiK κ f) (2 * κ * riccatiK κ f x₀ + f x₀) x₀ := by
    intro f hf hfc x₀
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = x₀ - 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hax₀ : a < x₀ := by rw [ha]; linarith
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y, g y = Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * y) * f y :=
      ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have hge : g = fun y => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * y) * f y := funext hg
    have hgc : Continuous g := by rw [hge]; fun_prop
    have hgi : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioi a) := by
      rw [hge]
      refine Integrable.bdd_mul (c := Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * a)) hf.integrableOn ?_ ?_
      · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * y)).aestronglyMeasurable
      · refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y hy => ?_)
        have hay : a < y := hy
        show ‖Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * y)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * a)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by nlinarith)
    have hsplit : ∀ x, riccatiK κ f x = -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, g y) := by
      intro x
      show -∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * f y = _
      rw [integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi, ← integral_const_mul]
      refine congrArg Neg.neg (congrArg (integral _) (funext fun y => ?_))
      rw [hg y, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      rw [show 2 * κ * x + -(2 * κ) * y = 2 * κ * (x - y) by ring]
    have hhalf : ∀ x, a ≤ x →
        ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, g y = (∫ y in Set.Ioi a, g y) - ∫ y in a..x, g y := by
      intro x hax
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hax, ← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hax,
        setIntegral_union (Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) measurableSet_Ioi
          (hgi.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self) (hgi.mono_set (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi hax))]
      ring
    have hP : HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ y in a..x, g y) (g x₀) x₀ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hgc.intervalIntegrable a x₀)
        (hgc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (nhds x₀)) hgc.continuousAt
    have hE := ((hasDerivAt_id' x₀).const_mul (2 * κ)).exp
    have hR := (hE.mul ((hasDerivAt_const x₀ (∫ y in Set.Ioi a, g y)).sub hP)).neg
    have hev : riccatiK κ f =ᶠ[nhds x₀] fun x =>
        -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * ((∫ y in Set.Ioi a, g y) - ∫ y in a..x, g y)) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hax₀] with x hx
      rw [hsplit x, hhalf x (le_of_lt hx)]
    have hR' := hR.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    refine hR'.congr_deriv ?_
    have he : Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * x₀) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, show 2 * κ * x₀ + -(2 * κ) * x₀ = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    rw [hsplit x₀, hhalf x₀ hax₀.le, hg x₀]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    linear_combination (f x₀) * he
  
  have hwz : Integrable (fun y => w y * z y) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    have h := hw2.integrable_mul hz2
    exact h
  have hgi : Integrable (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    refine (hwz.const_mul 2).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    show 2 * (w y * z y) = 2 * w y * z y
    ring
  have hze : z = fun x => riccatiK κ f x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x := funext hz
  obtain ⟨bf, tf1, tf2⟩ := s1 f hfi
  obtain ⟨bg, tg1, tg2⟩ := s1 _ hgi
  have hzc : Continuous z := by
    have h := (s2 f hfi).sub (s2 _ hgi)
    rw [hze]
    exact h
  have hgc : Continuous (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) := (continuous_const.mul hwc).mul hzc
  refine ⟨hzc, ⟨(∫ y, |f y|) + ∫ y, |2 * w y * z y|, fun x => ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · calc |z x| = |riccatiK κ f x - riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x| := by rw [← hz x]
      _ ≤ |riccatiK κ f x| + |riccatiK κ (fun y => 2 * w y * z y) x| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ (∫ y, |f y|) + ∫ y, |2 * w y * z y| := add_le_add (bf x) (bg x)
  · have h := tf1.sub tg1
    rw [sub_zero] at h
    rw [hze]; exact h
  · have h := tf2.sub tg2
    rw [sub_zero] at h
    rw [hze]; exact h
  · have hA := s3 f hfi hfc x
    have hB := s3 _ hgi hgc x
    have h := (hA.sub hB).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hz)
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    linear_combination (-(2 * κ)) * hz x

informal_problem.statement:
(K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (q0 w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hq0c : Continuous q0) (hq0i : Integrable q0 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hwc : Continuous w) (hwb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C)
    (hw2 : MemLp w 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hwd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q0 x + 2 * K * w x - w x ^ 2) x) :
    ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (2 * (w x - K) * G x + 1) x) ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |G x| ≤ C

signature.name: riccati_green_bounded
signature.statement:
(K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (q0 w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hq0c : Continuous q0) (hq0i : Integrable q0 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hwc : Continuous w) (hwb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C)
    (hw2 : MemLp w 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hwd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q0 x + 2 * K * w x - w x ^ 2) x) :
    ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (2 * (w x - K) * G x + 1) x) ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |G x| ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hbdef⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ → ℝ, b = fun s => 2 * (w s - K) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hb : Continuous b := by
    rw [hbdef]; exact continuous_const.mul (hwc.sub continuous_const)
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = (∫ s, w s ^ 2) / K := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hbd : ∀ x y : ℝ, y ≤ x → ∫ s in y..x, b s ≤ L - K * (x - y) := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hw2c : Continuous fun s => w s ^ 2 := hwc.pow 2
    have hgc : Continuous fun s => w s ^ 2 / K - K := (hw2c.div_const K).sub continuous_const
    have h1 : ∫ s in y..x, b s ≤ ∫ s in y..x, (w s ^ 2 / K - K) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hxy (hb.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hgc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      intro s _
      have e : w s ^ 2 / K - K - 2 * (w s - K) = (w s - K) ^ 2 / K := by
        field_simp; ring
      have : 0 ≤ (w s - K) ^ 2 / K := by positivity
      rw [hbdef]; simp only; linarith
    have h2 : ∫ s in y..x, (w s ^ 2 / K - K) = (∫ s in y..x, w s ^ 2) / K - (x - y) * K := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hw2c.div_const K).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        intervalIntegrable_const, intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
        smul_eq_mul]
    have h3 : ∫ s in y..x, w s ^ 2 ≤ ∫ s, w s ^ 2 := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hxy]
      exact setIntegral_le_integral hw2.integrable_sq
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => sq_nonneg _)
    have h4 : (∫ s in y..x, w s ^ 2) / K ≤ (∫ s, w s ^ 2) / K :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h3 hK.le
    rw [hLdef]; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ, A = fun x => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..x, b s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA : ∀ x, HasDerivAt A (b x) x := by
    intro x; rw [hAdef]; exact (hb.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt
  have hAc : Continuous A := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hA x).continuousAt
  have hAsub : ∀ x y, A x - A y = ∫ s in y..x, b s := by
    intro x y; rw [hAdef]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hb.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (hb.intervalIntegrable _ _)
  obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ → ℝ, E = fun y => Real.exp (-A y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEc : Continuous E := by rw [hEdef]; exact Real.continuous_exp.comp hAc.neg
  have hEpos : ∀ y, 0 < E y := fun y => by rw [hEdef]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have key : ∀ x y, y ≤ x → Real.exp (A x) * E y ≤ Real.exp (L - K * x) * Real.exp (K * y) := by
    intro x y hxy
    rw [hEdef]; simp only
    rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have h := hbd x y hxy
    rw [← hAsub] at h
    linarith
  have hint : ∀ c : ℝ, IntegrableOn E (Set.Iic c) volume := by
    intro c
    refine Integrable.mono' ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic hK c).const_mul
      (Real.exp (L - K * c - A c))) hEc.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Iic).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y hy => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hEpos y), hEdef]
    simp only
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have h := hbd c y hy
    rw [← hAsub] at h
    linarith
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, F = fun x => ∫ y in Set.Iic x, E y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF : ∀ x, HasDerivAt F (E x) x := by
    intro x
    have heq : F = fun x => (∫ y in Set.Iic 0, E y) + ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, E y := by
      rw [hFdef]
      funext z
      have h := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hint 0) (hint z)
      linarith
    rw [heq]
    exact (hEc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt.const_add _
  refine ⟨fun x => Real.exp (A x) * F x, ?_, Real.exp L / K, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    have h := ((hA x).exp).mul (hF x)
    have hEx : Real.exp (A x) * E x = 1 := by
      rw [hEdef]; simp only; rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
    convert h using 1
    rw [hEx, hbdef]
    ring
  · intro x
    have hF0 : 0 ≤ F x := by
      rw [hFdef]
      exact setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Iic fun y _ => (hEpos y).le
    have hG0 : 0 ≤ Real.exp (A x) * F x := mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hF0
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hG0]
    have hle : Real.exp (A x) * F x ≤
        ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (L - K * x) * Real.exp (K * y) := by
      rw [hFdef]
      simp only
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact setIntegral_mono_on ((hint x).const_mul _)
        ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic hK x).const_mul _) measurableSet_Iic
        (fun y hy => key x y hy)
    have hval : ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (L - K * x) * Real.exp (K * y) = Real.exp L / K := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Iic hK x, ← mul_div_assoc, ← Real.exp_add,
        sub_add_cancel]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    |∫ x : ℝ, q x * h x ^ 2| ≤ ‖toHm1 q‖ *
      (2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (h x * deriv (h : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2)
        + 2 * κ * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, h x ^ 4))

signature.name: schwartz_sq_pairing_bound
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    |∫ x : ℝ, q x * h x ^ 2| ≤ ‖toHm1 q‖ *
      (2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (h x * deriv (h : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2)
        + 2 * κ * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, h x ^ 4))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ0 : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by linarith
  
  have CS : ∀ (u v : ℝ → ℝ), MemLp u 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp v 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      (∫ a, u a * v a) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ a, u a ^ 2) * (∫ a, v a ^ 2) := by
    intro u v hu hv
    have hA := hu.integrable_sq
    have hB := hv.integrable_sq
    have hC : Integrable (fun a => u a * v a) volume := hu.integrable_mul hv
    have key : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ (∫ a, u a ^ 2) * (t * t) + (2 * ∫ a, u a * v a) * t +
        ∫ a, v a ^ 2 := by
      intro t
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∫ a, (t * u a + v a) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun a => sq_nonneg _)
      have heq : (fun a => (t * u a + v a) ^ 2) =
          fun a => (t * t) * u a ^ 2 + ((2 * t) * (u a * v a) + v a ^ 2) := by
        funext a; ring
      have i1 : Integrable (fun a => (t * t) * u a ^ 2) volume := hA.const_mul _
      have i2 : Integrable (fun a => (2 * t) * (u a * v a)) volume := hC.const_mul _
      have i23 : Integrable (fun a => (2 * t) * (u a * v a) + v a ^ 2) volume := i2.add hB
      rw [heq, integral_add i1 i23, integral_add i2 hB, integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul] at h0
      nlinarith
    have hd := discrim_le_zero key
    unfold discrim at hd
    nlinarith
  have CSabs : ∀ (u v : ℝ → ℝ), MemLp u 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp v 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      |∫ a, u a * v a| ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ a, u a ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ a, v a ^ 2) := by
    intro u v hu hv
    have h1 := CS u v hu hv
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ ∫ a, u a ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun a => sq_nonneg _
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ ∫ a, v a ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun a => sq_nonneg _
    have hb : (Real.sqrt (∫ a, u a ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ a, v a ^ 2)) ^ 2 =
        (∫ a, u a ^ 2) * (∫ a, v a ^ 2) := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hu0, Real.sq_sqrt hv0]
    rw [← hb] at h1
    exact abs_le.2 (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h1 (by positivity))
  
  obtain ⟨hk2, hkeq⟩ := riccatiK_sq_integral κ hκ0 q
  have hW := ((Hm1_weight_basic (toHm1 q)).2 κ hκ).2.1
  have hk_le : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 := by rw [hkeq]; exact hW
  have hS : Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2) ≤ ‖toHm1 q‖ :=
    (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hk_le).trans_eq (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _))
  have hkb : ∀ x : ℝ, |riccatiK κ q x| ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, |q y| := by
    intro x
    unfold riccatiK
    rw [abs_neg, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hb1 : ‖∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) * q y‖ ≤
        ∫ y in Set.Ici x, |q y| := by
      refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (q.integrable (μ := volume)).abs.integrableOn ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ici fun y hy => ?_
      have hy' : x ≤ y := hy
      have hle : Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by nlinarith)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hle
    exact hb1.trans (setIntegral_le_integral (q.integrable (μ := volume)).abs
      (ae_of_all _ fun y => abs_nonneg _))
  have hd : ∀ x₀ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (riccatiK κ q) (2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x₀ + q x₀) x₀ := by
    intro x₀
    obtain ⟨g0, hg0⟩ : ∃ g0 : ℝ → ℝ, g0 = fun y => Real.exp (-2 * κ * y) * q y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcont : Continuous g0 := by
      rw [hg0]
      exact (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul q.continuous
    have hint : ∀ a : ℝ, IntegrableOn g0 (Set.Ioi a) := by
      intro a
      refine Integrable.mono'
        ((q.integrable (μ := volume)).norm.const_mul (Real.exp (-2 * κ * a))).integrableOn
        hcont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => ?_
      rw [hg0]
      simp only
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg _)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have : a < y := hy
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ y in Set.Ioi (x₀ - 1), g0 y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hrep : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi (x₀ - 1),
        riccatiK κ q x = -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, g0 y)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hx' : x₀ - 1 < x := hx
      have hsplit : A = (∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, g0 y) + ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, g0 y := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx'.le, ← setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same
          measurableSet_Ioi ((hint (x₀ - 1)).mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self) (hint x),
          Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx'.le, hA]
      have hK : riccatiK κ q x = -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, g0 y) := by
        unfold riccatiK
        rw [integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi, ← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun y _ => ?_
        rw [hg0]
        simp only
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2
        ring
      rw [hK, hsplit]
      ring
    have hJ : HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, g0 y) (g0 x₀) x₀ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hcont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hcont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hcont.continuousAt
    have hE : HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.exp (2 * κ * x)) (Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (2 * κ)) x₀ := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id x₀).const_mul (2 * κ)).exp
      simpa using this
    have hP : HasDerivAt (fun x => -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, g0 y)))
        (-(Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (2 * κ) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x₀, g0 y) +
          Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (0 - g0 x₀))) x₀ :=
      (hE.mul ((hasDerivAt_const x₀ A).sub hJ)).neg
    have hev : riccatiK κ q =ᶠ[nhds x₀]
        fun x => -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, g0 y)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds (by linarith : x₀ - 1 < x₀)) hrep
    have hval : -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (2 * κ) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x₀, g0 y) +
          Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (0 - g0 x₀)) = 2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x₀ + q x₀ := by
      rw [hrep x₀ (show x₀ - 1 < x₀ by linarith), hg0]
      simp only
      have hEE : Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * x₀) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        ring_nf
        exact Real.exp_zero
      linear_combination (q x₀) * hEE
    have hfin := hP.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    rw [hval] at hfin
    exact hfin
  have hkc : Continuous (riccatiK κ q) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hd x).continuousAt
  
  obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ : ∃ h' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ y : ℝ, h' y = deriv (h : ℝ → ℝ) y :=
    ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ h, fun y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ h y⟩
  have hfun' : deriv (h : ℝ → ℝ) = (h' : ℝ → ℝ) := funext fun y => (hh' y).symm
  simp only [hfun']
  have hφ : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => h y ^ 2) (2 * h x * h' x) x := by
    intro x
    have := ((h.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt).pow 2
    rw [hh']
    convert this using 1
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hmul2 : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (fun x => f x * g x) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro f g
    refine MemLp.of_le ((g.memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).const_mul (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f))
      (f.continuous.mul g.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    have hC : 0 ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f :=
      (norm_nonneg (f x)).trans (SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ f x)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hC]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ f x) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hA2 : MemLp (fun x => h x * h' x) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := hmul2 h h'
  have hB2 : MemLp (fun x => h x ^ 2) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    simpa only [sq] using hmul2 h h
  
  have iφ : Integrable (fun x => h x ^ 2) volume := (h.memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).integrable_sq
  have iφ' : Integrable (fun x => 2 * h x * h' x) volume := by
    have h1 := (h.memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).integrable_mul (h'.memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    refine (h1.const_mul 2).congr (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
    ring
  have i1 : Integrable (fun x => riccatiK κ q x * (2 * h x * h' x)) volume :=
    iφ'.bdd_mul (c := ∫ y : ℝ, |q y|) hkc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hkb x)
  have i2 : Integrable (fun x => (2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x + q x) * h x ^ 2) volume := by
    refine iφ.bdd_mul (c := 2 * κ * (∫ y : ℝ, |q y|) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q)
      ((continuous_const.mul hkc).add q.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    have e1 := hkb x
    have e2 := SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ q x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at e2 ⊢
    have e3 : |2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x| = 2 * κ * |riccatiK κ q x| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * κ)]
    calc |2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x + q x| ≤ |2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x| + |q x| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = 2 * κ * |riccatiK κ q x| + |q x| := by rw [e3]
      _ ≤ 2 * κ * (∫ y : ℝ, |q y|) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (by positivity)) e2
  have i3 : Integrable (fun x => riccatiK κ q x * h x ^ 2) volume :=
    iφ.bdd_mul (c := ∫ y : ℝ, |q y|) hkc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hkb x)
  have i4 : Integrable (fun x => q x * h x ^ 2) volume :=
    iφ.bdd_mul (c := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 q) q.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ q x)
  
  have hibp : ∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * (2 * h x * h' x) =
      -∫ x, (2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x + q x) * h x ^ 2 :=
    integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul_of_integrable (u := riccatiK κ q) (v := fun y => h y ^ 2)
      (u' := fun x => 2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x + q x) (v' := fun x => 2 * h x * h' x)
      hd hφ i1 i2 i3
  have eL : ∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * (2 * h x * h' x) =
      2 * ∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * (h x * h' x) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext x
    ring
  have eR : ∫ x, (2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x + q x) * h x ^ 2 =
      2 * κ * (∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * h x ^ 2) + ∫ x, q x * h x ^ 2 := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_add (i3.const_mul _) i4]
    congr 1
    funext x
    ring
  have hid : ∫ x, q x * h x ^ 2 = -(2 * ∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * (h x * h' x))
      - 2 * κ * ∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * h x ^ 2 := by
    linarith
  
  have hI1 : |∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * (h x * h' x)| ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (h x * h' x) ^ 2) :=
    CSabs _ _ hk2 hA2
  have hI2 : |∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * h x ^ 2| ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (h x ^ 2) ^ 2) :=
    CSabs _ _ hk2 hB2
  have e4 : (∫ x : ℝ, (h x ^ 2) ^ 2) = ∫ x : ℝ, h x ^ 4 := by
    congr 1
    funext x
    ring
  rw [e4] at hI2
  rw [hid]
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (h x * h' x) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, h x ^ 4) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.1 hI1
  obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_le.1 hI2
  have c1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 hκ0.le
  have c2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b2 hκ0.le
  have key : |-(2 * ∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * (h x * h' x))
      - 2 * κ * ∫ x, riccatiK κ q x * h x ^ 2| ≤
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2) *
        (2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (h x * h' x) ^ 2) + 2 * κ * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, h x ^ 4)) := by
    refine abs_le.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  refine key.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS ?_)
  positivity

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :

    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 =
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2

signature.name: toHm1_norm_comp_neg
signature.statement:

    ‖toHm1 p‖ = ‖toHm1 q‖

proof.tactics:
by
  have hfl : ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine p ξ = fourierLine q (-ξ) := by
    intro ξ
    unfold fourierLine
    congr 1
    have := integral_neg_eq_self
      (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((-ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume
    rw [← this]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [hp x]
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  have hprof : hm1Profile p = (hm1Profile q) ∘ Neg.neg := by
    funext ξ
    simp only [hm1Profile, Function.comp, neg_sq]
    rw [hfl ξ]
  have hprof' : hm1Profile q = (hm1Profile p) ∘ Neg.neg := by
    funext ξ
    simp only [Function.comp, hprof, neg_neg]
  have hmp := Measure.measurePreserving_neg (volume : Measure ℝ)
  by_cases hq : MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 volume
  · have hpm : MemLp (hm1Profile p) 2 volume := by
      rw [hprof]; exact hq.comp_measurePreserving hmp
    unfold toHm1
    rw [dif_pos hpm, dif_pos hq, Lp.norm_toLp, Lp.norm_toLp]
    congr 1
    rw [hprof, eLpNorm_comp_measurePreserving hq.1 hmp]
  · have hpm : ¬ MemLp (hm1Profile p) 2 volume := by
      intro h
      apply hq
      rw [hprof']; exact h.comp_measurePreserving hmp
    unfold toHm1
    rw [dif_neg hpm, dif_neg hq]

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hc : Continuous w) (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C)
    (htop : Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbot : Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atBot (nhds 0))
    (hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) :
