signature.name: riccati_sol_rapid_decay
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hc : Continuous w) (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C)
    (htop : Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbot : Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atBot (nhds 0))
    (hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |w x| ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have linear_ode_right_tail_bound : ∀ (κ R Cg M : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (_hκ : 0 < κ) (_hR : 0 < R)
      (w a g : ℝ → ℝ)
      (_hd : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → HasDerivAt w (a x * w x + g x) x)
      (_ha : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → κ ≤ a x)
      (_hM : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → w x ≤ M)
      (_hg : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → x ^ k * |g x| ≤ Cg),
      ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → x ^ k * w x ≤ Cg / κ := by
    intro κ R Cg M k hκ hR w a g hd ha hM hg
    have hCg : 0 ≤ Cg :=
      le_trans (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR.le k) (abs_nonneg _)) (hg R le_rfl)
    obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = Cg / κ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; exact div_nonneg hCg hκ.le
    have hκB : κ * B = Cg := by rw [hBdef]; field_simp
    obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, φ = fun y => B * (y ^ k)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨φ', hφ'def⟩ : ∃ φ' : ℝ → ℝ,
        φ' = fun y => B * (-((k : ℝ) * y ^ (k - 1)) / (y ^ k) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hφd : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → HasDerivAt φ (φ' y) y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hφdef, hφ'def]
      exact ((hasDerivAt_pow k y).inv (pow_ne_zero k hy.ne')).const_mul B
    have hφ'nonpos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → φ' y ≤ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hφ'def]
      have h0 : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * y ^ (k - 1) / (y ^ k) ^ 2 :=
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) (pow_nonneg hy.le _)) (sq_nonneg _)
      have e : B * (-((k : ℝ) * y ^ (k - 1)) / (y ^ k) ^ 2) =
          -(B * ((k : ℝ) * y ^ (k - 1) / (y ^ k) ^ 2)) := by ring
      simp only
      rw [e]
      exact neg_nonpos.2 (mul_nonneg hB0 h0)
    have hφnonneg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 ≤ φ y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hφdef]
      exact mul_nonneg hB0 (inv_nonneg.2 (pow_nonneg hy.le k))
    have hgφ : ∀ y : ℝ, R ≤ y → 0 ≤ g y + κ * φ y := by
      intro y hy
      have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le hR hy
      have hpk : 0 < y ^ k := pow_pos hy0 k
      have h1 := hg y hy
      have h2 : |g y| ≤ Cg * (y ^ k)⁻¹ := by
        calc |g y| = (y ^ k)⁻¹ * (y ^ k * |g y|) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpk.ne', one_mul]
          _ ≤ (y ^ k)⁻¹ * Cg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.2 hpk.le)
          _ = Cg * (y ^ k)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
      have h3 : κ * φ y = Cg * (y ^ k)⁻¹ := by
        rw [hφdef]; simp only; rw [← mul_assoc, hκB]
      have h4 := neg_abs_le (g y)
      linarith
    intro x₀ hx₀
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hx0 : 0 < x₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hR hx₀
    have hpk0 : 0 < x₀ ^ k := pow_pos hx0 k
    have hlt : φ x₀ < w x₀ := by
      have e : φ x₀ = B * (x₀ ^ k)⁻¹ := by rw [hφdef]
      rw [e]
      calc B * (x₀ ^ k)⁻¹ < (x₀ ^ k * w x₀) * (x₀ ^ k)⁻¹ :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by rw [hBdef]; exact hcon) (inv_pos.2 hpk0)
        _ = w x₀ := by rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpk0.ne', one_mul]
    obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = w x₀ - φ x₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hcdef]; linarith
    have hMpos : 0 < M + 1 := by
      have := hM x₀ hx₀
      have := hφnonneg x₀ hx0
      linarith
    have hκc : 0 < κ * c := mul_pos hκ hc0
    obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = 2 * (M + 1) / (κ * c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hLdef]; exact div_pos (by linarith) hκc
    have hLe : κ * c / 2 * L = M + 1 := by rw [hLdef]; field_simp
    have hu : ∀ y : ℝ, R ≤ y →
        HasDerivAt (fun y => w y - φ y) (a y * w y + g y - φ' y) y :=
      fun y hy => (hd y hy).sub (hφd y (lt_of_lt_of_le hR hy))
    have hcmp := image_le_of_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary'
      (f := fun y => c + κ * c / 2 * (y - x₀)) (f' := fun _ => κ * c / 2 * 1)
      (a := x₀) (b := x₀ + L)
      (B := fun y => w y - φ y) (B' := fun y => a y * w y + g y - φ' y)
      (by fun_prop)
      (fun y _ => HasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt
        ((((hasDerivAt_id' y).sub_const x₀).const_mul (κ * c / 2)).const_add c))
      (by simp [hcdef])
      (fun y hy => (hu y (le_trans hx₀ hy.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun y hy => (hu y (le_trans hx₀ hy.1)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by
        intro y hy hfy
        simp only at hfy
        have hyR : R ≤ y := le_trans hx₀ hy.1
        have hy0 : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le hR hyR
        have hfc : c ≤ c + κ * c / 2 * (y - x₀) := by
          have : 0 ≤ κ * c / 2 * (y - x₀) :=
            mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith [hy.1])
          linarith
        have huc : c ≤ w y - φ y := by linarith
        have hay := ha y hyR
        have h1 : κ * c ≤ a y * (w y - φ y) := mul_le_mul hay huc hc0.le (le_trans hκ.le hay)
        have h2 := hφ'nonpos y hy0
        have h3 := hgφ y hyR
        have h4 : κ * φ y ≤ a y * φ y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hay (hφnonneg y hy0)
        have h5 : a y * w y = a y * (w y - φ y) + a y * φ y := by ring
        show κ * c / 2 * 1 < a y * w y + g y - φ' y
        linarith)
    have hfin := hcmp (x := x₀ + L) ⟨by linarith, le_rfl⟩
    simp only at hfin
    have hwM := hM (x₀ + L) (by linarith)
    have hφ0 := hφnonneg (x₀ + L) (by linarith)
    have e : κ * c / 2 * (x₀ + L - x₀) = M + 1 := by rw [add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hLe
    rw [e] at hfin
    linarith
  
  have linear_ode_left_tail_bound : ∀ (κ R Cg : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (_hκ : 0 < κ) (_hR : 0 < R)
      (_hkR : 2 * (k : ℝ) ≤ κ * R) (w a g : ℝ → ℝ)
      (_hd : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → HasDerivAt w (a x * w x + g x) x)
      (_ha : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → κ ≤ a x)
      (_hg : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → |x| ^ k * |g x| ≤ Cg),
      ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → |x| ^ k * w x ≤ 2 * Cg / κ + 1 + R ^ k * |w (-R)| := by
    intro κ R Cg k hκ hR hkR w a g hd ha hg
    have hCg : 0 ≤ Cg :=
      le_trans (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) k) (abs_nonneg _)) (hg (-R) le_rfl)
    obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = 2 * Cg / κ + 1 + R ^ k * |w (-R)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hRkw : 0 ≤ R ^ k * |w (-R)| := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR.le k) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hB1 : R ^ k * |w (-R)| + 1 ≤ B := by
      rw [hBdef]
      have : 0 ≤ 2 * Cg / κ := div_nonneg (by linarith) hκ.le
      linarith
    have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
    have hκB : κ * B = 2 * Cg + κ * (1 + R ^ k * |w (-R)|) := by
      rw [hBdef]; field_simp; ring
    have hW : ∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ t →
        HasDerivAt (fun t => w (-t)) (-(a (-t) * w (-t) + g (-t))) t := by
      intro t ht
      have h1 := (hd (-t) (by linarith)).comp t (hasDerivAt_neg t)
      convert h1 using 1
      ring
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨdef⟩ : ∃ Ψ : ℝ → ℝ, Ψ = fun t => B * (t ^ k)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ψ', hΨ'def⟩ : ∃ Ψ' : ℝ → ℝ,
        Ψ' = fun t => B * (-((k : ℝ) * t ^ (k - 1)) / (t ^ k) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΨd : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt Ψ (Ψ' t) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hΨdef, hΨ'def]
      exact ((hasDerivAt_pow k t).inv (pow_ne_zero k ht.ne')).const_mul B
    have hΨ'lb : ∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ t → -(κ / 2) * Ψ t ≤ Ψ' t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le hR ht
      have hpk : 0 < t ^ k := pow_pos ht0 k
      have key : (k : ℝ) * t ^ (k - 1) ≤ κ / 2 * t ^ k := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
        · subst hk
          simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, pow_zero, mul_one]
          linarith
        · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, k = n + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
          simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
          push_cast at hkR ⊢
          have hκt := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hκ.le
          have hn : 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ κ * t := by linarith
          have hpn : 0 ≤ t ^ n := pow_nonneg ht0.le n
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hpn
          nlinarith
      have hinv : (t ^ k)⁻¹ = t ^ k * ((t ^ k) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [pow_two, mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpk.ne', one_mul]
      rw [hΨdef, hΨ'def]
      simp only
      have e1 : B * (-((k : ℝ) * t ^ (k - 1)) / (t ^ k) ^ 2) =
          -(B * ((k : ℝ) * t ^ (k - 1)) * ((t ^ k) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by ring
      have e2 : -(κ / 2) * (B * (t ^ k)⁻¹) =
          -(B * (κ / 2 * t ^ k) * ((t ^ k) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        rw [hinv]; ring
      rw [e1, e2, neg_le_neg_iff]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hB0.le)
        (inv_nonneg.2 (sq_nonneg _))
    have hΨpos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < Ψ t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hΨdef]
      exact mul_pos hB0 (inv_pos.2 (pow_pos ht k))
    have hinit : w (-R) ≤ Ψ R := by
      have hpk : 0 < R ^ k := pow_pos hR k
      have e : Ψ R = B * (R ^ k)⁻¹ := by rw [hΨdef]
      rw [e]
      calc w (-R) ≤ |w (-R)| := le_abs_self _
        _ = (R ^ k * |w (-R)|) * (R ^ k)⁻¹ := by
            rw [mul_comm (R ^ k), mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpk.ne', mul_one]
        _ ≤ B * (R ^ k)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.2 hpk.le)
    have hcmp : ∀ t : ℝ, R ≤ t → w (-t) ≤ Ψ t := by
      intro t ht
      have hc := image_le_of_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary'
        (f := fun t => w (-t)) (f' := fun t => -(a (-t) * w (-t) + g (-t)))
        (a := R) (b := t + 1) (B := Ψ) (B' := Ψ')
        (fun s hs => (hW s hs.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (fun s hs => (hW s hs.1).hasDerivWithinAt)
        hinit
        (fun s hs => (hΨd s (lt_of_lt_of_le hR hs.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (fun s hs => (hΨd s (lt_of_lt_of_le hR hs.1)).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (by
          intro s hs hfs
          simp only at hfs
          have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hR hs.1
          have hpk : 0 < s ^ k := pow_pos hs0 k
          have has := ha (-s) (by linarith [hs.1])
          have hgs := hg (-s) (by linarith [hs.1])
          rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hs0] at hgs
          have h2 : |g (-s)| ≤ Cg * (s ^ k)⁻¹ := by
            calc |g (-s)| = (s ^ k)⁻¹ * (s ^ k * |g (-s)|) := by
                  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpk.ne', one_mul]
              _ ≤ (s ^ k)⁻¹ * Cg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgs (inv_nonneg.2 hpk.le)
              _ = Cg * (s ^ k)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
          have hΨs : Ψ s = B * (s ^ k)⁻¹ := by rw [hΨdef]
          have hlb := hΨ'lb s hs.1
          have hΨp := hΨpos s hs0
          have h3 : κ * Ψ s ≤ a (-s) * Ψ s := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right has hΨp.le
          have h4 := neg_abs_le (g (-s))
          have hinvpos : 0 < (s ^ k)⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 hpk
          have h5 : Cg * (s ^ k)⁻¹ < κ / 2 * Ψ s := by
            rw [hΨs]
            have hh : κ / 2 * B = Cg + κ / 2 * (1 + R ^ k * |w (-R)|) := by linarith [hκB]
            rw [← mul_assoc, hh]
            apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right _ hinvpos
            have : 0 < κ / 2 * (1 + R ^ k * |w (-R)|) :=
              mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
            linarith
          show -(a (-s) * w (-s) + g (-s)) < Ψ' s
          rw [hfs]
          linarith)
      exact hc ⟨ht, by linarith⟩
    intro x hx
    have h := hcmp (-x) (by linarith)
    rw [neg_neg] at h
    have hx0 : 0 < -x := by linarith
    rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith : x < 0)]
    have hpk : 0 < (-x) ^ k := pow_pos hx0 k
    have e : Ψ (-x) = B * ((-x) ^ k)⁻¹ := by rw [hΨdef]
    rw [e] at h
    calc (-x) ^ k * w x ≤ (-x) ^ k * (B * ((-x) ^ k)⁻¹) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hpk.le
      _ = B := by rw [mul_comm B, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpk.ne', one_mul]
      _ = _ := hBdef
  
  intro k
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨Cq, hCqdef⟩ : ∃ Cq : ℝ, Cq = SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k 0 q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hqd : ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |q x| ≤ Cq := by
    intro x
    have := SchwartzMap.norm_pow_mul_le_seminorm ℝ q k x
    rw [hCqdef]
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have hCq0 : 0 ≤ Cq := le_trans (by positivity) (hqd 0)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM 0)
  obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (htop.eventually_le_const hκ)
  obtain ⟨R₂, hR₂⟩ := Filter.eventually_atBot.1 (hbot.eventually_le_const hκ)
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = max (max 1 R₁) (max (-R₂) (2 * (k : ℝ) / κ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := by rw [hRdef]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hRR₁ : R₁ ≤ R := by rw [hRdef]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hRR₂ : -R₂ ≤ R := by rw [hRdef]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hRk : 2 * (k : ℝ) / κ ≤ R := by
    rw [hRdef]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hkR : 2 * (k : ℝ) ≤ κ * R := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hκ] at hRk; linarith
  obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ → ℝ, a = fun x => 2 * κ - w x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have haR : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → κ ≤ a x := by
    intro x hx
    have := hR₁ x (le_trans hRR₁ hx)
    rw [hadef]; linarith
  have haL : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → κ ≤ a x := by
    intro x hx
    have := hR₂ x (by linarith)
    rw [hadef]; linarith
  have hd1 : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (a x * w x + q x) x := by
    intro x
    convert hd x using 1
    rw [hadef]; ring
  have hd2 : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => -w y) (a x * (-w x) + (-q x)) x := by
    intro x
    convert (hd x).neg using 1
    rw [hadef]; ring
  have hgR : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → x ^ k * |q x| ≤ Cq := by
    intro x hx
    have := hqd x
    rwa [abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < x)] at this
  have hgR' : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → x ^ k * |(fun y => -q y) x| ≤ Cq := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [abs_neg]
    exact hgR x hx
  have hgL' : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → |x| ^ k * |(fun y => -q y) x| ≤ Cq := by
    intro x _
    simp only [abs_neg]
    exact hqd x
  have P1 : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → x ^ k * w x ≤ Cq / κ :=
    linear_ode_right_tail_bound κ R Cq M k hκ hR0 w a q (fun x _ => hd1 x) haR
      (fun x _ => le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hM x)) hgR
  have P2 : ∀ x : ℝ, R ≤ x → x ^ k * (-w x) ≤ Cq / κ :=
    linear_ode_right_tail_bound κ R Cq M k hκ hR0 (fun y => -w y) a (fun y => -q y)
      (fun x _ => hd2 x) haR (fun x _ => le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (hM x)) hgR'
  have P3 : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → |x| ^ k * w x ≤ 2 * Cq / κ + 1 + R ^ k * |w (-R)| :=
    linear_ode_left_tail_bound κ R Cq k hκ hR0 hkR w a q (fun x _ => hd1 x) haL
      (fun x _ => hqd x)
  have P4 : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -R → |x| ^ k * (-w x) ≤ 2 * Cq / κ + 1 + R ^ k * |-w (-R)| :=
    linear_ode_left_tail_bound κ R Cq k hκ hR0 hkR (fun y => -w y) a (fun y => -q y)
      (fun x _ => hd2 x) haL hgL'
  rw [abs_neg] at P4
  have hCk : 0 ≤ Cq / κ := div_nonneg hCq0 hκ.le
  have hRkM : 0 ≤ R ^ k * M := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR0.le k) hM0
  have hRkw : 0 ≤ R ^ k * |w (-R)| := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hR0.le k) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hCk2 : 0 ≤ 2 * Cq / κ := div_nonneg (by linarith) hκ.le
  refine ⟨Cq / κ + (2 * Cq / κ + 1 + R ^ k * |w (-R)|) + R ^ k * M, fun x => ?_⟩
  by_cases hxR : R ≤ x
  · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < x)]
    rcases abs_cases (w x) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
    · rw [h]; have := P1 x hxR; linarith
    · rw [h]; have := P2 x hxR; linarith
  · by_cases hxL : x ≤ -R
    · rcases abs_cases (w x) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
      · rw [h]; have := P3 x hxL; linarith
      · rw [h]; have := P4 x hxL; linarith
    · push_neg at hxR hxL
      have hax : |x| ≤ R := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have h1 : |x| ^ k ≤ R ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) hax k
      have h2 : |x| ^ k * |w x| ≤ R ^ k * M :=
        mul_le_mul h1 (hM x) (abs_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hR0.le k)
      linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x)
    (hdec : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |w x| ≤ C) :
    ∃ W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, W x = w x

signature.name: schwartz_of_riccati_decay
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x)
    (hdec : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |w x| ≤ C) :
    ∃ W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, W x = w x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ w := fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt
  have hD : deriv w = fun x => q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2 := funext fun x => (hd x).deriv
  have hq : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n (q : ℝ → ℝ) := fun n => contDiff_infty.1 (q.smooth ⊤) n
  
  have hsm : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n w := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact contDiff_zero.2 hdiff.continuous
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
      refine ⟨hdiff, fun h => absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
      rw [hD]
      exact ((hq n).add (contDiff_const.mul ih)).sub (ih.pow 2)
  
  have hrec : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) w x| ≤
      |iteratedDeriv n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x| + 2 * |κ| * |iteratedDeriv n w x|
        + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (n.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i w x| * |iteratedDeriv (n - i) w x| := by
    intro n x
    have hD' : deriv w = ((q : ℝ → ℝ) + fun y => 2 * κ * w y) - (w * w) := by
      rw [hD]; funext y; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply]; ring
    have cq : ContDiffAt ℝ n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x := (hq n).contDiffAt
    have cw : ContDiffAt ℝ n w x := (hsm n).contDiffAt
    have c2 : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun y => 2 * κ * w y) x := (contDiff_const.mul (hsm n)).contDiffAt
    have cs : ContDiffAt ℝ n ((q : ℝ → ℝ) + fun y => 2 * κ * w y) x := cq.add c2
    have cm : ContDiffAt ℝ n (w * w) x := ((hsm n).mul (hsm n)).contDiffAt
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hD', iteratedDeriv_sub cs cm, iteratedDeriv_add cq c2,
      iteratedDeriv_const_mul cw, iteratedDeriv_mul cw cw]
    have hS : |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i w x * iteratedDeriv (n - i) w x| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (n.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i w x| * |iteratedDeriv (n - i) w x| := by
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_))
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
    have hB : |2 * κ * iteratedDeriv n w x| = 2 * |κ| * |iteratedDeriv n w x| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
    have a1 := le_abs_self (iteratedDeriv n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x)
    have a2 := neg_abs_le (iteratedDeriv n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x)
    have b1 := le_abs_self (2 * κ * iteratedDeriv n w x)
    have b2 := neg_abs_le (2 * κ * iteratedDeriv n w x)
    have s1 := le_abs_self (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i w x * iteratedDeriv (n - i) w x)
    have s2 := neg_abs_le (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i w x * iteratedDeriv (n - i) w x)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hb : ∀ n k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv n (q : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ C := by
    intro n k
    obtain ⟨C, -, hC⟩ := q.decay k n
    refine ⟨C, fun x => ?_⟩
    have := hC x
    rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  
  have hQ : ∀ m k : ℕ, ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv j w x| ≤ D := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hdec k
      refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun j hj x => ?_⟩
      have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.le_zero.1 hj
      subst hj0
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      exact (hC x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k
      obtain ⟨Dk, hDk0, hDk⟩ := ih k
      obtain ⟨D0, hD00, hD0⟩ := ih 0
      obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hb m k
      refine ⟨max Dk (Cb + 2 * |κ| * Dk
          + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * Dk * D0),
        le_trans hDk0 (le_max_left _ _), fun j hj x => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (m + 1) with hjm | hjm
      · exact (hDk j (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjm) x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · have hj' : j = m + 1 := le_antisymm hj hjm
        subst hj'
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right _ _)
        have hxk : 0 ≤ |x| ^ k := pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) k
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrec m x) hxk
        have h2 := hCb x
        have h3 : |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv m w x| ≤ Dk := hDk m le_rfl x
        have h4 : |x| ^ k * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
            (m.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i w x| * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) w x| ≤
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * Dk * D0 := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
          have hi' : i ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)
          have e1 := hDk i hi' x
          have e2 : |iteratedDeriv (m - i) w x| ≤ D0 := by
            have := hD0 (m - i) (Nat.sub_le m i) x
            simpa using this
          have e3 : |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv i w x| * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) w x| ≤ Dk * D0 :=
            mul_le_mul e1 e2 (abs_nonneg _) hDk0
          have e4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (Nat.cast_nonneg (m.choose i) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m.choose i)
          calc |x| ^ k * ((m.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i w x| * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) w x|)
              = (m.choose i : ℝ) * (|x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv i w x| * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) w x|) := by
                ring
            _ ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) * (Dk * D0) := e4
            _ = (m.choose i : ℝ) * Dk * D0 := by ring
        have h5 : |x| ^ k * (2 * |κ| * |iteratedDeriv m w x|) ≤ 2 * |κ| * Dk := by
          calc |x| ^ k * (2 * |κ| * |iteratedDeriv m w x|)
              = 2 * |κ| * (|x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv m w x|) := by ring
            _ ≤ 2 * |κ| * Dk := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
        rw [mul_add, mul_add] at h1
        linarith
  
  refine ⟨⟨w, contDiff_infty.2 hsm, fun k n => ?_⟩, fun x => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, -, hDn⟩ := hQ n k
  refine ⟨D, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact hDn n le_rfl x

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q Wp Wm : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hp : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Wp : ℝ → ℝ) (q x + 2 * κ * Wp x - Wp x ^ 2) x)
    (hm : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Wm : ℝ → ℝ) (q x - 2 * κ * Wm x - Wm x ^ 2) x) :
    ∃ c > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, c ≤ 2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x

signature.name: green_denominator_lower_bound
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q Wp Wm : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hp : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Wp : ℝ → ℝ) (q x + 2 * κ * Wp x - Wp x ^ 2) x)
    (hm : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Wm : ℝ → ℝ) (q x - 2 * κ * Wm x - Wm x ^ 2) x) :
    ∃ c > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, c ≤ 2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set s : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Wm x + Wp x with hs_def
  set D : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x with hD_def
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, s t with hG_def
  have hsc : Continuous s := Wm.continuous.add Wp.continuous
  have hsi : Integrable s volume :=
    (Wm.integrable (μ := volume)).add (Wp.integrable (μ := volume))
  
  have hDd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt D (-(s x) * D x) x := by
    intro x
    have h := ((hm x).const_add (2 * κ)).sub (hp x)
    convert h using 1
    simp only [hs_def, hD_def]
    ring
  
  have hGd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (s x) x := fun x =>
    (hsc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt
  have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by simp [hG_def]
  
  have hP : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => D y * Real.exp (G y)) 0 x := by
    intro x
    have h := (hDd x).mul (hGd x).exp
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hPc : ∀ x : ℝ, D x * Real.exp (G x) = D 0 := by
    intro x
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => D y * Real.exp (G y)) :=
      fun y => (hP y).differentiableAt
    have := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hdiff (fun y => (hP y).deriv) x 0
    simpa [hG0] using this
  have hrep : ∀ x : ℝ, D x = D 0 * Real.exp (-G x) := by
    intro x
    rw [← hPc x, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  
  have haux : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → |∫ t in a..b, s t| ≤ ∫ t, |s t| := by
    intro a b hab
    calc |∫ t in a..b, s t| ≤ ∫ t in a..b, |s t| :=
          intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hab
      _ = ∫ t in Set.Ioc a b, |s t| := intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab
      _ ≤ ∫ t, |s t| :=
          setIntegral_le_integral hsi.abs (ae_of_all _ fun t => abs_nonneg _)
  have hGb : ∀ x : ℝ, |G x| ≤ ∫ t, |s t| := by
    intro x
    rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx | hx
    · exact haux 0 x hx
    · show |∫ t in (0:ℝ)..x, s t| ≤ _
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm, abs_neg]
      exact haux x 0 hx.le
  
  have hWm : Filter.Tendsto (Wm : ℝ → ℝ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty Wm).mono_left atTop_le_cocompact
  have hWp : Filter.Tendsto (Wp : ℝ → ℝ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty Wp).mono_left atTop_le_cocompact
  have hDlim : Filter.Tendsto D Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * κ + 0 - 0)) :=
    (tendsto_const_nhds.add hWm).sub hWp
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x in Filter.atTop, κ < D x :=
    hDlim.eventually_const_lt (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hev.exists
  have hD0 : 0 < D 0 := by
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg

    (contDiff_const.add (Wm.smooth ⊤)).sub (Wp.smooth ⊤)

      (∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, v x = 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 q x) - 1) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, U q x = 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 q x) - 1 := by
    refine ⟨fun q => if h : ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, v x = 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 q x) - 1
      then Classical.choose h else 0, fun q h x => ?_⟩
    simp only [dif_pos h]
    exact Classical.choose_spec h x
  refine ⟨min (1 / 16) δG, lt_min (by norm_num) hδG, 7, by norm_num, U, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  have hq16 : ‖toHm1 q‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := le_trans hq (min_le_left _ _)
  have hqG : ‖ι q‖ ≤ δG := le_trans hq (min_le_right _ _)
  have hq8 : ‖toHm1 q‖ ≤ 1 / 8 := by linarith
  have hn2 : ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 256 := by
    calc ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 16) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq16 2
      _ = 1 / 256 := by norm_num
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  
  
  
  have hqt : ‖toHm1 (Rf q)‖ ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    rw [toHm1_norm_comp_neg q (Rf q) (hR q)]
    exact hq8
  obtain ⟨Wp, hp, hP⟩ := hsolL2 q hq8
  obtain ⟨Wt, hWt, hT⟩ := hsolL2 (Rf q) hqt
  rw [toHm1_norm_comp_neg q (Rf q) (hR q)] at hT
  obtain ⟨Wm, hWm⟩ : ∃ Wm : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, Wm x = -Wt (-x) :=
    ⟨Rf (-Wt), fun x => by rw [hR]; simp⟩
  have hWmd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Wm : ℝ → ℝ) (q x - 2 * 1 * Wm x - Wm x ^ 2) x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (Wt : ℝ → ℝ)
        (Rf q (0 - x) + 2 * 1 * Wt (0 - x) - Wt (0 - x) ^ 2) (0 - x) := hWt (0 - x)
    have h3 := (h1.comp_const_sub 0 x).neg
    have h4 : HasDerivAt (Wm : ℝ → ℝ)
        (-(-(Rf q (0 - x) + 2 * 1 * Wt (0 - x) - Wt (0 - x) ^ 2))) x :=
      h3.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [hWm])
    convert h4 using 1
    rw [hWm, hR]
    simp only [zero_sub, neg_neg]
    ring
  have hM : (∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) ≤ 64 / 49 * ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 := by
    have e : (fun x : ℝ => Wm x ^ 2) = fun x => (fun y : ℝ => Wt y ^ 2) (-x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hWm]
      ring
    have e2 : (∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) = ∫ x : ℝ, Wt x ^ 2 := by
      rw [e]
      exact integral_neg_eq_self (fun y : ℝ => Wt y ^ 2) volume
    rw [e2]
    exact hT
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hlow⟩ := green_denominator_lower_bound 1 one_pos q Wp Wm hp hWmd
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := green_offset_schwartz 1 one_pos Wp Wm c hc hlow
  have hDpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < 2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x := fun x => lt_of_lt_of_le hc (hlow x)
  have hode : GreenODE 1 q γ := green_ode_of_riccati_pair 1 one_pos q Wp Wm γ hp hWmd hDpos hγ
  have hex : ∃ γ' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), GreenODE 1 q γ' := ⟨γ, hode⟩
  have hgo : greenOffset 1 q = γ := by
    have e : greenOffset 1 q = Classical.choose hex := by
      unfold greenOffset
      rw [dif_pos hex]
    rw [e]
    exact (hEU 1 le_rfl q hqG).unique (Classical.choose_spec hex) hode
  have hform : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 q x) - 1 = (Wm x - Wp x) / 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [hgo, hγ x]
    have e1 : 1 + 2 * (1 / (2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x) - 1 / (2 * 1)) = 2 / (2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x) := by
      ring
    rw [e1, one_div_div]
    ring
  
  
  
  have hexU : ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, v x = 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 q x) - 1 :=
    ⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (Wm - Wp), fun x => by
      rw [hform x]
      simp only [SchwartzMap.smul_apply, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring⟩
  have hUi := hUdef q hexU
  have hu : ∀ x : ℝ, U q x = (Wm x - Wp x) / 2 := fun x => (hUi x).trans (hform x)
  
  
  
  have hUfun : (U q : ℝ → ℝ) = fun x => (Wm x - Wp x) / 2 := funext hu
  have hderivU : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x = -(1 + U q x) * (Wm x + Wp x) := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (U q : ℝ → ℝ)
        (((q x - 2 * 1 * Wm x - Wm x ^ 2) - (q x + 2 * 1 * Wp x - Wp x ^ 2)) / 2) x := by
      rw [hUfun]
      exact ((hWmd x).sub (hp x)).div_const 2
    rw [h1.deriv, hu x]
    ring
  have iP := (Wp.memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).integrable_sq
  have iM := (Wm.memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).integrable_sq
  have iU := ((U q).memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).integrable_sq
  have iG := (γ.memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).integrable_sq
  have iD : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) volume := by
    have := ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (U q)).memLp 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)).integrable_sq
    simpa only [SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply] using this
  have iMP : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Wm x ^ 2 + Wp x ^ 2) volume := iM.add iP
  have hIMP : (∫ x : ℝ, (Wm x ^ 2 + Wp x ^ 2)) = (∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) + ∫ x : ℝ, Wp x ^ 2 :=
    integral_add iM iP
  have hAT : (∫ x : ℝ, U q x ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 * ((∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) + ∫ x : ℝ, Wp x ^ 2) := by
    rw [← hIMP, ← integral_const_mul]
    refine integral_mono iU (iMP.const_mul _) (fun x => ?_)
    show U q x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 * (Wm x ^ 2 + Wp x ^ 2)
    rw [hu x]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Wm x + Wp x)]
  have hAgU := agmon (U q)
  have hB : (∫ x : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) ≤
      (4 + 8 * (Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, U q y ^ 2) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2))) *
        ((∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) + ∫ x : ℝ, Wp x ^ 2) := by
    rw [← hIMP, ← integral_const_mul]
    refine integral_mono iD (iMP.const_mul _) (fun x => ?_)
    show deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 ≤ (4 + 8 * (Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, U q y ^ 2) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2))) * (Wm x ^ 2 + Wp x ^ 2)
    rw [hderivU x]
    have h1 := hAgU x
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (Wm x + Wp x) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have h3 : (Wm x + Wp x) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (Wm x ^ 2 + Wp x ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Wm x - Wp x)]
    have h4 : (1 + U q x) ^ 2 ≤ 2 + 2 * U q x ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - U q x)]
    have h5 : (1 + U q x) ^ 2 ≤ 2 + 4 * (Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, U q y ^ 2) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2)) := by nlinarith
    have hab : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, U q y ^ 2) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2) :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    calc (-(1 + U q x) * (Wm x + Wp x)) ^ 2 = (1 + U q x) ^ 2 * (Wm x + Wp x) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 + 4 * (Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, U q y ^ 2) *
          Real.sqrt (∫ y : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) y ^ 2))) * (2 * (Wm x ^ 2 + Wp x ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul h5 h3 h2 (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have alg : ∀ A B T : ℝ, 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ T → T ≤ 1 / 40 → A ≤ 1 / 2 * T →
      B ≤ (4 + 8 * (Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B)) * T →
      B + 4 * A ≤ 16 * T ∧ 2 * Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    intro A B T hA hB hT hT1 hAT hBT
    have ha : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt A := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hb : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt B := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have ha2 : Real.sqrt A ^ 2 = A := Real.sq_sqrt hA
    have hb2 : Real.sqrt B ^ 2 = B := Real.sq_sqrt hB
    have hamgm : 8 * (Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B) * T ≤
        Real.sqrt B ^ 2 / 2 + 32 * Real.sqrt A ^ 2 * T ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt B - 8 * Real.sqrt A * T)]
    have hB1 : B ≤ 8 * T + 64 * A * T ^ 2 := by
      rw [ha2, hb2] at hamgm
      nlinarith
    have hT2 : T ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 1600 := by nlinarith
    have hAT2 : A * T ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 * T * (1 / 1600) :=
      mul_le_mul hAT hT2 (sq_nonneg T) (by linarith)
    have hB9 : B ≤ 9 * T := by nlinarith
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    have e : (2 * Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B) ^ 2 = 4 * A * B := by
      have e0 : (2 * Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B) ^ 2 = 4 * Real.sqrt A ^ 2 * Real.sqrt B ^ 2 := by
        ring
      rw [e0, ha2, hb2]
    have hAB : A * B ≤ 1 / 2 * T * (9 * T) := mul_le_mul hAT hB9 hB (by linarith)
    have h4 : (2 * Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4) ^ 2 := by
      rw [e]
      nlinarith
    exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h4 (by norm_num)).2
  have hTsum : (∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) + (∫ x : ℝ, Wp x ^ 2) ≤ 128 / 49 * ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 := by
    linarith
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ (∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) + (∫ x : ℝ, Wp x ^ 2) :=
    add_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, U q x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨hN1, h2ab⟩ := alg _ _ _ hA0 hB0 hT0 (by linarith) hAT hB
  
  
  
  have hγU : ∀ x : ℝ, γ x ^ 2 ≤ U q x ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    have hv : U q x ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have := (hAgU x).trans h2ab
      nlinarith
    have hv' := (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hv (by norm_num)).1
    have hDx : 2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x = 2 + 2 * U q x := by rw [hu x]; ring
    have hD1 : 1 ≤ 2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x := by rw [hDx]; linarith
    have hD0 : 2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hγx : γ x * (2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x) = -U q x := by
      rw [hγ x, sub_mul, one_div_mul_cancel hD0, hu x]
      ring
    have e : U q x ^ 2 = (γ x * (2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x)) ^ 2 := by rw [hγx]; ring
    have hD2 : 1 ≤ (2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc γ x ^ 2 = γ x ^ 2 * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ γ x ^ 2 * (2 * 1 + Wm x - Wp x) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD2 (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = U q x ^ 2 := by rw [e]; ring
  have hGU : (∫ x : ℝ, γ x ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, U q x ^ 2 := integral_mono iG iU hγU
  have hγn : ‖toHm1 γ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (7 * ‖toHm1 q‖) ^ 2 := by
    have := hL2 γ
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hUi, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsplit : (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (U q x) ^ 2) =
        (∫ x : ℝ, deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2) + 4 * ∫ x : ℝ, U q x ^ 2 := by
      rw [integral_add iD (iU.const_mul 4), integral_const_mul]
    rw [hsplit]
    show _ ≤ 7 ^ 2 * ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2
    nlinarith
  · rw [hgo]
    show ‖toHm1 γ‖ ≤ 7 * ‖toHm1 q‖
    exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hγn (by positivity)).2

by

  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := toHm1_clm
  refine ⟨1 / 8, by norm_num, 7, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ q hq

  have hL1 : ∀ h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι h‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |h x| := by
    intro h

    show ‖toHm1 h‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |h x|
    by_cases hm : MemLp (hm1Profile h) 2 volume
    · have hsq : ‖toHm1 h‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x : ℝ, |h x|) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← (Hm1_weight_basic (toHm1 h)).1]
        have e1 : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) *
            ‖(toHm1 h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) =
            ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * (1 : ℝ) ^ 2)) * ‖hm1Profile h ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
          unfold toHm1
          rw [dif_pos hm]
          exact integral_congr_ae (hm.coeFn_toLp.mono fun ξ hξ => by simp only [hξ])
        rw [e1]
        have hF : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine h ξ‖ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, |h x| := by
          intro ξ
          unfold fourierLine

        ring
      have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => D y ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have := (ht D).pow 2

        ((D.continuous.pow 2).continuousWithinAt) (fun y _ => hderiv y) hint.integrableOn hlim
      have e1 : D x ^ 2 ≤ |∫ y in Set.Ioi x, 2 * D y * D' y| := by

        rw [← integral_const_mul]

        funext y
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
        ring
      linarith
    
    have hint2 : (∫ y : ℝ, |D y| * |D' y|) ≤ (2 * κ + M) * (2 * S) := by
      have h1 : (∫ y : ℝ, |D y| * |D' y|) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, (2 * κ + M) * (Wp y ^ 2 + Wm y ^ 2) :=
        integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun y => by positivity) (iSum.const_mul _)
          (ae_of_all _ fun y => hpt y)
      rw [integral_const_mul, hsumint] at h1
      have h2 : (2 * κ + M) * ((∫ x : ℝ, Wp x ^ 2) + ∫ x : ℝ, Wm x ^ 2) ≤ (2 * κ + M) * (2 * S) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by linarith)
      linarith
    
    have hκS : 0 ≤ κ * S := mul_nonneg hκ0.le hS0
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ 16 * κ * S + 4 * S * M := by positivity
    have hDsq : ∀ y : ℝ, D y ^ 2 ≤ 16 * κ * S + 4 * S * M := by
      intro y
      have h1 := hAg y
      nlinarith
    have hMle : M ≤ Real.sqrt (16 * κ * S + 4 * S * M) := by
      have := ciSup_le fun y => Real.abs_le_sqrt (hDsq y)
      rwa [← hMdef] at this
    have hM2 : M ^ 2 ≤ 16 * κ * S + 4 * S * M := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ hM0 hMle 2
      rwa [Real.sq_sqrt hX0] at this
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (κ * S) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hr2 : Real.sqrt (κ * S) ^ 2 = κ * S := Real.sq_sqrt hκS
    have hMB : M ≤ 4 * S + 4 * Real.sqrt (κ * S) := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hMpos : 0 < M := by linarith
      nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcon hMpos,
        mul_nonneg hr0 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M - 4 * Real.sqrt (κ * S))]
    intro x

    exact (hDM x).trans hMB
  
  
  
  have hDk : ∀ x : ℝ, |Wm x - Wp x| ≤ κ := by
    intro x
    have h1 : κ * S ≤ (κ / 7) ^ 2 := by

      nlinarith
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (κ * S) ≤ κ / 7 := by
      calc Real.sqrt (κ * S) ≤ Real.sqrt ((κ / 7) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
        _ = κ / 7 := Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
    have h3 := hsup x
    linarith
  have hlow : ∀ x : ℝ, κ ≤ 2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x := fun x => by
    have := (abs_le.1 (hDk x)).1; linarith
  have hhigh : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x ≤ 3 * κ := fun x => by
    have := (abs_le.1 (hDk x)).2; linarith
  have hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < 2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x := fun x => lt_of_lt_of_le hκ0 (hlow x)

  have hex : ∃ γ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), GreenODE κ q γ := ⟨γ, hγode⟩
  have hgo : GreenODE κ q (greenOffset κ q) := by

    rw [dif_pos hex]
    exact Classical.choose_spec hex
  have hgeq : greenOffset κ q = γ :=
    green_unique_of_pos κ hκ0 q γ (greenOffset κ q) hγode hgo
      ⟨1 / (3 * κ), by positivity, fun x => by
        rw [hγ x]
        have : 1 / (3 * κ) ≤ 1 / (2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x) :=

  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, s x = 1 / 2 * (Wp x + Wm x) :=

  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, A x = deriv (s : ℝ → ℝ) x :=

  have hAx : ∀ x : ℝ, A x = q x - κ * (Wm x - Wp x) - 1 / 2 * (Wp x ^ 2 + Wm x ^ 2) := by

  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), R = (q + (4 * κ ^ 3) • γ) - A := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRx : ∀ x : ℝ, R x = 1 / 2 * (Wp x ^ 2 + Wm x ^ 2)

    intro x

    simp only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hγ x, hAx x]
    have hu : 1 / (2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x) * (2 * κ + Wm x - Wp x) = 1 :=
      one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt (hpos x))
    have hv : 1 / (2 * κ) * (2 * κ) = 1 := one_div_mul_cancel (by positivity)
    have hdiv : κ * (Wm x - Wp x) ^ 2 / (2 * κ + (Wm x - Wp x)) =

      rw [mul_one_div]

      ring
    rw [hdiv]
    linear_combination (κ * (2 * κ - (Wm x - Wp x))) * hu - (2 * κ ^ 2) * hv
  have hfAR : q + (4 * κ ^ 3) • γ = A + R := by rw [hRdef]; abel
  have hιadd : ∀ a b : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ι (a + b) = ι a + ι b := fun a b =>
    Subtype.ext (by
      show toHm1 (a + b) = toHm1 a + toHm1 b

  have hAbd : ‖ι A‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt S := by
    refine (hderivbd s A hA).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_) (by norm_num))
    have h1 : (∫ x : ℝ, s x ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, 1 / 2 * (Wp x ^ 2 + Wm x ^ 2) := by

      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Wp x - Wm x)]
    rw [integral_const_mul, hsumint] at h1
    linarith
  
  
  
  have hRpt : ∀ x : ℝ, |R x| ≤ 5 / 2 * (Wp x ^ 2 + Wm x ^ 2) := by
    intro x

    have hl := hlow x

    have hq0 : 0 ≤ κ * (Wm x - Wp x) ^ 2 / (2 * κ + (Wm x - Wp x)) := by positivity
    have hq1 : κ * (Wm x - Wp x) ^ 2 / (2 * κ + (Wm x - Wp x)) ≤ (Wm x - Wp x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]

      nlinarith
    have hq2 : (Wm x - Wp x) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (Wp x ^ 2 + Wm x ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Wp x + Wm x)]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    linarith
  have hRbd : ‖ι R‖ ≤ 5 * S := by
    refine (hL1 R).trans ?_
    have h1 : (∫ x : ℝ, |R x|) ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, 5 / 2 * (Wp x ^ 2 + Wm x ^ 2) :=
      integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun x => abs_nonneg _) (iSum.const_mul _)
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => hRpt x)
    rw [integral_const_mul, hsumint] at h1
    linarith
  
  
  
  have hsqW : Real.sqrt S = 8 / 7 * Real.sqrt W := by
    have hSeq : S = (8 / 7 * Real.sqrt W) ^ 2 := by

    rw [hSeq, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  have hsW0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg W
  rw [hfAR, hιadd]
  calc ‖ι A + ι R‖ ≤ ‖ι A‖ + ‖ι R‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt S + 5 * S := add_le_add hAbd hRbd
    _ ≤ 7 * (W + Real.sqrt W) := by rw [hsqW, hSdef]; nlinarith

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sq_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 =
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_fixed_point
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hmem : MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hsmall : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 64) :
    (∃ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w) ∧
    (∀ w v : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → IsRiccatiSol κ q v → w = v) ∧
    (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, IsRiccatiSol κ q w → riccatiAlpha κ q = ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2) ∧
    49 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 81 / 64 * riccatiAlpha κ q

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_sol_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hw : IsRiccatiSol κ q w) :
    Continuous w ∧ (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |w x| ≤ C) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto w Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
    ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (q x + 2 * κ * w x - w x ^ 2) x

subgoal_signatures.name: riccati_sol_rapid_decay

(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w : ℝ → ℝ)

      MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => f y * g y)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => f y * g y) x ^ 2) ≤
        1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2)))

informal_problem.statement:
∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ (2 : ℝ), ∀ r u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      (∀ s : ℝ, ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => ι (r σ)) (ι v) s ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, v x = kdvRHS (r s) x - hkRHS κ (r s) x) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, ‖ι (r s)‖ ≤ δ) →
      (∀ σ x : ℝ, u σ x = 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 (r σ) x) - 1) →
      ∀ s : ℝ, ∃ F D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        (∀ x : ℝ, F x = 2 * (r s x + (4 * κ ^ 5 / (κ ^ 2 - 1)) * greenOffset κ (r s) x
            - (4 / (κ ^ 2 - 1)) * greenOffset 1 (r s) x) * (1 + u s x)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, D x = deriv (F : ℝ → ℝ) x) ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => ι (u σ)) (ι D) s

    have d1 : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) x) x :=

        HasDerivAt (deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ)) (iteratedDeriv 2 (f : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by

        rw [e2 f, e1 f, e1 (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f)]

  refine ⟨min (1 / 8) δG, lt_min (by norm_num) hδG, ?_⟩

subgoal_signatures.statement:

        (1 + 2 * γ x) * deriv (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ)) x - (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2
          - 4 * γ x - 4 * γ x ^ 2 := by
    intro r γ hγ x
    obtain ⟨γ₁, h1⟩ : ∃ γ₁ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑γ₁ :=
      ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ, funext fun y => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ γ y).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨γ₂, h2⟩ : ∃ γ₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), deriv (γ₁ : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑γ₂ :=
      ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₁, funext fun y => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ γ₁ y).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨γ₃, h3⟩ : ∃ γ₃ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), deriv (γ₂ : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑γ₃ :=
      ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₂, funext fun y => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ γ₂ y).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr1⟩ : ∃ r₁ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), deriv (r : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑r₁ :=
      ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ r, funext fun y => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ r y).symm⟩
    have hH : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑g → ∀ y : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g y) y := by
      intro f g hfg y
      have := (f.differentiableAt (x := y)).hasDerivAt
      rwa [hfg] at this
    have dγ := hH γ γ₁ h1
    have dγ₁ := hH γ₁ γ₂ h2
    have dγ₂ := hH γ₂ γ₃ h3
    have dr := hH r r₁ hr1
    
    have hG : ∀ y : ℝ, γ₃ y = r₁ y * (1 + 2 * γ y) + 4 * r y * γ₁ y + 4 * γ₁ y := by
      intro y
      have e := hγ y
      have hg : deriv (fun z => 1 / (2 * (1 : ℝ)) + γ z) = ⇑γ₁ := by
        rw [← h1]
        funext z
        exact deriv_const_add _
      have e3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (fun z => 1 / (2 * (1 : ℝ)) + γ z) y = γ₃ y := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hg, h2, h3]
      have em : deriv (fun z => r z * (1 / (2 * (1 : ℝ)) + γ z)) y =
          r₁ y * (1 / (2 * 1) + γ y) + r y * γ₁ y :=
        ((dr y).mul ((dγ y).const_add (1 / (2 * (1 : ℝ))))).deriv
      rw [e3, em, hg] at e
      linear_combination e
    
    obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ, R = fun z => -((1 + 2 * γ z) * γ₂ z) + γ₁ z * γ₁ z
        + r z * ((1 + 2 * γ z) * (1 + 2 * γ z)) + 4 * γ z + 4 * (γ z * γ z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hR0 : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt R 0 y := by
      intro y
      have hs : HasDerivAt (fun z => 1 + 2 * γ z) (2 * γ₁ y) y :=
        ((dγ y).const_mul 2).const_add 1
      have hR := (((((hs.mul (dγ₂ y)).neg.add ((dγ₁ y).mul (dγ₁ y))).add
        ((dr y).mul (hs.mul hs))).add ((dγ y).const_mul 4)).add (((dγ y).mul (dγ y)).const_mul 4))
      rw [hRdef]
      convert hR using 1
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      linear_combination (1 + 2 * γ y) * hG y
    have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hR0 y).differentiableAt)
      (fun y => (hR0 y).deriv)
    have hs0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun z => 1 + 2 * γ z) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 + 2 * 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.add ((ht γ).const_mul 2)
    have L := (((((hs0.mul (ht γ₂)).neg.add ((ht γ₁).mul (ht γ₁))).add
      ((ht r).mul (hs0.mul hs0))).add ((ht γ).const_mul 4)).add (((ht γ).mul (ht γ)).const_mul 4))
    have L' : Filter.Tendsto R Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      rw [hRdef]
      convert L using 2
      norm_num
    have hRc : R = fun _ => R x := funext fun z => hconst z x
    rw [hRc] at L'
    have hRx : R x = 0 := tendsto_const_nhds_iff.1 L'
    rw [hRdef] at hRx
    dsimp only at hRx
    rw [h1, h2]
    linear_combination hRx
  
  
  
  have inv7 : ∀ (r γ v A : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ x : ℝ, r x * (1 + 2 * γ x) ^ 2 =
        (1 + 2 * γ x) * deriv (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ)) x - (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2
          - 4 * γ x - 4 * γ x ^ 2) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 + 2 * γ x ≠ 0) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, v x = 1 / (1 + 2 * γ x) - 1) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, A x = -2 * (1 + v x) * deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x = (1 + v x) * A x) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, r x = 2 * v x + v x ^ 2 - 1 / 2 * deriv (A : ℝ → ℝ) x + 1 / 4 * A x ^ 2 := by
    intro r γ v A hfi hne hv hA
    have hvfun : (v : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => (1 + 2 * γ y)⁻¹ - 1 :=
      funext fun y => by rw [hv y, one_div]
    have hdv : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x = (1 + v x) * A x := by
      intro x
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => 1 + 2 * γ y) (2 * deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x) x :=
        ((γ.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).const_mul 2).const_add 1
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (v : ℝ → ℝ)
          (-(2 * deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x) / (1 + 2 * γ x) ^ 2) x := by
        rw [hvfun]
        exact (h1.inv (hne x)).sub_const 1
      have hs := hne x
      rw [h2.deriv, hA x, hv x]
      field_simp
      ring
    refine ⟨hdv, fun x => ?_⟩
    have hγ1 : deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ) :=
      funext fun y => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ γ y).symm
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ)) (deriv (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ)) x) x := by
      rw [hγ1]
      exact (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => -2 * (1 + v y) * deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) y)
        (-2 * deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x
          + -2 * (1 + v x) * deriv (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ)) x) x := by
      have h3 := ((v.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt.const_add 1).const_mul (-2)).mul hd1
      convert h3 using 1
    have hAfun : (A : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => -2 * (1 + v y) * deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) y := funext hA
    have hdA : deriv (A : ℝ → ℝ) x = -2 * deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x * deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x
          + -2 * (1 + v x) * deriv (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ)) x := by
      rw [hAfun]
      exact hd2.deriv
    have hs := hne x
    have hr : r x = ((1 + 2 * γ x) * deriv (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ)) x - (deriv (γ : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2
          - 4 * γ x - 4 * γ x ^ 2) / (1 + 2 * γ x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 hs)]
      exact hfi x
    rw [hdA, hdv x, hA x, hr, hv x]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  
  
  have hL₁pos : 0 < L₁ := by linarith
  refine ⟨min δ₁ (min δG (1 / (4 * L₁))), lt_min hδ₁ (lt_min hδG (by positivity)), 6,
    by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro q p u w hq hp hu hw
  
  
  
  have side : ∀ (r v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι r‖ ≤ min δ₁ (min δG (1 / (4 * L₁))) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, v x = 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 r x) - 1) →
      (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 16 ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, |v x| ≤ 1 / 4) ∧
      ∃ A : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x = (1 + v x) * A x) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, r x = 2 * v x + v x ^ 2 - 1 / 2 * deriv (A : ℝ → ℝ) x + 1 / 4 * A x ^ 2 := by
    intro r v hr hv
    have hr1 : ‖ι r‖ ≤ δ₁ := hr.trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hrG : ‖ι r‖ ≤ δG := hr.trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hrL : ‖ι r‖ ≤ 1 / (4 * L₁) := hr.trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    obtain ⟨hUf, hN, -⟩ := hU r hr1
    have hvU : (v : ℝ → ℝ) = (U r : ℝ → ℝ) := funext fun x => by rw [hv x, hUf x]
    have hN1 : (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (v x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      rw [hvU]
      refine hN.trans ?_
      have h1 : ‖ι r‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (4 * L₁)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hrL 2
      have h2 : L₁ ^ 2 * (1 / (4 * L₁)) ^ 2 = 1 / 16 := by
        field_simp
        ring
      calc L₁ ^ 2 * ‖ι r‖ ^ 2 ≤ L₁ ^ 2 * (1 / (4 * L₁)) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = 1 / 16 := h2
    have hsp := hsplit v
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, v x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
    have hv1 : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
    have hd : (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (v : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith
    have habs : ∀ x : ℝ, |v x| ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      intro x
      have h1 := hsupN v x
      have h2 : v x ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4) ^ 2 := by linarith
      exact abs_le.2 (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h2 (by norm_num))
    have hne : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 r x ≠ 0 := by
      intro x h0
      have h1 := hv x
      rw [h0, div_zero, zero_sub] at h1
      have h2 := habs x
      rw [h1] at h2
      norm_num at h2
    have hex : ∃ γ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), GreenODE 1 r γ := (hEU 1 le_rfl r hrG).exists
    have hode : GreenODE 1 r (greenOffset 1 r) := by
      have e : greenOffset 1 r = Classical.choose hex := by
        unfold greenOffset
        rw [dif_pos hex]
      rw [e]
      exact Classical.choose_spec hex
    have hfi := fi6 r (greenOffset 1 r) hode
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ,
        A x = -2 * (1 + v x) * deriv (greenOffset 1 r : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      ⟨(-2 : ℝ) • (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (greenOffset 1 r)
          + Mul v (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (greenOffset 1 r))), fun x => by
        simp only [SchwartzMap.smul_apply, SchwartzMap.add_apply, hMul,
          SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring⟩
    obtain ⟨h7a, h7b⟩ := inv7 r (greenOffset 1 r) v A hfi hne hv hA
    exact ⟨hd, habs, A, h7a, h7b⟩
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨hdu, habu, A, hAu, hqA⟩ := side q u hq hu
  obtain ⟨hdw, habw, B, hBw, hpB⟩ := side p w hp hw
  obtain ⟨s81, s82, s83⟩ := s8 u w A B habu habw hAu hBw hdu hdw
  set M := ∫ y : ℝ, (deriv ((u - w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) y) ^ 2 + 4 * ((u - w) y) ^ 2 with hMdef
  obtain ⟨S₃, hS₃⟩ : ∃ S₃ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S₃ x = (A - B) x * (A + B) x :=
    ⟨Mul (A - B) (A + B), hMul _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, D x = deriv ((A - B : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (A - B), fun x => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ (A - B) x⟩
  have hDx : ∀ x : ℝ, D x = deriv (A : ℝ → ℝ) x - deriv (B : ℝ → ℝ) x := by
    intro x
    have e : ((A - B : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => A y - B y :=
      funext fun y => SchwartzMap.sub_apply
    rw [hD x, e]
    exact deriv_sub A.differentiableAt B.differentiableAt
  obtain ⟨S₁, hS₁⟩ : ∃ S₁ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), S₁ = (q - p) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • D - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • S₃ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS₁x : ∀ x : ℝ, S₁ x = (u x - w x) * (u x + w x + 2) := by
    intro x
    rw [hS₁]
    simp only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hDx, hS₃, hqA x, hpB x]
    simp only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.add_apply]
    ring
  have hqp : q - p = S₁ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • D + (1 / 4 : ℝ) • S₃ := by
    rw [hS₁]
    abel
  have hdist : dist (ι q) (ι p) ≤ ‖ι S₁‖ + 1 / 2 * ‖ι D‖ + 1 / 4 * ‖ι S₃‖ := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← hιsub, hqp, hιadd, hιsub, hιsmul, hιsmul]
    calc ‖ι S₁ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ι D + (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ι S₃‖
        ≤ ‖ι S₁ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ι D‖ + ‖(1 / 4 : ℝ) • ι S₃‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖ι S₁‖ + ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • ι D‖ + ‖(1 / 4 : ℝ) • ι S₃‖ :=
          add_le_add (norm_sub_le _ _) le_rfl
      _ = ‖ι S₁‖ + 1 / 2 * ‖ι D‖ + 1 / 4 * ‖ι S₃‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4)]
  have hsqrt : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * M) = c * Real.sqrt M := fun c hc => by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc]
  have b1 : ‖ι S₁‖ ≤ 1 / 2 * (5 / 4 * Real.sqrt M) := by
    refine (hL2a S₁).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num))
    have e : (∫ x : ℝ, S₁ x ^ 2) = ∫ x : ℝ, ((u x - w x) * (u x + w x + 2)) ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hS₁x]
    rw [e, ← hsqrt (5 / 4) (by norm_num)]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt

  have hAB : Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (A - B) x ^ 2) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt M := by
    have e : (∫ x : ℝ, (A - B) x ^ 2) = ∫ x : ℝ, (A x - B x) ^ 2 := by

    rw [e2]

    rw [e]
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt s82).trans_eq Real.sqrt_one
  have b2 : ‖ι D‖ ≤ 2 * (4 * Real.sqrt M) :=
    (s5 (A - B) D hD).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAB (by norm_num))
  have b3 : ‖ι S₃‖ ≤ 1 / 2 * (4 * Real.sqrt M * 1) := by
    refine (hL2b (A - B) (A + B) S₃ hS₃).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num))

  have hN : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt M := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  linarith [hdist, b1, b2, b3, hN]

subgoal_signatures.name: green_one_good_unknown
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∃ L ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∃ U : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ →
      (∀ x : ℝ, U q x = 1 / (1 + 2 * greenOffset 1 q x) - 1) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (U q : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (U q x) ^ 2) ≤ L ^ 2 * ‖ι q‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖ι (greenOffset 1 q)‖ ≤ L * ‖ι q‖

subgoal_signatures.name: green_exists_unique
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ κ ≥ (1 : ℝ), ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ →
    ∃! γ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), GreenODE κ q γ

subgoal_signatures.name: toHm1_clm
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), L q = toHm1 q

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sq_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 =
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sqrt_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) :
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp (riccatiK κ f) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ f x ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => f y * g y)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => f y * g y) x ^ 2) ≤
        1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, f x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2)))

informal_problem.statement:
∀ a h p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, p x = a x * h x) →
    ‖ι p‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (a x) ^ 2) * ‖ι h‖

signature.name: hm1_multiplier_bound

∀ a h p : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, p x = a x * h x) →
    ‖ι p‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (a x) ^ 2) * ‖ι h‖

        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx'.le, ← setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same
          measurableSet_Ioi ((hint (x₀ - 1)).mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self) (hint x),
          Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx'.le, hA]
      have hK : riccatiK κ q x = -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, f y) := by
        unfold riccatiK
        rw [integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi, ← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun y _ => ?_
        rw [hh]
        simp only
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2
        ring
      rw [hK, hsplit]
      ring
    have hJ : HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, f y) (f x₀) x₀ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hcont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hcont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hcont.continuousAt
    have hE : HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.exp (2 * κ * x)) (Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (2 * κ)) x₀ := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id x₀).const_mul (2 * κ)).exp
      simpa using this
    have hP : HasDerivAt (fun x => -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, f y)))
        (-(Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (2 * κ) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x₀, f y) +
          Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (0 - f x₀))) x₀ :=
      (hE.mul ((hasDerivAt_const x₀ A).sub hJ)).neg
    have hev : riccatiK κ q =ᶠ[nhds x₀]
        fun x => -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x, f y)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds (by linarith : x₀ - 1 < x₀)) hrep
    have hval : -(Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (2 * κ) * (A - ∫ y in (x₀ - 1)..x₀, f y) +
          Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * (0 - f x₀)) = 2 * κ * riccatiK κ q x₀ + q x₀ := by
      rw [hrep x₀ (show x₀ - 1 < x₀ by linarith), hh]
      simp only
      have hEE : Real.exp (2 * κ * x₀) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * x₀) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        ring_nf
        exact Real.exp_zero
      linear_combination (q x₀) * hEE
    have hfin := hP.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    rw [hval] at hfin
    exact hfin
  
  have hGb : ∀ x : ℝ, |riccatiK 1 h x| ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, |h y| := by
    intro x
    unfold riccatiK
    rw [abs_neg]
    calc |∫ y in Set.Ici x, Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x - y)) * h y|
        ≤ ∫ y in Set.Ici x, |h y| := by
          rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
          refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (h.integrable (μ := volume)).abs.integrableOn
            (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ici fun y hy => ?_)
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
          refine mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 ?_)
          have : x ≤ y := hy
          linarith
      _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, |h y| :=
          setIntegral_le_integral (h.integrable (μ := volume)).abs
            (ae_of_all _ fun y => abs_nonneg _)
  
  obtain ⟨a1, ha1def⟩ : ∃ a1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), a1 = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha1 : ∀ y : ℝ, deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) y = a1 y := by
    intro y
    rw [ha1def, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
  have had : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (a : ℝ → ℝ) (a1 y) y := by
    intro y
    have := a.hasDerivAt y
    rw [ha1 y] at this
    exact this
  have hata : Filter.Tendsto (a : ℝ → ℝ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h0 := a.toZeroAtInfty.zero_at_infty'
    exact (h0.mono_left atTop_le_cocompact)
  have hGd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (riccatiK 1 h) (2 * 1 * riccatiK 1 h x + h x) x :=
    hd 1 one_pos h
  have hGc : Continuous (riccatiK 1 h) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hGd x).continuousAt
  have hKdef : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      riccatiK 1 f x = -∫ y in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x - y)) * f y := by
    intro f x
    unfold riccatiK
    rw [integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi]
  
  have hid : ∀ x₀ : ℝ, riccatiK 1 p x₀ =
      a x₀ * riccatiK 1 h x₀ - riccatiK 1 (fun y => a1 y * riccatiK 1 h y) x₀ := by
    intro x₀
    have hEc : Continuous fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) := by fun_prop
    have hE : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)))
        (Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (2 * 1 * (-1))) y := by
      intro y
      exact (((hasDerivAt_id' y).const_sub x₀).const_mul (2 * 1)).exp
    have hΦ : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (a y * riccatiK 1 h y))
        (Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (a1 y * riccatiK 1 h y)
          + Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * p y) y := by
      intro y
      have h1 := (hE y).mul ((had y).mul (hGd y))
      convert h1 using 1
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      rw [hp y]
      ring
    have hΦc : Continuous
        (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (a y * riccatiK 1 h y)) :=
      hEc.mul (a.continuous.mul hGc)
    have hu1 : IntegrableOn
        (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (a1 y * riccatiK 1 h y)) (Set.Ioi x₀) := by
      refine Integrable.mono'
        ((a1.integrable (μ := volume)).norm.const_mul (∫ y : ℝ, |h y|)).integrableOn
        (hEc.mul (a1.continuous.mul hGc)).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => ?_
      have hy' : x₀ < y := hy
      have hEle : Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le,
        Real.norm_eq_abs (riccatiK 1 h y)]
      have hb := hGb y
      have h0 := norm_nonneg (a1 y)
      have h2 := abs_nonneg (riccatiK 1 h y)
      calc Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (‖a1 y‖ * |riccatiK 1 h y|)
          ≤ 1 * (‖a1 y‖ * (∫ y : ℝ, |h y|)) :=
            mul_le_mul hEle (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb h0) (by positivity) zero_le_one
        _ = (∫ y : ℝ, |h y|) * ‖a1 y‖ := by ring
    have hu2 : IntegrableOn
        (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * p y) (Set.Ioi x₀) := by
      refine Integrable.mono' (p.integrable (μ := volume)).norm.integrableOn
        (hEc.mul p.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => ?_
      have hy' : x₀ < y := hy
      have hEle : Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hEle
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (a y * riccatiK 1 h y))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hC : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (∫ y : ℝ, |h y|) * |a y|)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have := (hata.abs).const_mul (∫ y : ℝ, |h y|)
        simpa using this
      refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hC
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop x₀] with y hy
      have hEle : Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hb := hGb y
      calc Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (|a y| * |riccatiK 1 h y|)
          ≤ 1 * (|a y| * (∫ y : ℝ, |h y|)) :=
            mul_le_mul hEle (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (abs_nonneg _)) (by positivity)

        _ = (∫ y : ℝ, |h y|) * |a y| := by ring
    have hftc := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      (f := fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (a y * riccatiK 1 h y))
      (f' := fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * (a1 y * riccatiK 1 h y)
          + Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - y)) * p y)
      hΦc.continuousWithinAt (fun y _ => hΦ y) (hu1.add hu2) hlim
    rw [integral_add hu1 hu2] at hftc
    have hE0 : Real.exp (2 * 1 * (x₀ - x₀)) = 1 := by simp
    beta_reduce at hftc
    rw [hE0] at hftc
    rw [hKdef (p : ℝ → ℝ) x₀, hKdef (fun y => a1 y * riccatiK 1 h y) x₀]
    linarith
  
  have ha1sq : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => a1 y ^ 2) volume := (a1.memLp 2).integrable_sq
  have hasq : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => a y ^ 2) volume := (a.memLp 2).integrable_sq
  obtain ⟨N, hNdef⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ, N = ∫ y : ℝ, a1 y ^ 2 + 4 * a y ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    intro x
    have hfd : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a y * a y) (a1 y * a y + a y * a1 y) y :=
      fun y => (had y).mul (had y)
    have hfi : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => a1 y * a y + a y * a1 y) volume := by
      refine Integrable.mono' (ha1sq.add hasq)
        ((a1.continuous.mul a.continuous).add (a.continuous.mul a1.continuous)).aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      show |a1 y * a y + a y * a1 y| ≤ a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a y + a1 y), sq_nonneg (a y - a1 y)]
    have hlim2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => a y * a y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have := hata.mul hata
      rwa [mul_zero] at this
    have hftc2 := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      (a := x) (f := fun y : ℝ => a y * a y) (f' := fun y : ℝ => a1 y * a y + a y * a1 y)
      (a.continuous.mul a.continuous).continuousWithinAt (fun y _ => hfd y) hfi.integrableOn hlim2
    have h1 : -(∫ y in Set.Ioi x, (a1 y * a y + a y * a1 y)) ≤
        ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, (a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2) := by
      rw [← integral_neg]
      refine setIntegral_mono hfi.neg.integrableOn (ha1sq.add hasq).integrableOn fun y => ?_
      show -(a1 y * a y + a y * a1 y) ≤ a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a y + a1 y)]
    have h2 : ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, (a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, (a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2) :=
      setIntegral_le_integral (ha1sq.add hasq) (ae_of_all _ fun y => by
        show (0 : ℝ) ≤ a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2
        positivity)
    have h3 : ∫ y : ℝ, (a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, (a1 y ^ 2 + 4 * a y ^ 2) :=
      integral_mono (ha1sq.add hasq) (ha1sq.add (hasq.const_mul 4)) fun y => by
        show a1 y ^ 2 + a y ^ 2 ≤ a1 y ^ 2 + 4 * a y ^ 2
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a y)]
    rw [hftc2] at h1
    rw [hNdef]
    have hsq : a x ^ 2 = a x * a x := sq (a x)
    linarith
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := by
    rw [hNdef]
    exact integral_nonneg fun y => by positivity
  have hA : ∫ y : ℝ, a1 y ^ 2 ≤ N := by
    rw [hNdef]
    exact integral_mono ha1sq (ha1sq.add (hasq.const_mul 4)) fun y => by
      show a1 y ^ 2 ≤ a1 y ^ 2 + 4 * a y ^ 2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a y)]
  
  have s4h := riccatiK_sq_integral 1 one_pos h
  have s4p := riccatiK_sq_integral 1 one_pos p
  rw [(Hm1_weight_basic (toHm1 h)).1] at s4h
  rw [(Hm1_weight_basic (toHm1 p)).1] at s4p
  have s5 := riccatiK_mul_bound 1 le_rfl (a1 : ℝ → ℝ) (riccatiK 1 h) (a1.memLp 2) s4h.1

    intro x
    rw [hid x]
    have hs := hsup x
    have hG2 := sq_nonneg (riccatiK 1 h x)
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hG2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a x * riccatiK 1 h x + riccatiK 1 (fun y => a1 y * riccatiK 1 h y) x)]
  have hint_le : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK 1 p x ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, (2 * N * riccatiK 1 h x ^ 2
      + 2 * riccatiK 1 (fun y => a1 y * riccatiK 1 h y) x ^ 2) :=
    integral_mono s4p.1.integrable_sq
      ((s4h.1.integrable_sq.const_mul (2 * N)).add (s5.1.integrable_sq.const_mul 2)) hpt
  rw [integral_add (s4h.1.integrable_sq.const_mul (2 * N)) (s5.1.integrable_sq.const_mul 2),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, s4p.2, s4h.2] at hint_le
  have s52 := s5.2
  rw [s4h.2] at s52
  have hN' : (∫ x : ℝ, (deriv (a : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (a x) ^ 2) = N := by
    rw [hNdef]
    congr 1
    funext y
    rw [ha1 y]
  have e1 : ‖ι p‖ = ‖toHm1 p‖ := rfl
  have e2 : ‖ι h‖ = ‖toHm1 h‖ := rfl
  rw [e1, e2, hN']
  have hsqN : Real.sqrt N ^ 2 = N := Real.sq_sqrt hN0
  have hR : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt N * ‖toHm1 h‖ := by positivity
  have hAY := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA (sq_nonneg ‖toHm1 h‖)
  have hNY := mul_nonneg hN0 (sq_nonneg ‖toHm1 h‖)
  have hX2 : ‖toHm1 p‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt N * ‖toHm1 h‖) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hsqN]
    nlinarith [s52, hint_le, hAY, hNY]
  exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hX2 hR).2

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_sq_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    MemLp (riccatiK κ q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 =
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * κ ^ 2)) * ‖(toHm1 q : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: riccatiK_mul_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (g h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (hh : MemLp h 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) :
    MemLp (riccatiK κ (fun y => g y * h y)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
    ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ (fun y => g y * h y) x ^ 2 ≤
      1 / 4 * ((∫ y : ℝ, g y ^ 2) * (∫ y : ℝ, h y ^ 2))
