  have hprof : ∀ (r : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ),
      ‖hm1Profile r ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro r ξ
    show ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 = _
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
      mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    ring
  have S1 : ∀ r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ᵐ ξ ∂(volume : Measure ℝ),
      ‖(toHm1 r : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖fourierLine (r : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro r
    filter_upwards [hae r] with ξ hξ
    rw [hξ, hprof]
  
  have hconv : ∀ (r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ), fourierLine (⇑r) ξ = ((Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)) (ξ / (2 * π)) := by
    intro r ξ
    unfold fourierLine
    rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    congr 2
    have hπ : (π : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.2 Real.pi_ne_zero
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have hconvn : ∀ (r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ), ‖fourierLine (⇑r) ξ‖ ^ 2 = (2 * π)⁻¹ *
      ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((r x : ℝ) : ℂ)) (ξ / (2 * π))‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro r ξ
    rw [hconv r ξ, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), mul_pow, inv_pow,
      Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  
  have S2 : ∀ F D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, D x = deriv (F : ℝ → ℝ) x) → ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      ‖fourierLine (D : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine (F : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro F D hD ξ
    have hGd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ((F x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((D x : ℝ) : ℂ) x := by
      intro x
      rw [hD x]
      exact (F.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt.ofReal_comp
    have hderiv : deriv (fun x : ℝ => ((F x : ℝ) : ℂ)) = fun x : ℝ => ((D x : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      funext fun x => (hGd x).deriv
    have hFd := Real.fourier_deriv ((F.integrable (μ := volume)).ofReal)
      (fun x => (hGd x).differentiableAt)
      (by rw [hderiv]; exact (D.integrable (μ := volume)).ofReal)
    rw [hderiv] at hFd
    have hξ := congrFun hFd (ξ / (2 * π))
    rw [hconvn D ξ, hconvn F ξ, hξ, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, mul_pow]
    have hc : ‖(2 * (π : ℂ) * I * ((ξ / (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 := by
      have e : (2 * (π : ℂ) * I * ((ξ / (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ((ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        have hπ : (π : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.2 Real.pi_ne_zero
        push_cast
        field_simp
      rw [e, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [hc]
    ring
  
  have S3 : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (g : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (g : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ, (g x) ^ 2 := by
    intro g
    obtain ⟨Gs, hGs⟩ : ∃ Gs : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ), (⇑Gs : ℝ → ℂ) = fun x : ℝ => ((g x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      refine ⟨SchwartzMap.bilinLeftCLM (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ)
        (Function.HasTemperateGrowth.const (1 : ℂ)) g, ?_⟩
      funext x
      simp [SchwartzMap.bilinLeftCLM_apply]
    have hFc : (⇑(FourierTransform.fourier Gs) : ℝ → ℂ) =
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((g x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      rw [SchwartzMap.fourier_coe, hGs]
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ η : ℝ,
        φ η = ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => ((g x : ℝ) : ℂ)) η‖ ^ 2 :=
      ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have hφi : Integrable φ volume := by
      have h := (FourierTransform.fourier Gs).memLp 2 volume
      have h2 := (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h.1).1 h
      refine h2.congr (ae_of_all _ fun η => ?_)
      show ‖(FourierTransform.fourier Gs) η‖ ^ 2 = φ η
      rw [hφ, hFc]
    have hφint : ∫ η : ℝ, φ η = ∫ x : ℝ, (g x) ^ 2 := by
      have h := SchwartzMap.integral_norm_sq_fourier Gs
      have e1 : (fun η : ℝ => φ η) = fun η : ℝ => ‖(FourierTransform.fourier Gs) η‖ ^ 2 := by
        funext η
        rw [hφ, hFc]
      have e2 : (fun x : ℝ => (g x) ^ 2) = fun x : ℝ => ‖Gs x‖ ^ 2 := by
        funext x
        rw [hGs]
        simp only
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [e1, e2, h]
    have hpt : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (g : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2) =
        fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * π)⁻¹ * φ ((2 * π)⁻¹ * ξ) := by
      funext ξ
      rw [hconvn g ξ, hφ, show (2 * π)⁻¹ * ξ = ξ / (2 * π) from inv_mul_eq_div _ _]
    rw [hpt]
    refine ⟨(hφi.comp_mul_left' (by positivity)).const_mul _, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left φ (2 * π)⁻¹, inv_inv,
      abs_of_pos (by positivity), smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul, hφint]
  
  have hnorm : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    have h1 : (inner ℂ f f : ℂ) = ((‖f‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]; push_cast; rfl
    have h2 := MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def (𝕜 := ℂ) f f
    have h3 : (∫ a : ℝ, (inner ℂ ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) : ℂ)) =
        ((∫ a : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have e : (fun a : ℝ => (inner ℂ ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) : ℂ)) =
          fun a : ℝ => ((‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        funext a
        rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]; push_cast; rfl
      rw [e]
      exact integral_ofReal
    exact_mod_cast (h1.symm.trans (h2.trans h3))
  have hsqi : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
    fun f => (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)).1 (Lp.memLp f)
  refine ⟨fun f => ?_, fun F D hD => ?_, fun f hf K hK => ?_, fun f g hf hg K hK => ?_⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, D x = deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
      ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f, fun x => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ f x⟩
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(toHm1 f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 =
        4 * ‖fourierLine (f : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 + ‖fourierLine (D : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      filter_upwards [S1 f] with ξ hξ
      rw [hξ, S2 f D hD ξ]
      have h4 : (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    obtain ⟨hi1, he1⟩ := S3 f
    obtain ⟨hi2, he2⟩ := S3 D
    have hint : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        4 * ‖fourierLine (f : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 + ‖fourierLine (D : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
      (hi1.const_mul 4).add hi2
    refine ⟨hint.congr (hpt.mono fun ξ h => h.symm), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_congr_ae hpt, integral_add (hi1.const_mul 4) hi2, integral_const_mul, he1, he2]
    have hfi : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (f x) ^ 2) volume :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable).1 (f.memLp 2 volume)
    have hDi : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (D x) ^ 2) volume :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq D.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable).1 (D.memLp 2 volume)
    have e : (fun x : ℝ => (deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) x) ^ 2 + 4 * (f x) ^ 2) =
        fun x : ℝ => (D x) ^ 2 + 4 * (f x) ^ 2 := by
      funext x
      rw [hD x]
    rw [e, integral_add hDi (hfi.const_mul 4), integral_const_mul]
    ring
  · 
    have hLHS : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂(volume : Measure ℝ),
        ‖(toHm1 D : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ ‖(toHm1 F : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      filter_upwards [S1 D, S1 F] with ξ h1 h2
      rw [h1, h2, S2 F D hD ξ]
      have hA : 0 ≤ ‖fourierLine (F : ℝ → ℝ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h4 : 0 < 4 + ξ ^ 2 := by positivity
      rw [div_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) h4]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg h4.le hA]
    refine (integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => by positivity) (hsqi (toHm1 F))
      hLHS).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [hnorm]
  · 
    have hK0 : 0 < 4 * K ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hm : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) ∧ ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) ≤ 1 :=
      fun ξ => ⟨by positivity, by rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith⟩
    have hA := hsqi f
    have hB : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      refine hA.mono' ((hA.aemeasurable.div
        (by fun_prop : Measurable fun ξ : ℝ => 4 + ξ ^ 2).aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      exact div_le_self (sq_nonneg _) (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ])
    have hW : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
      refine hf.mono' (((by fun_prop : Measurable fun ξ : ℝ =>
        ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2).aemeasurable.mul
          hA.aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable) (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      calc ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
          = ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hm ξ).2 (by positivity)
        _ = (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := one_mul _
    have hR : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + 4 * K ^ 2) ^ 3 * (‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) +
        2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2)) volume :=
      (hB.const_mul _).add (hW.const_mul 2)
    have hpt : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (4 + 4 * K ^ 2) ^ 3 * (‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) +
        2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro ξ
      have hAξ : 0 ≤ ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h4 : 0 < 4 + ξ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hX : 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
      rcases le_total (ξ ^ 2) (4 * K ^ 2) with hξ | hξ
      · have hP : (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3 ≤ (4 + 4 * K ^ 2) ^ 3 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ h4.le (by linarith) 3
        have e : (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 =
            (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3 * (‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
          field_simp
        have h1 : (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3 * (‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) ≤
            (4 + 4 * K ^ 2) ^ 3 * (‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (by positivity)
        have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 *
            ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by positivity
        linarith
      · have hr : 1 ≤ 2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2)) := by
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          linarith
        have h1 : (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
            2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
          calc (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
              = 1 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) := (one_mul _).symm
            _ ≤ 2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr hX
            _ = _ := by ring
        have h2 : 0 ≤ (4 + 4 * K ^ 2) ^ 3 * (‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
          positivity
        linarith
    refine (integral_mono hf hR hpt).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [integral_add (hB.const_mul _) (hW.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  · 
    have hK0 : 0 < 4 * K ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hm : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) ∧ ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) ≤ 1 :=
      fun ξ => ⟨by positivity, by rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith⟩
    have hw : ∀ h : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume →
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
          ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
      intro h hh
      refine hh.mono' (((by fun_prop : Measurable fun ξ : ℝ =>
        ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2).aemeasurable.mul
          (hsqi h).aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable) (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      calc ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
          = ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hm ξ).2 (by positivity)
        _ = (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := one_mul _
    have hR : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) +
        2 * (ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2)) volume :=
      ((hw f hf).const_mul 2).add ((hw g hg).const_mul 2)
    refine (integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun ξ => by positivity) hR ?_).trans
      (le_of_eq ?_)
    · filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub f g] with ξ hξ
      rw [hξ, Pi.sub_apply]
      have h1 := norm_sub_le ((f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) ((g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
      have h0 := norm_nonneg ((f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ - (g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
      have h2 : ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ - (g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
          2 * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ - ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖)]
      have hw0 : 0 ≤ ξ ^ 2 / (ξ ^ 2 + 4 * K ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hw0]
    · rw [integral_add ((hw f hf).const_mul 2) ((hw g hg).const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul]

signature.name: weighted_L2_clm
signature.statement:
∃ M : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
    ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ‖M f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set w : ℝ → ℂ := fun ξ => (((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) with hwdef
  have hpos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < 4 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  have hsqrt_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2) := fun ξ => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos ξ)
  have hw_norm : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖w ξ‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
    intro ξ
    simp only [hwdef]
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (hsqrt_pos ξ).le)]
  have hw_le : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖w ξ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro ξ
    rw [hw_norm]
    apply inv_le_one_of_one_le₀
    rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ]
  have hw_sq : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖w ξ‖ ^ 2 = 1 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro ξ
    rw [hw_norm, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hpos ξ).le, one_div]
  have hw_cont : Continuous w := by
    simp only [hwdef]
    refine Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_
    exact (Continuous.sqrt (by fun_prop)).inv₀ (fun ξ => (hsqrt_pos ξ).ne')
  have hw_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable w (volume : Measure ℝ) := hw_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hmem : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      MemLp (fun ξ => w ξ * (f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro f
    refine MemLp.of_le (Lp.memLp f) (hw_meas.mul (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f)) ?_
    refine ae_of_all _ (fun ξ => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (hw_le ξ)
  let Mf : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
    fun f => (hmem f).toLp (fun ξ => w ξ * (f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
  have hMf : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      ((Mf f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
        fun ξ => w ξ * (f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ := fun f => MemLp.coeFn_toLp (hmem f)
  have hadd : ∀ f g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), Mf (f + g) = Mf f + Mf g := by
    intro f g
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hMf (f + g), hMf f, hMf g, Lp.coeFn_add f g, Lp.coeFn_add (Mf f) (Mf g)]
      with ξ h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    rw [h5, Pi.add_apply, h1, h2, h3, h4, Pi.add_apply]
    ring
  have hsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)), Mf (c • f) = c • Mf f := by
    intro c f
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hMf (c • f), hMf f, Lp.coeFn_smul c f, Lp.coeFn_smul c (Mf f)]
      with ξ h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [h4, Pi.smul_apply, h1, h2, h3, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul]
    ring
  have hbd : ∀ f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ‖Mf f‖ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖ := by
    intro f
    rw [one_mul]
    apply Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le
    filter_upwards [hMf f] with ξ h
    rw [h, norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (hw_le ξ)
  let Ml : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
    { toFun := Mf
      map_add' := hadd
      map_smul' := fun c f => by rw [RingHom.id_apply]; exact hsmul c f }
  have hnorm : ∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ), ‖g‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    have h1 : (inner ℂ f f : ℂ) = ((‖f‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]; push_cast; rfl
    have h2 := MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def (𝕜 := ℂ) f f
    have h3 : (∫ a : ℝ, (inner ℂ ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) : ℂ)) =
        ((∫ a : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have e : (fun a : ℝ => (inner ℂ ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) ((f : ℝ → ℂ) a) : ℂ)) =
          fun a : ℝ => ((‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        funext a
        rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]; push_cast; rfl
      rw [e]
      exact integral_ofReal
    exact_mod_cast (h1.symm.trans (h2.trans h3))
  refine ⟨Ml.mkContinuous 1 hbd, fun f => ?_⟩
  have happ : Ml.mkContinuous 1 hbd f = Mf f := rfl
  rw [happ, hnorm]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [hMf f] with ξ h
  rw [h, norm_mul, mul_pow, hw_sq]
  field_simp

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨δU, hδU, hU⟩ := green_exists_unique
  refine ⟨min (1 / 8) δU, lt_min (by norm_num) hδU, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ
  refine ⟨3, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro q hq f

  have hG : GreenODE κ q γ := by rw [hγdef]; exact hG0
  
  obtain ⟨hKqm, hKqeq⟩ := riccatiK_sq_integral κ hκ0 q
  have hsK : ∫ x : ℝ, riccatiK κ q x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 64 := by
    rw [hKqeq]
    have h1 := ((Hm1_weight_basic (toHm1 q)).2 κ hκ).2.1
    have h3 : ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 8) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq8 2
    have h4 : ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ 2 = 1 / 64 := by norm_num
    linarith
  obtain ⟨⟨ρ, hρ⟩, -⟩ := riccati_fixed_point κ hκ q hKqm hsK
  obtain ⟨hρc, hρb, hρtop, hρbot, hρd⟩ := riccati_sol_regularity κ hκ0 q ρ hρ
  
  have hsq16 : Real.sqrt (1 / 16) = 1 / 4 := by
    rw [show (1 / 16 : ℝ) = (1 / 4) ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  have hSρ : Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, ρ x ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    rw [← hsq16]

  have hscale : ∀ (c : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (c * g x) ^ 2) = c * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2) := by
    intro c g hc
    have : (fun x : ℝ => (c * g x) ^ 2) = fun x : ℝ => c ^ 2 * g x ^ 2 := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [this, integral_const_mul, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc]
  have hkinv0 : 0 ≤ κ⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hκ0.le
  have hkinv1 : κ⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hκ
  have hscaleK : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (κ⁻¹ * g x) ^ 2) ≤

    intro g

    nlinarith
  have hdecay : ∀ F : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (⇑F) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (⇑F) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    intro F

    rw [cocompact_eq_atBot_atTop, Filter.tendsto_sup] at h
    exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  have ode_zero : ∀ (m v u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous m → (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt v (u x) x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt u (m x * u x) x) → Filter.Tendsto v Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto v Filter.atBot (nhds 0) → ∀ x : ℝ, v x = 0 := by
    intro m v u hm hv hu htop hbot
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt P (m x) x :=
      ⟨fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, m t, fun x => (hm.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt⟩
    have hΦ : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => u y * Real.exp (-P y)) 0 x := by
      intro x
      have := (hu x).mul ((hP x).neg.exp)
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hconst : ∀ x : ℝ, u x * Real.exp (-P x) = u 0 * Real.exp (-P 0) := by
      intro x
      exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hΦ y).differentiableAt)
        (fun y => (hΦ y).deriv) x 0
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = u 0 * Real.exp (-P 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, u x = c * Real.exp (P x) := by
      intro x
      have h1 := hconst x
      have h2 : Real.exp (-P x) * Real.exp (P x) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
      calc u x = u x * Real.exp (-P x) * Real.exp (P x) := by rw [mul_assoc, h2, mul_one]
        _ = c * Real.exp (P x) := by rw [h1, hc]
    intro x
    rcases le_total 0 c with hc0 | hc0
    · have hmono : Monotone v := monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun y => (hv y).differentiableAt)
        (fun y => by rw [(hv y).deriv, hu_eq y]; exact mul_nonneg hc0 (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      have h1 := hmono.ge_of_tendsto htop x
      have h2 := hmono.le_of_tendsto hbot x
      linarith
    · have hanti : Antitone v := antitone_of_deriv_nonpos (fun y => (hv y).differentiableAt)
        (fun y => by
          rw [(hv y).deriv, hu_eq y]
          exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hc0 (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      have h1 := hanti.le_of_tendsto htop x
      have h2 := hanti.ge_of_tendsto hbot x
      linarith
  have hN : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)),
      ‖hg.toLp g‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2) := by
    intro g hg
    rw [Lp.norm_toLp, hg.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    have h2 : (2 : ENNReal).toReal = 2 := by norm_num
    have hint : ∫ a, ‖g a‖ ^ (2 : ℝ) = ∫ a, g a ^ 2 := by
      congr 1; funext a; rw [Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [h2, hint, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, one_div, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _) _
  have hadd : ∀ g h : ℝ → ℝ, MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp h 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (g x + h x) ^ 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, h x ^ 2) := by
    intro g h hg hh
    have e := hN (g + h) (hg.add hh)
    rw [MemLp.toLp_add hg hh] at e
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at e
    calc Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, (g x + h x) ^ 2) = ‖hg.toLp g + hh.toLp h‖ := e.symm
      _ ≤ ‖hg.toLp g‖ + ‖hh.toLp h‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [hN g hg, hN h hh]
  have hnegI : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, (-g x) ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2 := by
    intro g; congr 1; funext x; ring
  
  have hlinear : ∀ y a b e h : ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt y (a x * y x + b x + e x * h x - 2 * κ * y x) x) →
      Filter.Tendsto y Filter.atBot (nhds 0) →
      MemLp y 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp a 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp b 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp e 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      MemLp h 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, y x ^ 2) ≤
        1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, a x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, y x ^ 2)) +
        1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, b x ^ 2) +
        1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, e x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, h x ^ 2)) := by
    intro y a b e h hy hybot hy2 ha hb he hh
    have habsI : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ∫ s : ℝ, |g s| ^ 2 = ∫ s : ℝ, g s ^ 2 := by
      intro g; congr 1; funext s; exact sq_abs _
    have key : ∀ Y A B E H : ℝ → ℝ,
        (∀ s, HasDerivAt Y (2 * κ * Y s - (A s * Y s + B s + E s * H s)) s) →
        Filter.Tendsto Y Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        MemLp Y 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp A 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
        MemLp B 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) → MemLp E 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
        MemLp H 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) →
        Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, Y x ^ 2) ≤
          1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, A x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, Y x ^ 2)) +
          1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, B x ^ 2) +
          1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, E x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, H x ^ 2)) := by
      intro Y A B E H hY hYtop hY2 hA hB hE hH
      have hYc : Continuous Y := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun s => (hY s).continuousAt
      have hYn : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => ‖Y s‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using hYtop.norm
      have mA : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => |A s|) volume :=
        continuous_abs.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hA.1
      have mB : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => |B s|) volume :=
        continuous_abs.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hB.1
      have mE : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => |E s|) volume :=
        continuous_abs.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hE.1
      have mH : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => |H s|) volume :=
        continuous_abs.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hH.1
      have mY : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => |Y s|) volume :=
        continuous_abs.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY2.1
      have iAY : Integrable (fun s => A s * Y s) volume := hA.integrable_mul hY2
      have iEH : Integrable (fun s => E s * H s) volume := hE.integrable_mul hH
      have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, |Y x| ≤
          -riccatiK κ (fun s => |A s| * |Y s|) x + -riccatiK κ (fun s => |B s|) x +
            -riccatiK κ (fun s => |E s| * |H s|) x := by
        intro x
        have cex : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s))) := by fun_prop
        have hEx : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioi x, ‖Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s))‖ ≤ 1 := by
          intro s hs
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
          apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.2
          have : x < s := hs
          nlinarith
        have I1 : IntegrableOn (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|A s| * |Y s|))
            (Set.Ioi x) := by
          refine Integrable.mono' iAY.norm.integrableOn
            ((cex.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (mA.mul mY)).restrict) ?_
          refine (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi).mono fun s hs => ?_
          have h1 := hEx s hs
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
          simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_abs]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) h1
        have I3 : IntegrableOn (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|E s| * |H s|))
            (Set.Ioi x) := by
          refine Integrable.mono' iEH.norm.integrableOn
            ((cex.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (mE.mul mH)).restrict) ?_
          refine (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi).mono fun s hs => ?_
          have h1 := hEx s hs
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
          simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_abs]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) h1
        have I2 : IntegrableOn (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * |B s|) (Set.Ioi x) := by
          have ib : IntegrableOn (fun s => Real.exp (4 * κ * x) * Real.exp (-(4 * κ) * s)
              + B s ^ 2) (Set.Ioi x) :=
            ((exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi x (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * κ)).const_mul
              (Real.exp (4 * κ * x))).add hB.integrable_sq.integrableOn
          refine Integrable.mono' ib ((cex.aestronglyMeasurable.mul mB).restrict) ?_
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_
          have ht := Real.exp_pos (2 * κ * (x - s))
          have hsq : Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) ^ 2 =
              Real.exp (4 * κ * x) * Real.exp (-(4 * κ) * s) := by
            rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs, abs_of_pos ht, ← hsq]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) - |B s|), sq_abs (B s),
            abs_nonneg (B s)]
        have Ig : IntegrableOn (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) *
            (|A s| * |Y s| + |B s| + |E s| * |H s|)) (Set.Ioi x) := by
          refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((I1.add I2).add I3) (fun s _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
          simp only [Pi.add_apply]
          ring
        have mF : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun s => A s * Y s + B s + E s * H s) volume :=
          ((hA.1.mul hY2.1).add hB.1).add (hE.1.mul hH.1)
        have hFle : ∀ s, ‖Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (A s * Y s + B s + E s * H s)‖ ≤
            Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|A s| * |Y s| + |B s| + |E s| * |H s|) := by
          intro s
          rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.exp_pos _).le
          calc |A s * Y s + B s + E s * H s| ≤ |A s * Y s + B s| + |E s * H s| :=
                abs_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ |A s * Y s| + |B s| + |E s * H s| := by
                have := abs_add_le (A s * Y s) (B s); linarith
            _ = |A s| * |Y s| + |B s| + |E s| * |H s| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have IF : IntegrableOn (fun s => -(Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) *
            (A s * Y s + B s + E s * H s))) (Set.Ioi x) := by
          refine Integrable.mono' Ig ((cex.aestronglyMeasurable.mul mF).neg.restrict) ?_
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_
          rw [norm_neg]
          exact hFle s
        have hG' : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioi x, HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * Y s)
            (-(Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (A s * Y s + B s + E s * H s))) s := by
          intro s _
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)))
              (Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (2 * κ * (-1))) s :=
            (((hasDerivAt_id' s).const_sub x).const_mul (2 * κ)).exp
          convert h1.mul (hY s) using 1
          ring
        have hGc : ContinuousWithinAt (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * Y s)
            (Set.Ici x) x := (cex.mul hYc).continuousWithinAt
        have hGlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * Y s)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hYn
          filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop x] with s hs
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (hEx s hs)
        have hftc := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hGc hG' IF hGlim
        rw [integral_neg] at hftc
        simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul, zero_sub, neg_inj] at hftc
        have hbound : ‖∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) *
            (A s * Y s + B s + E s * H s)‖ ≤ ∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) *
            (|A s| * |Y s| + |B s| + |E s| * |H s|) :=
          norm_integral_le_of_norm_le Ig (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFle)
        have hsplit : ∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) *
            (|A s| * |Y s| + |B s| + |E s| * |H s|) =
            (∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|A s| * |Y s|)) +
            (∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * |B s|) +
            (∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|E s| * |H s|)) := by
          calc ∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) *
                (|A s| * |Y s| + |B s| + |E s| * |H s|)
              = ∫ s in Set.Ioi x, (Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|A s| * |Y s|) +
                  Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * |B s| +
                  Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|E s| * |H s|)) := by
                congr 1; funext s; ring
            _ = (∫ s in Set.Ioi x, (Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|A s| * |Y s|) +
                  Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * |B s|)) +
                  ∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * (|E s| * |H s|) :=
                integral_add (I1.add I2) I3
            _ = _ := by rw [integral_add I1 I2]
        have hK : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, -riccatiK κ g x =
            ∫ s in Set.Ioi x, Real.exp (2 * κ * (x - s)) * g s := by
          intro g
          unfold riccatiK
          rw [integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi, neg_neg]
        rw [hK, hK, hK, ← hsplit, ← hftc, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hbound
      obtain ⟨hK1, hK2⟩ := riccatiK_sqrt_bounds κ hκ
      have aA : MemLp (fun s => |A s|) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := hA.abs

        + 2 * (w y - κ) * (2 * (w y - κ) * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y) + 1)) y := by
    intro y
    have h := ((((hw1 y).sub_const κ).const_mul 2).mul (hg1 y)).add_const 1
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hdg2 : deriv (fun y => 2 * (w y - κ) * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y) + 1) =
      fun y => 2 * deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ) y * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y)
        + 2 * (w y - κ) * (2 * (w y - κ) * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y) + 1) :=
    funext fun y => (hg2 y).deriv
  have hg3 : HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ) y * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y)
        + 2 * (w y - κ) * (2 * (w y - κ) * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y) + 1)) _ x :=
    (((hw2 x).const_mul 2).mul (hg1 x)).add ((((hw1 x).sub_const κ).const_mul 2).mul (hg2 x))
  have hqf : (q : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ) y - 2 * κ * w y + w y ^ 2 := funext hq
  have hq1 : HasDerivAt (q : ℝ → ℝ)
      (deriv (deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ)) x - 2 * κ * deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ) x
        + 2 * w x * deriv (w : ℝ → ℝ) x) x := by
    rw [hqf]
    have h := ((hw2 x).sub ((hw1 x).const_mul (2 * κ))).add ((hw1 x).pow 2)
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    norm_num
  have hqg : HasDerivAt (fun y => q y * (1 / (2 * κ) + γ y)) _ x := hq1.mul (hg1 x)
  rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hdg, hdg2, hg3.deriv,
    hqg.deriv, hq x]
  ring

signature.name: green_unique_of_pos
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (q γ₀ γ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (h₀ : GreenODE κ q γ₀) (h : GreenODE κ q γ)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmG⟩ := hpos
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := hκ.ne'
  have hL : (1 / (2 * κ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  
  have hderiv : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f x) x := by
    intro f x
    rw [SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
    exact f.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hderivfun : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) = (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro f; funext x; rw [SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
  have hlim : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (f : ℝ → ℝ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (f : ℝ → ℝ) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    intro f
    have h := ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty f
    exact ⟨h.mono_left atTop_le_cocompact, h.mono_left atBot_le_cocompact⟩
  
  have hexp : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), GreenODE κ q g → ∀ x : ℝ,
      SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g)) x =
        2 * SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ q x * (1 / (2 * κ) + g x)
          + 4 * (q x + κ ^ 2) * SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g x := by
    intro g hg x
    have h1 : deriv (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + g y) = (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g : ℝ → ℝ) := by
      funext y; rw [deriv_const_add, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
    have h3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + g y) x =
        SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g)) x := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, h1, hderivfun, hderivfun]
    have hm' : deriv (fun y => q y * (1 / (2 * κ) + g y)) x =
        SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ q x * (1 / (2 * κ) + g x)
          + q x * SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g x :=
      ((hderiv q x).mul ((hderiv g x).const_add (1 / (2 * κ)))).deriv
    have := hg x
    rw [h3, hm', h1] at this
    linarith
  
  have const_lim : ∀ (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ x, HasDerivAt Φ 0 x) →
      Filter.Tendsto Φ Filter.atTop (nhds L) → ∀ x, Φ x = L := by
    intro Φ L hΦ hl x
    have hc := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hΦ y).differentiableAt)
      (fun y => (hΦ y).deriv)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun y => hc x y)) hl
  
  have hIconst : ∀ (G G1 G2 G3 p p1 : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt G (G1 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt G1 (G2 x) x) →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt G2 (G3 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt p (p1 x) x) →
      (∀ x, G3 x = 2 * p1 x * G x + 4 * (p x + κ ^ 2) * G1 x) →
      Filter.Tendsto G Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / (2 * κ))) →
      Filter.Tendsto G1 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto G2 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      ∀ x, 2 * G x * G2 x - G1 x * G1 x - 4 * (p x + κ ^ 2) * (G x * G x) = -1 := by
    intro G G1 G2 G3 p p1 hG hG1 hG2 hp hode hGt hG1t hG2t hpt
    refine const_lim
      (fun x => 2 * G x * G2 x - G1 x * G1 x - 4 * (p x + κ ^ 2) * (G x * G x)) (-1) ?_ ?_
    · intro x
      have := ((((hG x).const_mul 2).mul (hG2 x)).sub ((hG1 x).mul (hG1 x))).sub
        ((((hp x).add_const (κ ^ 2)).const_mul 4).mul ((hG x).mul (hG x)))
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      linear_combination (2 * G x) * hode x
    · have := (((hGt.const_mul 2).mul hG2t).sub (hG1t.mul hG1t)).sub
        (((hpt.add_const (κ ^ 2)).const_mul 4).mul (hGt.mul hGt))
      have e : 2 * (1 / (2 * κ)) * 0 - 0 * 0 - 4 * (0 + κ ^ 2) * (1 / (2 * κ) * (1 / (2 * κ)))
          = (-1 : ℝ) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [e] at this
      exact this
  
  have hBzero : ∀ (G G1 G2 G3 D D1 D2 D3 p p1 : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt G (G1 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt G1 (G2 x) x) →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt G2 (G3 x) x) →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt D (D1 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt D1 (D2 x) x) →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt D2 (D3 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt p (p1 x) x) →
      (∀ x, G3 x = 2 * p1 x * G x + 4 * (p x + κ ^ 2) * G1 x) →
      (∀ x, D3 x = 2 * p1 x * D x + 4 * (p x + κ ^ 2) * D1 x) →
      Filter.Tendsto G Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / (2 * κ))) →
      Filter.Tendsto G1 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto G2 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto p Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto D Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto D1 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto D2 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      ∀ x, G x * D2 x + G2 x * D x - G1 x * D1 x - 4 * (p x + κ ^ 2) * G x * D x = 0 := by
    intro G G1 G2 G3 D D1 D2 D3 p p1 hG hG1 hG2 hD hD1 hD2 hp hodeg hoded hGt hG1t hG2t hpt
      hDt hD1t hD2t
    refine const_lim
      (fun x => G x * D2 x + G2 x * D x - G1 x * D1 x - 4 * (p x + κ ^ 2) * G x * D x) 0 ?_ ?_
    · intro x
      have := ((((hG x).mul (hD2 x)).add ((hG2 x).mul (hD x))).sub ((hG1 x).mul (hD1 x))).sub
        (((((hp x).add_const (κ ^ 2)).const_mul 4).mul (hG x)).mul (hD x))
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      linear_combination (G x) * hoded x + (D x) * hodeg x
    · have := (((hGt.mul hD2t).add (hG2t.mul hDt)).sub (hG1t.mul hD1t)).sub
        ((((hpt.add_const (κ ^ 2)).const_mul 4).mul hGt).mul hDt)
      simpa using this
  
  have energy : ∀ (G G1 G2 D D1 D2 P : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt G (G1 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt G1 (G2 x) x) →
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt D (D1 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt D1 (D2 x) x) →
      (∀ x, 0 < G x) →
      Filter.Tendsto G Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / (2 * κ))) →
      Filter.Tendsto G Filter.atBot (nhds (1 / (2 * κ))) →
      Filter.Tendsto G1 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto G1 Filter.atBot (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto D Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto D Filter.atBot (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto D1 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto D1 Filter.atBot (nhds 0) →
      (∀ x, 2 * G x * G2 x - G1 x * G1 x - P x * (G x * G x) = -1) →
      (∀ x, G x * D2 x + G2 x * D x - G1 x * D1 x - P x * G x * D x = 0) →
      ∀ x, D x = 0 := by
    intro G G1 G2 D D1 D2 P hG hG1 hD hD1 hpos hGt hGb hG1t hG1b hDt hDb hD1t hD1b hI hB
    have hNd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => D y * D1 y * G y - D y * D y * G1 y)
        ((D1 x * D1 x + D x * D2 x) * G x + D x * D1 x * G1 x
          - ((D1 x * D x + D x * D1 x) * G1 x + D x * D x * G2 x)) x := by
      intro x
      exact (((hD x).mul (hD1 x)).mul (hG x)).sub (((hD x).mul (hD x)).mul (hG1 x))
    have hEd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => (D y * D1 y * G y - D y * D y * G1 y) / (G y * G y))
        (G x * ((D1 x * G x - D x * G1 x) ^ 2 + D x ^ 2) / (G x * G x) ^ 2) x := by
      intro x
      have hGx := hpos x
      have hne : G x * G x ≠ 0 := by positivity
      refine ((hNd x).div ((hG x).mul (hG x)) hne).congr_deriv ?_
      congr 1
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      linear_combination (G x * D x * G x) * hB x - (G x * D x ^ 2) * hI x
    have hmono : Monotone (fun y => (D y * D1 y * G y - D y * D y * G1 y) / (G y * G y)) := by
      apply monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun x => (hEd x).differentiableAt)
      intro x
      rw [(hEd x).deriv]
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hpos x).le (by positivity)) (by positivity)
    have hEt : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (D y * D1 y * G y - D y * D y * G1 y) / (G y * G y))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have := (((hDt.mul hD1t).mul hGt).sub ((hDt.mul hDt).mul hG1t)).div (hGt.mul hGt)
        (mul_ne_zero hL hL)
      simpa using this
    have hEb : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (D y * D1 y * G y - D y * D y * G1 y) / (G y * G y))
        Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
      have := (((hDb.mul hD1b).mul hGb).sub ((hDb.mul hDb).mul hG1b)).div (hGb.mul hGb)
        (mul_ne_zero hL hL)
      simpa using this
    have hfun : (fun y => (D y * D1 y * G y - D y * D y * G1 y) / (G y * G y)) =
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      funext fun x => le_antisymm (hmono.ge_of_tendsto hEt x) (hmono.le_of_tendsto hEb x)
    intro x
    have h1 := hEd x
    rw [hfun] at h1
    have h2 := h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const x (0 : ℝ))
    have hGx := hpos x
    have hne : (G x * G x) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [div_eq_zero_iff] at h2
    rcases h2 with h2 | h2
    · have h3 : (D1 x * G x - D x * G1 x) ^ 2 + D x ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h2 with h | h
        · exact absurd h hGx.ne'
        · exact h
      have h4 : D x ^ 2 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (D1 x * G x - D x * G1 x), sq_nonneg (D x)]
      exact pow_eq_zero_iff (two_ne_zero) |>.1 h4
    · exact absurd h2 hne
  
  have hγ₀d : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ₀ y)
      (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀ x) x :=
    fun x => (hderiv γ₀ x).const_add _
  have hGt : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ₀ y) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (1 / (2 * κ))) := by
    have := (hlim γ₀).1.const_add (1 / (2 * κ))
    rwa [add_zero] at this
  have hGb : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ₀ y) Filter.atBot
      (nhds (1 / (2 * κ))) := by
    have := (hlim γ₀).2.const_add (1 / (2 * κ))
    rwa [add_zero] at this
  have hsubt : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun y => f y - g y) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro f g
    have := (hlim f).1.sub (hlim g).1
    rwa [sub_zero] at this
  have hsubb : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun y => f y - g y) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    intro f g
    have := (hlim f).2.sub (hlim g).2
    rwa [sub_zero] at this
  have hodeg := hexp γ₀ h₀
  have hoded : ∀ x,
      SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ)) x
        - SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀)) x =
      2 * SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ q x * (γ x - γ₀ x)
        + 4 * (q x + κ ^ 2) * (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ x - SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀ x) := by
    intro x
    rw [hexp γ h x, hexp γ₀ h₀ x]
    ring
  have hI0 := hIconst (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ₀ y) (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀)
    (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀))
    (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀)))
    q (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ q) hγ₀d (hderiv _) (hderiv _) (hderiv _) hodeg hGt
    (hlim _).1 (hlim _).1 (hlim _).1
  have hB0 := hBzero (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ₀ y) (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀)
    (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀))
    (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀)))
    (fun y => γ y - γ₀ y)
    (fun y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ y - SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀ y)
    (fun y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ) y
      - SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀) y)
    (fun y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ)) y
      - SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀)) y)
    q (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ q)
    hγ₀d (hderiv _) (hderiv _)
    (fun x => (hderiv γ x).sub (hderiv γ₀ x)) (fun x => (hderiv _ x).sub (hderiv _ x))
    (fun x => (hderiv _ x).sub (hderiv _ x)) (hderiv _) hodeg hoded hGt (hlim _).1 (hlim _).1
    (hlim _).1 (hsubt _ _) (hsubt _ _) (hsubt _ _)
  have hD0 := energy (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + γ₀ y) (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀)
    (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀))
    (fun y => γ y - γ₀ y)
    (fun y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ y - SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀ y)
    (fun y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ) y
      - SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ γ₀) y)
    (fun y => 4 * (q y + κ ^ 2))
    hγ₀d (hderiv _) (fun x => (hderiv γ x).sub (hderiv γ₀ x))
    (fun x => (hderiv _ x).sub (hderiv _ x))
    (fun x => by have := hmG x; linarith) hGt hGb (hlim _).1 (hlim _).2
    (hsubt _ _) (hsubb _ _) (hsubt _ _) (hsubb _ _)
    hI0 hB0
  ext x
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hD0 x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨C₀, -, hC₀⟩ := v₀.decay 0 0
  obtain ⟨C₂, -, hC₂⟩ := v₀.decay 2 0
  have hv0b : ∀ x : ℝ, |v₀ x| ≤ C₀ := by
    intro x
    have h := hC₀ x
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h
  have hv2b : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 * |v₀ x| ≤ C₂ := by
    intro x
    have h := hC₂ x
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h
    exact h
  have hf₀b : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖(1 + x ^ 2) * v₀ x‖ ≤ C₀ + C₂ := by
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2)]
    have e : (1 + x ^ 2) * |v₀ x| = |v₀ x| + x ^ 2 * |v₀ x| := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith [hv0b x, hv2b x]
  have hpoly : Continuous fun x : ℝ => 1 + x ^ 2 := continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)
  let f₀ : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun x => (1 + x ^ 2) * v₀ x)
      (hpoly.mul v₀.continuous) (C₀ + C₂) hf₀b
  have hf₀ : ∀ x : ℝ, f₀ x = (1 + x ^ 2) * v₀ x := fun x => rfl
  
  obtain ⟨I₀, hI₀⟩ : ∃ I₀ : ℝ, I₀ = ∫ x : ℝ, v₀ x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hI₀0 : 0 ≤ I₀ := by rw [hI₀]; exact integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = Real.sqrt I₀ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := by rw [hρdef]; positivity
  have hIρ : I₀ < ρ ^ 2 := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hI₀0
    have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg I₀
    rw [hρdef]
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL0, hLip⟩ := wfieldC_weighted_lipschitz κ ρ hκ hρ
  obtain ⟨hcont, hzero⟩ := wfieldC_continuous_zero κ ρ hκ hρ
  
  have hwf : ∀ f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ, Continuous (fun y : ℝ => f y / (1 + y ^ 2)) :=
    fun f => f.continuous.div hpoly (fun y => by positivity)
  have hwfb : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (y : ℝ),
      (1 + y ^ 2) * |f y / (1 + y ^ 2)| = |f y| := by
    intro f y
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hp, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp.ne']
  have hnc : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (y : ℝ), |f y| ≤ ‖f‖ := by
    intro f y
    have h := f.norm_coe_le_norm y
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  have hΦb : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      ‖(1 + x ^ 2) * wfieldC κ ρ (fun y => f y / (1 + y ^ 2)) x‖ ≤ L * ‖f‖ := by
    intro f x
    have h := hLip (fun y => f y / (1 + y ^ 2)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (hwf f) continuous_const ‖f‖
      (fun y => by
        rw [sub_zero, hwfb]
        exact hnc f y) x
    rw [hzero x, sub_zero] at h
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2)]
    exact h
  let Φ : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ → BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ := fun f =>
    BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup
      (fun x => (1 + x ^ 2) * wfieldC κ ρ (fun y => f y / (1 + y ^ 2)) x)

  have hΦ : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      Φ f x = (1 + x ^ 2) * wfieldC κ ρ (fun y => f y / (1 + y ^ 2)) x := fun f x => rfl
  have hΦL : LipschitzWith ⟨L, hL0⟩ Φ := by
    refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun f g => ?_
    rw [NNReal.coe_mk]
    refine (BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_le (mul_nonneg hL0 dist_nonneg)).2 fun x => ?_
    rw [hΦ, hΦ, Real.dist_eq, ← mul_sub, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2)]
    refine hLip _ _ (hwf f) (hwf g) (dist f g) (fun y => ?_) x
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hp, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp.ne', ← Real.dist_eq]

  have hγc : Continuous γ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hγ t).continuousAt
  have hΦγc : Continuous fun τ => Φ (γ τ) := hΦL.continuous.comp hγc
  
  have hvc : ∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (fun x : ℝ => γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) := fun t => hwf (γ t)
  have hvb : ∀ (t x : ℝ), (1 + x ^ 2) * |γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)| ≤ ‖γ t‖ := by
    intro t x
    rw [hwfb]

  have hvi : ∀ t : ℝ, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) ^ 2) volume := by

    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (‖γ t‖ ^ 2))

    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h2 : |γ t x| ^ 2 ≤ ‖γ t‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hnc (γ t) x) 2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow, abs_div, abs_of_pos hp, div_pow,
      div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have h3 : ‖γ t‖ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + x ^ 2) ^ 2 =

    rw [h3, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp.ne', mul_one]

      funext x
      rw [hΦ, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (by positivity : (1 : ℝ) + x ^ 2 ≠ 0)]

    exact h
  have hDz : ∀ t : ℝ, (∫ x : ℝ, (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) ^ 2) ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      2 * ∫ x : ℝ, (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * wfieldC κ ρ (fun y => γ t y / (1 + y ^ 2)) x = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have heq := wfieldC_eq_wfield κ ρ hρ (fun y => γ t y / (1 + y ^ 2)) (hvc t) (hvi t) ht

      rw [heq x]

    rw [hγ0, hI₀]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [hf₀, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (by positivity : (1 : ℝ) + x ^ 2 ≠ 0)]

      hconst t
    show (∫ x : ℝ, (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) ^ 2) ≤ ρ ^ 2
    rw [h, hg0]

  refine ⟨fun t x => γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    show γ 0 x / (1 + x ^ 2) = v₀ x
    rw [hγ0, hf₀, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (by positivity : (1 : ℝ) + x ^ 2 ≠ 0)]

  · intro T
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=

    have hsI : s ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := abs_le.1 hs
    have htI : t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := abs_le.1 ht
    have hsub : Set.uIcc t s ⊆ Set.Icc (-T) T := Set.uIcc_subset_Icc htI hsI

    show (1 + x ^ 2) * |γ s x / (1 + x ^ 2) - γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)| ≤ K * |s - t|
    rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hp, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp.ne']

    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hder : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun σ => γ σ x) (Φ (γ τ) x) τ := by

        (1 + x ^ 2) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, wfield κ (fun y => γ τ y / (1 + y ^ 2)) x := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun τ _ => ?_
      show Φ (γ τ) x = (1 + x ^ 2) * wfield κ (fun y => γ τ y / (1 + y ^ 2)) x
      rw [hΦ, hact]
    rw [hint, hγ0, hf₀] at hftc
    show γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2) =

subgoal_signatures.name: wfieldC_weighted_lipschitz
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ ρ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous w₁ → Continuous w₂ → ∀ D : ℝ,
      (∀ y : ℝ, (1 + y ^ 2) * |w₁ y - w₂ y| ≤ D) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |wfieldC κ ρ w₁ x - wfieldC κ ρ w₂ x| ≤ L * D

subgoal_signatures.name: wfieldC_continuous_zero
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ ρ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Continuous (wfieldC κ ρ w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, wfieldC κ ρ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: wfieldC_eq_wfield

(κ ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w)
    (hw2 : Integrable (fun x => w x ^ 2) (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hE : ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, wfieldC κ ρ w x = wfield κ w x

    intro g k n M hM h
    refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound ℝ k n g hM (fun x => ?_)
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]

    · calc (a + b) ^ k ≤ (2 * b) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) k
        _ = 2 ^ k * b ^ k := mul_pow 2 b k
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (a ^ k + b ^ k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [pow_nonneg ha k]) h2
    · calc (a + b) ^ k ≤ (2 * a) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) k
        _ = 2 ^ k * a ^ k := mul_pow 2 a k
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (a ^ k + b ^ k) :=

    rw [hfun]
    exact hP f a x k n
  
  have hφd : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (y : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv m (f : ℝ → ℝ)) (iteratedDeriv (m + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) y) y := by
    intro f m y
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    exact (((hsm f (m + 1)).differentiable_iteratedDeriv m
      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self m)) y).hasDerivAt
  
  have hTaylor : ∀ (f f' g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (b h : ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, f' x = deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) x) →
      |h| ≤ 1 → (∀ x : ℝ, g x = f (x + b + h) - f (x + b) - h * f' (x + b)) → ∀ k n : ℕ,
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n g ≤ h ^ 2 * (2 ^ k * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 2) f
            + (|b| + 1) ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + 2) f)) := by
    intro f f' g b h hf' hh hg k n
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 2 ^ k * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 2) f
        + (|b| + 1) ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + 2) f) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hK]
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by
      rw [hK]
      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (add_nonneg (apply_nonneg _ _)
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (apply_nonneg _ _)))
    have hgf : (g : ℝ → ℝ) = fun z => f (z + (b + h)) - f (z + b) - h * f' (z + b) := by
      funext z
      rw [hg z, add_assoc]
    have hf'φ : iteratedDeriv n (f' : ℝ → ℝ) = iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
      congr 1
      funext z
      exact hf' z
    have hgd : ∀ x : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + (b + h)) - iteratedDeriv n (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b)
          - h * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b) := by
      intro x
      have c1 : ContDiff ℝ n (fun z => f (z + (b + h))) :=
        (hsm f n).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      have c2 : ContDiff ℝ n (fun z => f (z + b)) :=
        (hsm f n).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      have c3 : ContDiff ℝ n (fun z => f' (z + b)) :=
        (hsm f' n).comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      rw [hgf, iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (c1.sub c2).contDiffAt (contDiff_const.mul c3).contDiffAt,
        iteratedDeriv_fun_sub c1.contDiffAt c2.contDiffAt, iteratedDeriv_const_mul c3.contDiffAt]
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const, hf'φ]
    refine F3 g k n _ (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg h) hK0) (fun x => ?_)
    rw [hgd x, ← add_assoc]
    have hxk : 0 ≤ |x| ^ k := pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) k
    have hc : ∀ θ : ℝ, |θ| ≤ 1 →
        |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv (n + 2) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + θ)| ≤ K := by
      intro θ hθ
      obtain ⟨hθ1, hθ2⟩ := abs_le.1 hθ
      rw [hK]
      refine hW x (x + b + θ) (|b| + 1) _ _ _ k (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _) ?_
        (F2 f k (n + 2) _) ?_
      · exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le (x + b + θ), le_abs_self b],
          by linarith [le_abs_self (x + b + θ), neg_abs_le b]⟩
      · simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul] using F2 f 0 (n + 2) (x + b + θ)
    have hd1 : ∀ σ : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun σ => |x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + σ))
        (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 2) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + σ)) σ := by
      intro σ
      exact ((hφd f (n + 1) (x + b + σ)).comp_const_add (x + b) σ).const_mul (|x| ^ k)
    have hmvt1 : ∀ θ : ℝ, |θ| ≤ 1 → |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + θ)
        - iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b)| ≤ K * |θ| := by
      intro θ hθ
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
      have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (f := fun σ => |x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + σ))
        (s := Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (C := K)
        (fun σ _ => (hd1 σ).differentiableAt)
        (fun σ hσ => by
          rw [(hd1 σ).deriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hxk]
          exact hc σ (abs_le.2 hσ))
        (convex_Icc _ _) h0 (abs_le.1 hθ)
      simp only [add_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hxk] at this
      exact this
    have hd2 : ∀ σ : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun σ => |x| ^ k * (iteratedDeriv n (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + σ)
          - iteratedDeriv n (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b) - σ * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b)))
        (|x| ^ k * (iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + σ)
          - iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b))) σ := by
      intro σ
      have h1 := ((((hφd f n (x + b + σ)).comp_const_add (x + b) σ).sub_const
        (iteratedDeriv n (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b))).sub
        ((hasDerivAt_id' σ).mul_const (iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b)))).const_mul
        (|x| ^ k)
      refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have hmvt2 := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (f := fun σ => |x| ^ k * (iteratedDeriv n (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + σ)
          - iteratedDeriv n (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b) - σ * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b)))
      (s := Set.Icc (-|h|) |h|) (C := K * |h|)
      (fun σ _ => (hd2 σ).differentiableAt)
      (fun σ hσ => by
        have hσ' : |σ| ≤ |h| := abs_le.2 hσ
        rw [(hd2 σ).deriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hxk]
        calc |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b + σ)
              - iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x + b)| ≤ K * |σ| := hmvt1 σ (hσ'.trans hh)
          _ ≤ K * |h| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσ' hK0)
      (convex_Icc _ _)
      (⟨by linarith [abs_nonneg h], abs_nonneg h⟩ : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-|h|) |h|)
      (⟨neg_abs_le h, le_abs_self h⟩ : h ∈ Set.Icc (-|h|) |h|)
    simp only [add_zero, sub_zero, zero_mul, sub_self, mul_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt2
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hxk] at hmvt2
    calc _ ≤ K * |h| * |h| := hmvt2
      _ = h ^ 2 * K := by rw [mul_assoc, abs_mul_abs_self]; ring
  
  have s5a : ∀ (c : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (c' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt c c' t → ∀ k n : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (c s - c t - (s - t) • c'))) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
    intro c c' t hc k n
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt] at hc
    have h1 := HasFDerivAtFilter.isLittleOTVS hc
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] at h1
    have G := h1.tendsto_inv_smul
    rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds _ 0] at G
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [G (k, n) ε hε] with s hs
    rw [sub_zero] at hs
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (apply_nonneg _ _)]
    exact hs
  
  have s5b : ∀ (c : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (c' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ), (∀ k n : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (c s - c t - (s - t) • c'))) (nhds t) (nhds 0)) →
      HasDerivAt c c' t := by
    intro c c' t hc
    have G : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - t)⁻¹ • (c s - c t - (s - t) • c'))
        (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds _ 0]
      rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
      filter_upwards [(hc k n).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with s hs
      rw [sub_zero]
      exact hs
    have h2 : (fun s : ℝ => c s - c t - (s - t) • c') =o[ℝ; nhds t] (fun s => s - t) := by
      rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul]
      · exact G
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
        have hst : s = t := sub_eq_zero.mp hs
        subst hst
        simp
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
    exact (hasFDerivAtFilter_iff_isLittleOTVS _ _ _ _).2
      (by simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] using h2)
  
  have hkey : ∀ d K : ℝ, |d⁻¹| * ((μ * d) ^ 2 * K) = μ ^ 2 * |d| * K := by
    intro d K
    rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with h0 | h0
    · simp [h0]
    · have hd : 0 < |d| := abs_pos.2 h0
      rw [abs_inv, mul_pow, ← sq_abs d]
      field_simp
  
  refine ⟨fun s => τ (v s) (μ * s), fun s x => hτ _ _ _, fun t => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, D x = deriv (v t : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (v t), fun x => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ (v t) x⟩
  obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂⟩ : ∃ D₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, D₂ x = deriv (V t : ℝ → ℝ) x :=
    ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (V t), fun x => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ (V t) x⟩
  refine ⟨τ (V t) (μ * t) + μ • τ D (μ * t), ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  swap
  · simp only [SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hτ, hD]
    ring
  refine s5b _ _ t (fun k n => ?_)
  show Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ •
    (τ (v s) (μ * s) - τ (v t) (μ * t) - (s - t) • (τ (V t) (μ * t) + μ • τ D (μ * t)))))
    (nhds t) (nhds 0)
  have hEk := s5a v (V t) t (hv t) k n
  have hE0 := s5a v (V t) t (hv t) 0 n
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ : ∃ K₁ : ℝ, K₁ = 2 ^ k * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 2) (v t)
      + (|μ * t| + 1) ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + 2) (v t)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂⟩ : ∃ K₂ : ℝ, K₂ = 2 ^ k * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 2) (V t)
      + (|μ * t| + 1) ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + 2) (V t)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (τ D₂ (μ * t)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hid : ∀ s : ℝ, (s - t)⁻¹ •
      (τ (v s) (μ * s) - τ (v t) (μ * t) - (s - t) • (τ (V t) (μ * t) + μ • τ D (μ * t))) =
      τ ((s - t)⁻¹ • (v s - v t - (s - t) • V t)) (μ * s)
        + ((τ (V t) (μ * s) - τ (V t) (μ * t) - (μ * (s - t)) • τ D₂ (μ * t))
          + (μ * (s - t)) • τ D₂ (μ * t))
        + (s - t)⁻¹ • (τ (v t) (μ * s) - τ (v t) (μ * t) - (μ * (s - t)) • τ D (μ * t)) := by
    intro s
    ext x
    simp only [SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hτ]
    rcases eq_or_ne (s - t) 0 with h0 | h0
    · have hst : s = t := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
      subst hst
      simp
    · field_simp
      ring
  
  have hA : ∀ s : ℝ,
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (τ ((s - t)⁻¹ • (v s - v t - (s - t) • V t)) (μ * s)) ≤
        2 ^ k * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (v s - v t - (s - t) • V t))
          + |μ * s| ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (v s - v t - (s - t) • V t))) :=
    fun s => hτb _ _ k n
  
  have hC : ∀ s : ℝ, |μ * (s - t)| ≤ 1 → SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ •
      (τ (v t) (μ * s) - τ (v t) (μ * t) - (μ * (s - t)) • τ D (μ * t))) ≤
        μ ^ 2 * |s - t| * K₁ := by
    intro s hs
    have hT := hTaylor (v t) D
      (τ (v t) (μ * s) - τ (v t) (μ * t) - (μ * (s - t)) • τ D (μ * t)) (μ * t) (μ * (s - t))
      hD hs (fun x => by
        simp only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hτ]
        rw [show x + μ * t + μ * (s - t) = x + μ * s by ring]) k n
    rw [← hK₁] at hT
    rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc _ ≤ |(s - t)⁻¹| * ((μ * (s - t)) ^ 2 * K₁) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = μ ^ 2 * |s - t| * K₁ := hkey (s - t) K₁
  
  have hB : ∀ s : ℝ, |μ * (s - t)| ≤ 1 → SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n
      ((τ (V t) (μ * s) - τ (V t) (μ * t) - (μ * (s - t)) • τ D₂ (μ * t))
        + (μ * (s - t)) • τ D₂ (μ * t)) ≤ (μ * (s - t)) ^ 2 * K₂ + |μ * (s - t)| * M := by
    intro s hs
    have hT := hTaylor (V t) D₂
      (τ (V t) (μ * s) - τ (V t) (μ * t) - (μ * (s - t)) • τ D₂ (μ * t)) (μ * t) (μ * (s - t))
      hD₂ hs (fun x => by
        simp only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hτ]
        rw [show x + μ * t + μ * (s - t) = x + μ * s by ring]) k n
    rw [← hK₂] at hT
    refine (map_add_le_add _ _ _).trans (add_le_add hT ?_)
    rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hM]
  
  have hev : ∀ᶠ s in nhds t, |μ * (s - t)| ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => |μ * (s - t)|) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have := (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => |μ * (s - t)|).tendsto t
      simpa using this
    exact h1.eventually (eventually_le_nhds one_pos)
  have hlimA : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => 2 ^ k *
      (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (v s - v t - (s - t) • V t))
        + |μ * s| ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (v s - v t - (s - t) • V t))))
      (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
    have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => |μ * s| ^ k) (nhds t) (nhds (|μ * t| ^ k)) :=
      (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => |μ * s| ^ k).tendsto t
    have := (hEk.add (hc.mul hE0)).const_mul (2 ^ k)
    rw [mul_zero, add_zero, mul_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hlimBC : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      (μ * (s - t)) ^ 2 * K₂ + |μ * (s - t)| * M + μ ^ 2 * |s - t| * K₁) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
    have := (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ =>
      (μ * (s - t)) ^ 2 * K₂ + |μ * (s - t)| * M + μ ^ 2 * |s - t| * K₁).tendsto t
    simpa using this
  have hlim := hlimA.add hlimBC
  rw [zero_add] at hlim
  have key3 : ∀ a b c : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (a + b + c) ≤
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n a + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n b
        + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n c := fun a b c =>
    (map_add_le_add _ _ _).trans (add_le_add (map_add_le_add _ _ _) le_rfl)
  refine squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => apply_nonneg _ _) ?_ hlim
  filter_upwards [hev] with s hs
  rw [hid s]
  refine (key3 _ _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 := hA s
  have h2 := hB s hs
  have h3 := hC s hs
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(a : ℝ) (w W : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (hw : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (W t) t) :
    ∃ c : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ t x : ℝ, c t x = deriv (w t : ℝ → ℝ) x - a * w t x + w t x ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ C : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt c C t ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, C x = deriv (W t : ℝ → ℝ) x - a * W t x + 2 * w t x * W t x
