proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have mulex : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∃ h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x, h x = f x * g x := by
    intro f g
    refine ⟨SchwartzMap.bilinLeftCLM (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) g.hasTemperateGrowth f,
      fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [SchwartzMap.bilinLeftCLM_apply]
    simp
  
  have slope : ∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt u v t ↔
      Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - t)⁻¹ • (u s - u t)) (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds v) := by
    intro u v t
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
    show HasFDerivAtFilter u _ t (nhds t) ↔ _
    rw [hasFDerivAtFilter_iff_isLittleOTVS]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
    rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s hs => by
      have hst : s = t := sub_eq_zero.1 hs
      subst hst
      simp)]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h2 := h.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := {t}ᶜ))
      rw [← tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff]
      refine h2.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
      have hs' : s - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hs
      rw [smul_sub, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs', one_smul]
    · intro h
      rw [← nhdsNE_sup_pure t]
      refine Filter.Tendsto.sup ?_ ?_
      · have h2 := tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.2 h
        refine h2.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
        have hs' : s - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hs
        rw [smul_sub ((s - t)⁻¹) (u s - u t) ((s - t) • v), smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs',
          one_smul]
      · rw [Filter.tendsto_pure_left]
        intro S hS
        simpa using mem_of_mem_nhds hS
  
  have leib : ∀ (f g h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), (∀ x, h x = f x * g x) → ∀ k n : ℕ,
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n h ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i f * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) g := by
    intro f g h hh k n
    refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound ℝ k n h
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (apply_nonneg _ _)) (apply_nonneg _ _)) fun x => ?_
    have hfun : (h : ℝ → ℝ) = fun y => f y * g y := funext hh
    rw [hfun]
    have hle := norm_iteratedFDeriv_mul_le (f.smooth ⊤) (g.smooth ⊤) x (n := n)
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    calc ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y * g y) x‖
        ≤ ‖x‖ ^ k * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (by positivity)
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) *
            (‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖) *
            (‖x‖ ^ 0 * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          ring
      _ ≤ _ := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
          refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (SchwartzMap.le_seminorm ℝ k i f x)
            (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (SchwartzMap.le_seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) g x) (by positivity)
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (apply_nonneg _ _))
  
  have multend : ∀ (l : Filter ℝ) (f g p : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (f₀ g₀ p₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds f₀) → Filter.Tendsto g l (nhds g₀) →
      (∀ i x, p i x = f i x * g i x) → (∀ x, p₀ x = f₀ x * g₀ x) →
      Filter.Tendsto p l (nhds p₀) := by
    intro l f g p f₀ g₀ p₀ hf hg hp hp₀
    have semt : ∀ (F : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (F₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Filter.Tendsto F l (nhds F₀) →
        ∀ k n : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun s => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (F s - F₀)) l (nhds 0) := by
      intro F F₀ hF k n
      have h1 := ((schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (k, n)).tendsto 0
      rw [map_zero] at h1
      have h2 := h1.comp (tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.2 hF)
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply] using h2
    rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds p p₀]
    rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
    simp only [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply]
    choose h₁ hh₁ using fun s => mulex (f s - f₀) (g s)
    choose h₂ hh₂ using fun s => mulex f₀ (g s - g₀)
    have hdec : ∀ s, p s - p₀ = h₁ s + h₂ s := by
      intro s
      ext x
      simp only [SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.add_apply, hp, hp₀, hh₁, hh₂]
      ring
    have hb : ∀ s, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (p s - p₀) ≤
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i (f s - f₀) *
          (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) (g s - g₀) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) g₀)) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i f₀ *
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) (g s - g₀) := by
      intro s
      rw [hdec s]
      refine (map_add_le_add _ _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ (leib _ _ _ (hh₂ s) k n))
      refine (leib _ _ _ (hh₁ s) k n).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (apply_nonneg _ _))
      calc SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) (g s)
          = SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) ((g s - g₀) + g₀) := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
        _ ≤ _ := map_add_le_add _ _ _
    have hV : Filter.Tendsto (fun s =>
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i (f s - f₀) *
          (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) (g s - g₀) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) g₀)) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i f₀ *
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) (g s - g₀)) l (nhds 0) := by
      have h1 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Filter.Tendsto (fun s =>
          (n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i (f s - f₀) *
            (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) (g s - g₀) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) g₀)) l
          (nhds ((n.choose i : ℝ) * 0 * (0 + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) g₀))) :=
        fun i _ => (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (semt f f₀ hf k i)).mul
          ((semt g g₀ hg 0 (n - i)).add tendsto_const_nhds)
      have h2 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Filter.Tendsto (fun s =>
          (n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i f₀ *
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n - i) (g s - g₀)) l
          (nhds ((n.choose i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k i f₀ * 0)) :=
        fun i _ => tendsto_const_nhds.mul (semt g g₀ hg 0 (n - i))
      have h3 := (tendsto_finset_sum _ h1).add (tendsto_finset_sum _ h2)
      simpa using h3
    have hT := tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hV
      (fun s => apply_nonneg _ _) hb
    exact Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt_const hε hT
  
  choose sq hsq using fun t => mulex (w t) (w t)
  refine ⟨fun t => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (w t) - a • w t + sq t, fun t x => ?_, fun t => ?_⟩
  · simp only [SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply, hsq]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), D = fun s => (s - t)⁻¹ • (w s - w t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : Filter.Tendsto D (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds (W t)) := by
    rw [hDdef]; exact (slope w (W t) t).1 (hw t)
  have hsub : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s - t) (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s - t) (nhds t) (nhds (t - t)) :=
      (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).tendsto t
    rw [sub_self] at h1
    exact h1.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hcont : Filter.Tendsto w (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds (w t)) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => w t + (s - t) • D s) (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ)
        (nhds (w t + (0 : ℝ) • W t)) := tendsto_const_nhds.add (hsub.smul hD)
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at h1
    refine h1.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    have hs' : s - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hs
    rw [hDdef]
    simp only [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hs', one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
  
  have hS : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => w s + w t) (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ) (nhds (w t + w t)) :=
    hcont.add tendsto_const_nhds
  choose Pq hPq using fun s => mulex (D s) (w s + w t)
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ := mulex (W t) (w t + w t)
  have hP := multend _ D (fun s => w s + w t) Pq (W t) (w t + w t) P0 hD hS hPq hP0
  have hL : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (D s)) (nhdsWithin t {t}ᶜ)
      (nhds (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (W t))) :=
    ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ).continuous.tendsto (W t)).comp hD
  have hsum := (hL.sub (hD.const_smul a)).add hP
  refine ⟨SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (W t) - a • W t + P0, (slope _ _ t).2 ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · 
    refine hsum.congr (fun s => ?_)
    ext x
    simp only [SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      hPq]
    rw [hDdef]
    simp only [map_smul, map_sub, SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.sub_apply,
      SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply, hsq]
    ring
  · simp only [SchwartzMap.add_apply, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply, hP0]
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (rgreen κ w) (2 * (w x - κ) * rgreen κ w x + 1) x

signature.name: rgreen_hasDerivAt
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (rgreen κ w) (2 * (w x - κ) * rgreen κ w x + 1) x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, W t = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, w y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y, F y = Real.exp (2 * κ * y - 2 * W y) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, E t = Real.exp (-2 * κ * t + 2 * W t) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, J t = ∫ y in Set.Iic t, F y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ y, ‖w y‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hii : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun y => w y) volume a b :=
    fun a b => w.continuous.intervalIntegrable a b
  have hWf : W = fun t => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, w y := funext hW
  have hWd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (w t) t := by
    intro t
    rw [hWf]
    exact (w.continuous.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 t).hasDerivAt
  have hWc : Continuous W := by
    rw [hWf]
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hii 0
  have hFf : F = fun y => Real.exp (2 * κ * y - 2 * W y) := funext hF
  have hFc : Continuous F := by
    rw [hFf]
    exact Real.continuous_exp.comp
      ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).sub (continuous_const.mul hWc))
  
  have hWb : ∀ y, |W y| ≤ A := by
    intro y
    rw [hW, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, hA]
    refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm_uIoc).trans ?_
    exact setIntegral_le_integral ((w.integrable (μ := volume)).norm)
      (ae_of_all _ fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hFint : ∀ c : ℝ, IntegrableOn F (Set.Iic c) := by
    intro c
    refine Integrable.mono'
      ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * κ) c).const_mul
        (Real.exp (2 * A)))
      hFc.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
    rw [hF, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.abs_exp, ← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have := (abs_le.1 (hWb y)).1
    linarith
  
  have hJd : HasDerivAt J (F x) x := by
    have hJf : J = fun t => J 0 + ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, F y := by
      funext t
      have := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hFint 0) (hFint t)
      rw [hJ t, hJ 0]
      linarith
    rw [hJf]
    exact ((hFc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt).const_add _
  
  have hEd : HasDerivAt E (E x * (-2 * κ + 2 * w x)) x := by
    have hEf : E = fun t => Real.exp (-2 * κ * t + 2 * W t) := funext hE
    have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun t => -2 * κ * t + 2 * W t) (-2 * κ + 2 * w x) x :=
      (((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul (-2 * κ)).add ((hWd x).const_mul 2)).congr_deriv
        (by ring)
    rw [hEf]
    exact h0.exp
  have hEF : E x * F x = 1 := by
    rw [hE, hF, ← Real.exp_add,
      show (-2 * κ * x + 2 * W x) + (2 * κ * x - 2 * W x) = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
  
  have hclosed : ∀ t, rgreen κ w t = E t * J t := by
    intro t
    have h1 : ∀ s : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (t - s)..t, w y) =
        E t * F (t - s) := by
      intro s
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hii 0 t) (hii 0 (t - s)), ← hW, ← hW,
        hE, hF, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    have h2 : rgreen κ w t = ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), E t * F (t - s) := by
      unfold rgreen
      congr 1
      funext s
      exact h1 s
    have h3 : (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), F (t - s)) = ∫ u in Set.Iic (0 : ℝ), F (t + u) := by
      have := integral_comp_neg_Ioi (0 : ℝ) (fun u => F (t + u))
      simp only [neg_zero] at this
      rw [← this]
      congr 1
    have h4 : (∫ u in Set.Iic (0 : ℝ), F (t + u)) = ∫ y in Set.Iic t, F y := by
      rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic, ← integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic]
      rw [← integral_add_right_eq_self (fun y => (Set.Iic t).indicator F y) t]
      congr 1
      funext u
      simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_Iic]
      by_cases hu : u ≤ 0
      · rw [if_pos hu, if_pos (by linarith), add_comm]
      · rw [if_neg hu, if_neg (by linarith)]
    rw [h2, integral_const_mul, hJ, h3, h4]
  have hfun : rgreen κ w = fun t => E t * J t := funext hclosed
  rw [hclosed x, hfun]
  exact (hEd.mul hJd).congr_deriv (by rw [hEF]; ring)

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |rgreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ)| ≤ C

signature.name: rgreen_offset_decay
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |rgreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ)| ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k
  
  have hexp1 : ∀ t : ℝ, |Real.exp t - 1| ≤ |t| * Real.exp |t| := by
    intro t
    rcases le_or_gt 0 t with ht | ht
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp t
      have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-t)
      have h3 : Real.exp t * Real.exp (-t) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
      have hp := Real.exp_pos t
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hp.le]
    · rw [abs_of_neg ht]
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp t
      have h5 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (-t) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
      have h4 : Real.exp t ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 ht.le
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 (neg_nonneg.2 ht.le)]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP0, hpoly⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ, 0 ≤ P ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → (1 + s) ^ (k + 1) ≤ P * Real.exp (κ * s) := by
    refine ⟨((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp κ / κ ^ (k + 1), by positivity, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    have hu : 0 ≤ κ * (1 + s) := by positivity
    have h := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (κ * (1 + s)) hu (k + 1)
    rw [mul_pow, show κ * (1 + s) = κ + κ * s by ring, Real.exp_add] at h
    have hf : (0 : ℝ) < ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos _
    have hk : 0 < κ ^ (k + 1) := pow_pos hκ _
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hf] at h
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hk]
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ, (1 + |y|) ^ k * |w y| ≤ M := by
    refine ⟨2 ^ k * ((Finset.Iic (k, 0)).sup fun m => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ m.1 m.2) w,
      fun y => ?_⟩
    have h := SchwartzMap.one_add_le_sup_seminorm_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (m := (k, 0)) (le_refl k) (le_refl 0) w y
    rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (by positivity) (hM 0)
  have hpe : ∀ x s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      (1 + |x|) ^ k * |∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y| ≤ M * (1 + s) ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro x s hs
    have hb : ∀ y ∈ Set.uIoc (x - s) x, ‖(1 + |x|) ^ k * w y‖ ≤ M * (1 + s) ^ k := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
      obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
      have hxy : |x| ≤ |y| + s := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub x y
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ x - y by linarith)] at this
        linarith
      have h1 : 1 + |x| ≤ (1 + |y|) * (1 + s) := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg y]
      have h2 : (1 + |x|) ^ k ≤ (1 + |y|) ^ k * (1 + s) ^ k := by
        rw [← mul_pow]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 k
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + |x|) ^ k)]
      calc (1 + |x|) ^ k * |w y| ≤ (1 + |y|) ^ k * (1 + s) ^ k * |w y| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = (1 + s) ^ k * ((1 + |y|) ^ k * |w y|) := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 + s) ^ k * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM y) (by positivity)
        _ = M * (1 + s) ^ k := by ring
    have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + |x|) ^ k),
      show x - (x - s) = s by ring, abs_of_nonneg hs] at h
    have hMs : 0 ≤ M * (1 + s) ^ k := mul_nonneg hM0 (by positivity)
    calc _ ≤ M * (1 + s) ^ k * s := h
      _ ≤ M * (1 + s) ^ k * (1 + s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hMs
      _ = M * (1 + s) ^ (k + 1) := by ring
  
  have hwi : Integrable (fun y => |w y|) := (w.integrable).abs
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ y, |w y| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hA]; exact integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hI : ∀ x s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → |∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y| ≤ A := by
    intro x s hs
    have hab : x - s ≤ x := by linarith
    rw [hA]
    calc |∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y| ≤ ∫ y in (x - s)..x, |w y| :=
          intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hab
      _ = ∫ y in Set.Ioc (x - s) x, |w y| := intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab
      _ ≤ ∫ y, |w y| :=
          setIntegral_le_integral hwi (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => abs_nonneg _)
  
  have h2κ : 0 < 2 * κ := by linarith
  have hexpint : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    refine (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 h2κ).congr_fun (fun s _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
    show Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * s) = Real.exp (-2 * κ * s)
    congr 1
    ring
  have hexpint1 : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * s)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hκ
  have hexpval : ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    rw [integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : -2 * κ < 0) 0, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero,
      show (-2 * κ) = -(2 * κ) by ring, neg_div_neg_eq]
  have hexpval1 : ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-κ * s) = 1 / κ := by
    rw [integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : -κ < 0) 0, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, neg_div_neg_eq]
  have hii : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun y => w y) volume a b :=
    fun a b => w.continuous.intervalIntegrable a b
  have hWc : Continuous fun b => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..b, w y :=
    intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hii 0
  
  refine ⟨2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * M * P / κ, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hIeq : ∀ s : ℝ, (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) =
      (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..x, w y) - ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(x - s), w y :=
    fun s => (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hii 0 x) (hii 0 (x - s))).symm
  have hcont : Continuous fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) := by
    have hfe : (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) =
        fun s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s +
          2 * ((∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..x, w y) - ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(x - s), w y)) := by
      funext s; rw [hIeq s]
    rw [hfe]
    have hc2 : Continuous fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(x - s), w y :=
      hWc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
    exact Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).add
      (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub hc2)))
  have hint : IntegrableOn
      (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (Integrable.const_mul hexpint (Real.exp (2 * A)))
      hcont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
    show ‖Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (2 * A) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
    have := (abs_le.1 (hI x s (le_of_lt hs))).2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = (1 + |x|) ^ k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hcdef]; positivity
  have hb : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ‖c * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * s))‖ ≤
        2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * M * P * Real.exp (-κ * s) := by
    intro s hs
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := le_of_lt hs
    obtain ⟨I, hIdef⟩ : ∃ I : ℝ, I = ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hIdef]
    have hIA : |I| ≤ A := by rw [hIdef]; exact hI x s hs0
    have hcI : c * |I| ≤ M * (1 + s) ^ (k + 1) := by rw [hIdef, hcdef]; exact hpe x s hs0
    have hE : 0 < Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hsplit : Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * I) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) =
        Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (Real.exp (2 * I) - 1) := by rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
    have h3 := hexp1 (2 * I)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_two] at h3
    have h4 : Real.exp (2 * |I|) ≤ Real.exp (2 * A) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
    have h5 : |Real.exp (2 * I) - 1| ≤ 2 * |I| * Real.exp (2 * A) :=
      le_trans h3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (by positivity))
    have h6 : c * |I| ≤ M * P * Real.exp (κ * s) := by
      refine le_trans hcI ?_
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoly s hs0) hM0
    have h7 : Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * Real.exp (κ * s) = Real.exp (-κ * s) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [hsplit, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0, abs_of_pos hE]
    calc c * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * |Real.exp (2 * I) - 1|)
        ≤ c * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (2 * |I| * Real.exp (2 * A))) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (c * |I|) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (M * P * Real.exp (κ * s)) := by
          gcongr
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * M * P * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * Real.exp (κ * s)) := by ring
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * M * P * Real.exp (-κ * s) := by rw [h7]
  have hdiff : (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      c * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * s))) =
        c * (rgreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ)) := by
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub hint hexpint, hexpval]
    rfl
  have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
    (hexpint1.const_mul (2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * M * P))
    (by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
      exact hb s hs)
  rw [hdiff, integral_const_mul, hexpval1, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0] at hnorm
  have hxk : |x| ^ k ≤ c := by
    rw [hcdef]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) (by linarith) k
  calc |x| ^ k * |rgreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ)| ≤ c * |rgreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ)| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxk (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * M * P * (1 / κ) := hnorm
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (2 * A) * M * P / κ := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(c : ℝ) (a b : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt g ((c + a x) * g x + b x) x)
    (hdec : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |g x| ≤ C) :

signature.name: schwartz_of_linear_ode
signature.statement:
(c : ℝ) (a b : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt g ((c + a x) * g x + b x) x)
    (hdec : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |g x| ≤ C) :
    ∃ γ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, γ x = g x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ g := fun x => (hg x).differentiableAt
  have hD : deriv g = fun x => (c + a x) * g x + b x := funext fun x => (hg x).deriv
  have ha : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n (a : ℝ → ℝ) := fun n => contDiff_infty.1 (a.smooth ⊤) n
  have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n (b : ℝ → ℝ) := fun n => contDiff_infty.1 (b.smooth ⊤) n
  
  have hsm : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ n g := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact contDiff_zero.2 hdiff.continuous
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
      refine ⟨hdiff, fun h => absurd h (by simp), ?_⟩
      rw [hD]
      exact ((contDiff_const.add (ha n)).mul ih).add (hb n)
  
  have hrec : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g x| ≤
      |c| * |iteratedDeriv n g x|
        + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (n.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x| * |iteratedDeriv (n - i) g x|
        + |iteratedDeriv n (b : ℝ → ℝ) x| := by
    intro n x
    have hD' : deriv g = ((fun y => c * g y) + ((a : ℝ → ℝ) * g)) + (b : ℝ → ℝ) := by
      rw [hD]; funext y; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply]; ring
    have cg : ContDiffAt ℝ n g x := (hsm n).contDiffAt
    have ca : ContDiffAt ℝ n (a : ℝ → ℝ) x := (ha n).contDiffAt
    have cb : ContDiffAt ℝ n (b : ℝ → ℝ) x := (hb n).contDiffAt
    have c1 : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun y => c * g y) x := (contDiff_const.mul (hsm n)).contDiffAt
    have cm : ContDiffAt ℝ n ((a : ℝ → ℝ) * g) x := ((ha n).mul (hsm n)).contDiffAt
    have cs : ContDiffAt ℝ n ((fun y => c * g y) + ((a : ℝ → ℝ) * g)) x := c1.add cm
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hD', iteratedDeriv_add cs cb, iteratedDeriv_add c1 cm,
      iteratedDeriv_const_mul cg, iteratedDeriv_mul ca cg]
    have hS : |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x * iteratedDeriv (n - i) g x| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (n.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x| * |iteratedDeriv (n - i) g x| := by
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_))
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
    have hB : |c * iteratedDeriv n g x| = |c| * |iteratedDeriv n g x| := abs_mul _ _
    have a1 := le_abs_self (iteratedDeriv n (b : ℝ → ℝ) x)
    have a2 := neg_abs_le (iteratedDeriv n (b : ℝ → ℝ) x)
    have b1 := le_abs_self (c * iteratedDeriv n g x)
    have b2 := neg_abs_le (c * iteratedDeriv n g x)
    have s1 := le_abs_self (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x * iteratedDeriv (n - i) g x)
    have s2 := neg_abs_le (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (n.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x * iteratedDeriv (n - i) g x)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hA : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ A := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := a.decay 0 i
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x => ?_⟩
    have := hC.2 x
    simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, pow_zero,
      one_mul] at this
    exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  choose Aa hAa0 hAa using hA
  have hbd : ∀ n k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv n (b : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ C := by
    intro n k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := b.decay k n
    refine ⟨C, fun x => ?_⟩
    have := hC.2 x
    rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  
  have hQ : ∀ m k : ℕ, ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv j g x| ≤ D := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hdec k
      refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun j hj x => ?_⟩
      have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.le_zero.1 hj
      subst hj0
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      exact (hC x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k
      obtain ⟨Dk, hDk0, hDk⟩ := ih k
      obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hbd m k
      refine ⟨max Dk (|c| * Dk + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * Aa i * Dk + Cb),
        le_trans hDk0 (le_max_left _ _), fun j hj x => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (m + 1) with hjm | hjm
      · exact (hDk j (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hjm) x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · have hj' : j = m + 1 := le_antisymm hj hjm
        subst hj'
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right _ _)
        have hxk : 0 ≤ |x| ^ k := pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) k
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrec m x) hxk
        have h2 := hCb x
        have h3 : |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv m g x| ≤ Dk := hDk m le_rfl x
        have h4 : |x| ^ k * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
            (m.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x| * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) g x| ≤
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) * Aa i * Dk := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
          have e1 := hAa i x
          have e2 : |x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) g x| ≤ Dk := hDk (m - i) (Nat.sub_le m i) x
          have e3 : |iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x| * (|x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) g x|) ≤
              Aa i * Dk :=
            mul_le_mul e1 e2 (mul_nonneg hxk (abs_nonneg _)) (hAa0 i)
          have e4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3
            (Nat.cast_nonneg (m.choose i) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m.choose i)
          calc |x| ^ k * ((m.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x|
                * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) g x|)
              = (m.choose i : ℝ) * (|iteratedDeriv i (a : ℝ → ℝ) x|
                * (|x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv (m - i) g x|)) := by ring
            _ ≤ (m.choose i : ℝ) * (Aa i * Dk) := e4
            _ = (m.choose i : ℝ) * Aa i * Dk := by ring
        have h5 : |x| ^ k * (|c| * |iteratedDeriv m g x|) ≤ |c| * Dk := by
          calc |x| ^ k * (|c| * |iteratedDeriv m g x|)
              = |c| * (|x| ^ k * |iteratedDeriv m g x|) := by ring
            _ ≤ |c| * Dk := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (abs_nonneg c)
        rw [mul_add, mul_add] at h1
        linarith
  
  refine ⟨⟨g, contDiff_infty.2 hsm, fun k n => ?_⟩, fun x => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, -, hDn⟩ := hQ n k
  refine ⟨D, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact hDn n le_rfl x

informal_problem.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (f : E → E) (K : NNReal) (hf : LipschitzWith K f) (x₀ : E) :
    ∃ γ : ℝ → E, γ 0 = x₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt γ (f (γ t)) t

signature.name: lipschitz_ode_global
signature.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (f : E → E) (K : NNReal) (hf : LipschitzWith K f) (x₀ : E) :
    ∃ γ : ℝ → E, γ 0 = x₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt γ (f (γ t)) t

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hconcat : ∀ (a b c : ℝ), a ≤ b → b ≤ c → ∀ (γ₁ γ₂ : ℝ → E),
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivWithinAt γ₁ (f (γ₁ t)) (Set.Icc a b) t) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc b c, HasDerivWithinAt γ₂ (f (γ₂ t)) (Set.Icc b c) t) →
      γ₁ b = γ₂ b →
      ∃ g : ℝ → E, (∀ t, t ≤ b → g t = γ₁ t) ∧ (∀ t, b ≤ t → g t = γ₂ t) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a c, HasDerivWithinAt g (f (g t)) (Set.Icc a c) t := by
    intro a b c hab hbc γ₁ γ₂ h₁ h₂ hb
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → E, g = fun t => if t ≤ b then γ₁ t else γ₂ t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have e1 : ∀ t, t ≤ b → g t = γ₁ t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hg]
      exact if_pos ht
    have e2 : ∀ t, b ≤ t → g t = γ₂ t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hg]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht with h | h
      · show (if t ≤ b then γ₁ t else γ₂ t) = γ₂ t
        rw [if_pos (le_of_eq h.symm), ← h, hb]
      · exact if_neg (not_le.2 h)
    have D₁ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivWithinAt g (f (g t)) (Set.Icc a b) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [e1 t ht.2]
      exact (h₁ t ht).congr (fun s hs => e1 s hs.2) (e1 t ht.2)
    have D₂ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc b c, HasDerivWithinAt g (f (g t)) (Set.Icc b c) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [e2 t ht.1]
      exact (h₂ t ht).congr (fun s hs => e2 s hs.1) (e2 t ht.1)
    refine ⟨g, e1, e2, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    rcases lt_trichotomy t b with h | h | h
    · have hmem : Set.Icc a b ∈ nhdsWithin t (Set.Icc a c) := by
        apply Filter.mem_of_superset (inter_mem_nhdsWithin (Set.Icc a c) (Iio_mem_nhds h))
        rintro s ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
        exact ⟨hs1.1, le_of_lt hs2⟩
      exact (D₁ t ⟨ht.1, h.le⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hmem
    · rw [h, ← Set.Icc_union_Icc_eq_Icc hab hbc]
      exact (D₁ b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩).union (D₂ b ⟨le_rfl, hbc⟩)
    · have hmem : Set.Icc b c ∈ nhdsWithin t (Set.Icc a c) := by
        apply Filter.mem_of_superset (inter_mem_nhdsWithin (Set.Icc a c) (Ioi_mem_nhds h))
        rintro s ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
        exact ⟨le_of_lt hs2, hs1.2⟩
      exact (D₂ t ⟨h.le, ht.2⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hmem
  
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := K.2
  obtain ⟨ε, hεdef⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = 1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε : 0 < ε := by rw [hεdef]; positivity
  have hKε : (K : ℝ) * ε ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [hεdef, mul_one_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    linarith
  
  have hloc : ∀ (τ : ℝ) (y : E), ∃ α : ℝ → E, α τ = y ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (τ - ε) (τ + ε),
        HasDerivWithinAt α (f (α t)) (Set.Icc (τ - ε) (τ + ε)) t := by
    intro τ y
    have hτ : τ ∈ Set.Icc (τ - ε) (τ + ε) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hF : 0 ≤ ‖f y‖ := norm_nonneg _
    let a : NNReal := ⟨2 * ε * ‖f y‖ + 1, by positivity⟩
    let L : NNReal := ⟨‖f y‖ + K * (2 * ε * ‖f y‖ + 1), by positivity⟩
    have hP : IsPicardLindelof (fun _ => f) (⟨τ, hτ⟩ : Set.Icc (τ - ε) (τ + ε)) y a 0 L K := by
      apply IsPicardLindelof.of_time_independent
      · intro x hx
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hx
        show ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖f y‖ + K * (2 * ε * ‖f y‖ + 1)
        have h1 := hf.norm_sub_le x y
        have h2 := norm_sub_norm_le (f x) (f y)
        have h3 : (K : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ ≤ K * (2 * ε * ‖f y‖ + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hK0
        linarith
      · exact hf.lipschitzOnWith
      · show (‖f y‖ + K * (2 * ε * ‖f y‖ + 1)) * max ((τ + ε) - τ) (τ - (τ - ε)) ≤
          (2 * ε * ‖f y‖ + 1) - ((0 : NNReal) : ℝ)
        have hm : max ((τ + ε) - τ) (τ - (τ - ε)) = ε := by
          rw [show (τ + ε) - τ = ε by ring, show τ - (τ - ε) = ε by ring, max_self]
        rw [hm, NNReal.coe_zero, sub_zero]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hε.le hF) (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - 2 * (K * ε))]
    obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := hP.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt₀
    exact ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩
  
  have nested : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ γ : ℝ → E, γ 0 = x₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε)) (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε),
        HasDerivWithinAt γ (f (γ t)) (Set.Icc (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε)) (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε)) t := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := hloc 0 x₀
      refine ⟨α, hα0, ?_⟩
      simp only [zero_sub, zero_add] at hα
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, one_mul]
      exact hα
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨γ, hγ0, hγ⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hT] at hγ
      have hTpos : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; positivity
      have hT1 : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * ε = T + ε := by rw [hT]; push_cast; ring
      rw [hT1]
      obtain ⟨αm, hαm0, hαm⟩ := hloc (-T) (γ (-T))
      have hαm' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T - ε) (-T),
          HasDerivWithinAt αm (f (αm t)) (Set.Icc (-T - ε) (-T)) t := by
        intro t ht
        have hsub : Set.Icc (-T - ε) (-T) ⊆ Set.Icc (-T - ε) (-T + ε) :=
          Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (by linarith)
        exact (hαm t (hsub ht)).mono hsub
      obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁l, hg₁r, hg₁⟩ :=
        hconcat (-T - ε) (-T) T (by linarith) (by linarith) αm γ hαm' hγ hαm0
      obtain ⟨αp, hαp0, hαp⟩ := hloc T (g₁ T)
      have hαp' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc T (T + ε),
          HasDerivWithinAt αp (f (αp t)) (Set.Icc T (T + ε)) t := by
        intro t ht

          Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) le_rfl

        hconcat (-T - ε) T (T + ε) (by linarith) (by linarith) g₁ αp hg₁ hαp' hαp0.symm
      refine ⟨g₂, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hg₂l 0 hTpos.le, hg₁r 0 (by linarith), hγ0]
      · have e : -(T + ε) = -T - ε := by ring
        rw [e]
        exact hg₂
  
  choose Γ hΓ0 hΓ using nested
  have hTp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε := fun n => by positivity
  have hA : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε → HasDerivAt (Γ n) (f (Γ n t)) t := by
    intro n t ht

    exact (hΓ n t ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds h1 h2)
  have hB : ∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * ε → |s| ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε →
      Γ m s = Γ n s := by
    intro m n s hm hn
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = min (((m : ℝ) + 1) * ε) (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hRpos : 0 < R := by rw [hR]; exact lt_min (hTp m) (hTp n)
    have hRm : R ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * ε := by rw [hR]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hRn : R ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε := by rw [hR]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R := by
      rw [hR]
      exact abs_le.1 (le_min hm hn)
    have key := ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun _ => f) (s := fun _ => Set.univ) (K := K)
      (fun _ _ => hf.lipschitzOnWith) (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-R) R from ⟨by linarith, hRpos⟩)
      ((HasDerivWithinAt.continuousOn (f' := fun t => f (Γ m t)) (hΓ m)).mono
        (Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) hRm))
      (fun t ht => hA m t (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]))
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      ((HasDerivWithinAt.continuousOn (f' := fun t => f (Γ n t)) (hΓ n)).mono
        (Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) hRn))
      (fun t ht => hA n t (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]))
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      (by rw [hΓ0, hΓ0])
    exact key hs
  have hC : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < (((⌈|t| / ε⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * ε := by
    intro t
    have h1 : |t| / ε ≤ ((⌈|t| / ε⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hε] at h1
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨fun t => Γ ⌈|t| / ε⌉₊ t, hΓ0 _, ?_⟩
  intro t
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, n = ⌈|t| / ε⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ht : |t| < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε := by rw [hn]; exact hC t
  have hev : (fun s => Γ ⌈|s| / ε⌉₊ s) =ᶠ[nhds t] Γ n := by
    have hU : Set.Ioo (-(((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε)) (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε) ∈ nhds t := by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.1 ht
      exact Ioo_mem_nhds h1 h2
    filter_upwards [hU] with s hs
    have hs' : |s| < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ε := abs_lt.2 hs
    exact hB _ n s (hC s).le hs'.le
  have hd := (hA n t ht).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  show HasDerivAt (fun s => Γ ⌈|s| / ε⌉₊ s) (f (Γ ⌈|t| / ε⌉₊ t)) t
  rw [← hn]
  exact hd

signature.statement:

by

    have hx : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
    have pw : ∀ y, |x - y| ≤ s → ‖w₁ y - w₂ y‖ ≤ 2 * D * (1 + s ^ 2) / (1 + x ^ 2) := by

      have hy2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) := by positivity

      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right peetre ha, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hD y) hs2]
    have hC : ∀ a b : ℝ, (∀ y ∈ Set.uIoc a b, |x - y| ≤ s) → |b - a| = s →

          (h₂.intervalIntegrable _ _)).symm

    · refine hC _ _ (fun y hy => ?_) (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_nonneg hs])

      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |F₂ s| ≤ C * Real.exp (-s)) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |F₁ s - F₂ s| ≤ K * g s) →
      |(∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, F₁ s) - ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, F₂ s| ≤ K * ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, g s := by

      (integrableOn_exp_neg_Ioi 0).const_mul C
    have hi : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous F → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |F s| ≤ C * Real.exp (-s)) →

      have hpos : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-s) := by positivity

            ring
  have hR : |rgreenRC κ ρ w₁ x - rgreenRC κ ρ w₂ x| ≤
      (2 * Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * (2 * D / (1 + x ^ 2))) *
        ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (s + s ^ 3) * Real.exp (-s) := by
    unfold rgreenRC
    refine s4 _ _ (fun s => (s + s ^ 3) * Real.exp (-s)) (Real.exp (ρ ^ 2)) _ c₁' c₂' s3
      ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s hs
      rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact (s1 s _ 0 hs.le).1
    · intro s hs
      rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact (s1 s _ 0 hs.le).1
    · intro s hs
      have e1 := (s1 s (∫ y in x..(x + s), w₁ y) (∫ y in x..(x + s), w₂ y) hs.le).2
      have e2 := (s2 w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ D hD x s hs.le).2
      have hpos : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-s) := by positivity
      calc _ ≤ _ := e1
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-s) * (2 * D / (1 + x ^ 2) * (s + s ^ 3)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hpos
        _ = (2 * Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * (2 * D / (1 + x ^ 2))) * ((s + s ^ 3) * Real.exp (-s)) := by
            ring
  have hw : wfieldC κ ρ w₁ x - wfieldC κ ρ w₂ x = 8 * κ ^ 5 *
      ((rgreenC κ ρ w₁ x - rgreenC κ ρ w₂ x) - (rgreenRC κ ρ w₁ x - rgreenRC κ ρ w₂ x)) := by
    unfold wfieldC; ring
  rw [hw, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hk5]
  have htri := abs_sub (rgreenC κ ρ w₁ x - rgreenC κ ρ w₂ x)
    (rgreenRC κ ρ w₁ x - rgreenRC κ ρ w₂ x)
  calc (1 + x ^ 2) * (8 * κ ^ 5 * |rgreenC κ ρ w₁ x - rgreenC κ ρ w₂ x -
        (rgreenRC κ ρ w₁ x - rgreenRC κ ρ w₂ x)|)
      ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) * (8 * κ ^ 5 * (2 * ((2 * Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * (2 * D / (1 + x ^ 2))) *
        ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (s + s ^ 3) * Real.exp (-s)))) := by
        gcongr
        linarith
    _ = 64 * κ ^ 5 * Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (s + s ^ 3) * Real.exp (-s)) *
        D := by

        ring

signature.statement:
(κ ρ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    (∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Continuous (wfieldC κ ρ w)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, wfieldC κ ρ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hbound : ∀ s a : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt s) a) ≤
        Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-s) := by
    intro s a hs
    have hb : 0 ≤ ρ * Real.sqrt s := mul_nonneg hρ (Real.sqrt_nonneg s)
    have h1 : wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt s) a ≤ ρ * Real.sqrt s := by
      unfold wclamp
      exact max_le (by linarith) (min_le_right _ _)
    have h2 : 2 * ρ * Real.sqrt s ≤ ρ ^ 2 + Real.sqrt s ^ 2 := two_mul_le_add_sq ρ (Real.sqrt s)
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hs] at h2
    have h3 : -2 * κ * s ≤ -2 * s := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hκ) hs]
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
  have hcontI : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) →
      (∀ x s : ℝ, 0 < s → |F x s| ≤ Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-s)) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), F x s) := by
    intro F hF hb
    refine continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun s => Real.exp (ρ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-s))
      (fun x => (hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (fun x => ?_) (Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_exp_neg_Ioi 0) _)
      (ae_of_all _ fun s => hF.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun s hs => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hb x s hs
  have hwcl : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => wclamp q.1 q.2) := by
    unfold wclamp
    exact continuous_fst.neg.max (continuous_snd.min continuous_fst)
  refine ⟨fun w hw => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, P = fun u => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..u, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hP : Continuous P := by
      rw [hPdef]
      exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (fun a b => hw.intervalIntegrable a b) 0
    have hrepL : ∀ x s : ℝ, (∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) = P x - P (x - s) := by
      intro x s
      rw [hPdef]
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 x)
        (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 (x - s))).symm
    have hrepR : ∀ x s : ℝ, (∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) = P (x + s) - P x := by
      intro x s
      rw [hPdef]
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 (x + s))
        (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 x)).symm
    have hL : rgreenC κ ρ w = fun x => ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt s) (P x - P (x - s))) := by
      funext x
      unfold rgreenC
      simp only [hrepL]
    have hR : rgreenRC κ ρ w = fun x => ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt s) (P (x + s) - P x)) := by
      funext x
      unfold rgreenRC
      simp only [hrepR]
    have hsq : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ρ * Real.sqrt p.2) :=
      continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp continuous_snd)
    have hcL : Continuous (rgreenC κ ρ w) := by
      rw [hL]
      refine hcontI (fun x s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt s)
        (P x - P (x - s)))) ?_ ?_
      · have hin : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt p.2) (P p.1 - P (p.1 - p.2))) :=
          hwcl.comp (hsq.prodMk ((hP.comp continuous_fst).sub
            (hP.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd))))
        exact Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add
          (continuous_const.mul hin))
      · intro x s hs
        rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        exact hbound s _ hs.le
    have hcR : Continuous (rgreenRC κ ρ w) := by
      rw [hR]
      refine hcontI (fun x s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt s)
        (P (x + s) - P x))) ?_ ?_
      · have hin : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt p.2) (P (p.1 + p.2) - P p.1)) :=
          hwcl.comp (hsq.prodMk ((hP.comp (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd)).sub
            (hP.comp continuous_fst)))
        exact Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add
          (continuous_const.mul hin))
      · intro x s hs
        rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        exact hbound s _ hs.le
    have hfun : wfieldC κ ρ w = fun x => 8 * κ ^ 5 * (rgreenC κ ρ w x - rgreenRC κ ρ w x) := rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact continuous_const.mul (hcL.sub hcR)
  · simp [wfieldC, rgreenC, rgreenRC]

informal_problem.statement:
(κ ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w)
    (hw2 : Integrable (fun x => w x ^ 2) (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hE : ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, wfieldC κ ρ w x = wfield κ w x

signature.name: wfieldC_eq_wfield
signature.statement:
(κ ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w)
    (hw2 : Integrable (fun x => w x ^ 2) (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (hE : ∫ x : ℝ, w x ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, wfieldC κ ρ w x = wfield κ w x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hCS : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b →
      (∫ y in a..b, w y) ^ 2 ≤ (b - a) * ∫ y in a..b, w y ^ 2 := by
    intro a b hab
    have hg : 0 ≤ ∫ y in a..b, ((b - a) * w y - ∫ z in a..b, w z) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab (fun u _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hexp : (∫ y in a..b, ((b - a) * w y - ∫ z in a..b, w z) ^ 2) =
        (b - a) ^ 2 * (∫ y in a..b, w y ^ 2)
          - (2 * (b - a) * ∫ z in a..b, w z) * (∫ y in a..b, w y)
          + (b - a) * (∫ z in a..b, w z) ^ 2 := by
      have e : (fun y => ((b - a) * w y - ∫ z in a..b, w z) ^ 2) =
          fun y => ((b - a) ^ 2 * w y ^ 2 - (2 * (b - a) * ∫ z in a..b, w z) * w y)
            + (∫ z in a..b, w z) ^ 2 := by
        funext y; ring
      rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_sub,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      all_goals exact Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) _ _
    rw [hexp] at hg
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hab with h | h
    · subst h
      simp
    · have hL : 0 < b - a := by linarith
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcon hL]
  
  have hwin : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → (∫ y in a..b, w y ^ 2) ≤ ρ ^ 2 := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab]
    exact (setIntegral_le_integral hw2
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => sq_nonneg (w y))).trans hE
  
  have hbd : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → |∫ y in a..b, w y| ≤ ρ * Real.sqrt (b - a) := by
    intro a b hab
    have h1 := hCS a b hab
    have h2 := hwin a b hab
    have hs : 0 ≤ b - a := by linarith
    have h3 : (∫ y in a..b, w y) ^ 2 ≤ (ρ * Real.sqrt (b - a)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hs]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hs]
    exact abs_le.2 (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h3 (mul_nonneg hρ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)))
  
  have key : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |F s| ≤ ρ * Real.sqrt s) →
      (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * wclamp (ρ * Real.sqrt s) (F s))) =
        ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * F s) := by
    intro F hF
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
    have h := abs_le.1 (hF s hs)
    simp only [wclamp, min_eq_left h.2, max_eq_right h.1]
  intro x
  have e1 : rgreenC κ ρ w x = rgreen κ w x := by
    unfold rgreenC rgreen
    exact key (fun s => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) (fun s hs => by
      have h := hbd (x - s) x (by linarith)
      rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at h)
  have e2 : rgreenRC κ ρ w x = rgreenR κ w x := by
    unfold rgreenRC rgreenR
    exact key (fun s => ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) (fun s hs => by
      have h := hbd x (x + s) (by linarith)
      rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at h)
  unfold wfieldC wfield
  rw [e1, e2]

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w)
    (hm : ∃ m : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |w x| ≤ m) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, w x * wfield κ w x = 0

signature.name: wfield_energy_orthogonal
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w)
    (hm : ∃ m : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |w x| ≤ m) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, w x * wfield κ w x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hm
  
  have hwi : Integrable w (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul m) hw.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hp]
    linarith [hm x, mul_comm (|w x|) (1 + x ^ 2)]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, P = fun u => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..u, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPd : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt P (w u) u := by
    intro u; rw [hPdef]; exact (hw.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 u).hasDerivAt
  have hPc : Continuous P := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun u => (hPd u).continuousAt
  have hwin : ∀ a b : ℝ, ∫ y in a..b, w y = P b - P a := by
    intro a b
    rw [hPdef]
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 b)
      (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 a)).symm
  
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ : ∃ A₀ : ℝ, A₀ = ∫ y, |w y| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hbd : ∀ a b : ℝ, |∫ y in a..b, w y| ≤ A₀ := by
    have key : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → |∫ y in a..b, w y| ≤ A₀ := by
      intro a b hab
      refine (intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hab).trans ?_
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab, hA₀]
      exact setIntegral_le_integral hwi.abs (ae_of_all _ fun y => abs_nonneg (w y))
    intro a b
    rcases le_total a b with hab | hab
    · exact key a b hab
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm, abs_neg]; exact key b a hab
  
  have htop : ∀ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro s
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto P Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), w y)) := by
      rw [hPdef]
      exact intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Ioi 0 hwi.integrableOn Filter.tendsto_id
    have hs : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x - s) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using
        Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop (-s) Filter.tendsto_id
    have h2 := h1.sub (h1.comp hs)
    rw [sub_self] at h2
    refine h2.congr (fun x => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [hwin]
  have hbot : ∀ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y)
      Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    intro s
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ y in x..(0 : ℝ), w y) Filter.atBot
        (nhds (∫ y in Set.Iic (0 : ℝ), w y)) :=
      intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Iic 0 hwi.integrableOn Filter.tendsto_id
    have hs : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x - s) Filter.atBot Filter.atBot := by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using
        Filter.tendsto_atBot_add_const_right Filter.atBot (-s) Filter.tendsto_id
    have h2 := (h1.comp hs).sub h1
    rw [sub_self] at h2
    refine h2.congr (fun x => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [hwin, hwin, hwin]
    ring
  
  have hfub : ∀ (E : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => E p.1 p.2) → ∀ M : ℝ,
      (∀ x s : ℝ, |E x s| ≤ M) →
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => w x * ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + E x s))
        (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
      ∫ x : ℝ, w x * ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + E x s) =
        ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ x : ℝ, w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + E x s) := by
    intro E hE M hM
    have hF : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun x s => w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + E x s))
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) := by
      have hc : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun x s => w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + E x s)) := by
        show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w p.1 * Real.exp (-2 * κ * p.2 + E p.1 p.2))
        exact (hw.comp continuous_fst).mul
          (Real.continuous_exp.comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_snd).add hE))
      have hG : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => |w p.1| * (Real.exp M * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * p.2)))
          ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) :=
        Integrable.mul_prod hwi.abs
          ((exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * κ)).const_mul (Real.exp M))
      refine hG.mono' hc.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
      show ‖w p.1 * Real.exp (-2 * κ * p.2 + E p.1 p.2)‖ ≤
        |w p.1| * (Real.exp M * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * p.2))
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
        ← Real.exp_add]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_) (abs_nonneg _)
      have := (le_abs_self (E p.1 p.2)).trans (hM p.1 p.2)
      linarith
    have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hF
    have hI := hF.integral_prod_left
    have hpull : ∀ x : ℝ, ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), w x * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + E x s) =
        w x * ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + E x s) :=
      fun x => integral_const_mul _ _
    simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, hpull] at hswap hI
    exact ⟨hI, hswap⟩
  
  have hslice : ∀ c s : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) := by
    intro c s
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ, A = fun x => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have htr : ∫ x : ℝ, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x) := by
      have := integral_sub_right_eq_self (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ))
        (fun x => w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y)) s
      simp only [sub_add_cancel] at this
      rw [← this, hAdef]
    suffices key : ∫ x : ℝ, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x) by
      rw [htr, ← key, hAdef]
    have hAd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt A (w x - w (x - s)) x := by
      intro x
      have e : A = fun x => P x - P (x - s) := by
        rw [hAdef]; funext x; exact hwin _ _
      rw [e]
      exact (hPd x).sub ((hPd (x - s)).comp_sub_const x s)
    have hAc : Continuous A := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hAd x).continuousAt
    have hAb : ∀ x : ℝ, A x ≤ A₀ := fun x => by
      rw [hAdef]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hbd _ _)
    have hK : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (c + 2 * A₀) := fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith [hAb x])
    have hec : Continuous (fun x => Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) :=
      Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hAc))
    have hg₁ : Integrable (fun x => w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      refine (hwi.abs.const_mul (Real.exp (c + 2 * A₀))).mono' (hw.mul hec).aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
      have h1 := hK x
      have h2 := abs_nonneg (w x)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      nlinarith
    have hg₂ : Integrable (fun x => w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      refine ((hwi.comp_sub_right s).abs.const_mul (Real.exp (c + 2 * A₀))).mono'
        ((hw.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).mul hec).aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
      have h1 := hK x
      have h2 := abs_nonneg (w (x - s))
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      nlinarith
    have hhd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.exp (c + 2 * A x))
        (2 * (w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) - 2 * (w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x))) x := by
      intro x
      have := (((hAd x).const_mul 2).const_add c).exp
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hlim : ∀ l : Filter ℝ, Filter.Tendsto A l (nhds 0) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun x => Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) l (nhds (Real.exp c)) := by
      intro l hl
      have := (hl.const_mul 2).const_add c
      rw [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
      exact (Real.continuous_exp.tendsto c).comp this
    have hAtop : Filter.Tendsto A Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by rw [hAdef]; exact htop s
    have hAbot : Filter.Tendsto A Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by rw [hAdef]; exact hbot s
    have hint : Integrable (fun x => 2 * (w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) -
        2 * (w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x))) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      (hg₁.const_mul 2).sub (hg₂.const_mul 2)
    have hftc := integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hhd hint (hlim _ hAbot) (hlim _ hAtop)
    have e1 : ∫ x, (2 * (w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) -
        2 * (w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x))) =
        (2 * ∫ x, w x * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x)) -
          2 * ∫ x, w (x - s) * Real.exp (c + 2 * A x) := by
      rw [integral_sub (hg₁.const_mul 2) (hg₂.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul]
    rw [e1, sub_self] at hftc
    linarith
  
  have hcA : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in (p.1 - p.2)..p.1, w y) := by
    have e : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in (p.1 - p.2)..p.1, w y) =
        fun p => 2 * (P p.1 - P (p.1 - p.2)) := by
      funext p; rw [hwin]
    rw [e]
    exact continuous_const.mul
      ((hPc.comp continuous_fst).sub (hPc.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)))
  have hcB : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in p.1..(p.1 + p.2), w y) := by
    have e : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * ∫ y in p.1..(p.1 + p.2), w y) =
        fun p => 2 * (P (p.1 + p.2) - P p.1) := by
      funext p; rw [hwin]
    rw [e]
    exact continuous_const.mul
      ((hPc.comp (continuous_fst.add continuous_snd)).sub (hPc.comp continuous_fst))
  have hM₁ : ∀ x s : ℝ, |2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y| ≤ 2 * A₀ := by
    intro x s
    rw [abs_mul, abs_two]
    linarith [hbd (x - s) x]
  have hM₂ : ∀ x s : ℝ, |2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y| ≤ 2 * A₀ := by
    intro x s
    rw [abs_mul, abs_two]
    linarith [hbd x (x + s)]
  obtain ⟨hI₁, hF₁⟩ := hfub (fun x s => 2 * ∫ y in (x - s)..x, w y) hcA (2 * A₀) hM₁
  obtain ⟨hI₂, hF₂⟩ := hfub (fun x s => 2 * ∫ y in x..(x + s), w y) hcB (2 * A₀) hM₂
  have hI₁' : Integrable (fun x => w x * rgreen κ w x) (volume : Measure ℝ) := hI₁
  have hI₂' : Integrable (fun x => w x * rgreenR κ w x) (volume : Measure ℝ) := hI₂
  have heq : ∫ x, w x * rgreen κ w x = ∫ x, w x * rgreenR κ w x := by
    refine hF₁.trans (Eq.trans ?_ hF₂.symm)
    congr 1
    funext s
    exact hslice _ _
  have hfield : (fun x => w x * wfield κ w x) =
      fun x => 8 * κ ^ 5 * (w x * rgreen κ w x) - 8 * κ ^ 5 * (w x * rgreenR κ w x) := by
    funext x; simp only [wfield]; ring
  rw [hfield, integral_sub (hI₁'.const_mul _) (hI₂'.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul, heq, sub_self]

informal_problem.statement:
(g D : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (D t) t) (h0 : g 0 < c)
    (hD : ∀ t : ℝ, g t ≤ c → D t = 0) : ∀ t : ℝ, g t = g 0

signature.name: deriv_zero_below_bootstrap
signature.statement:
(g D : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (D t) t) (h0 : g 0 < c)
    (hD : ∀ t : ℝ, g t ≤ c → D t = 0) : ∀ t : ℝ, g t = g 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcont : Continuous g := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hg t).continuousAt
  have hclosed : IsClosed {t : ℝ | g t = g 0} := isClosed_eq hcont continuous_const
  have hopen : IsOpen {t : ℝ | g t = g 0} := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    intro t ht
    have ht' : g t = g 0 := ht
    have hlt : g t < c := by rw [ht']; exact h0
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in nhds t, g s < c :=
      (hcont.continuousAt (x := t)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hlt)
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.1 hev
    refine ⟨ε, hε, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    have key := (convex_ball t ε).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (f := g) (f' := D) (C := 0)
      (fun x _ => (hg x).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun x hx => by rw [hD x (hball x hx).le, norm_zero])
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hε) hs
    rw [zero_mul] at key
    have h2 : ‖g s - g t‖ = 0 := le_antisymm key (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [norm_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h2
    show g s = g 0
    rw [h2, ht']
  have hclopen : IsClopen {t : ℝ | g t = g 0} := ⟨hclosed, hopen⟩
  have huniv : {t : ℝ | g t = g 0} = Set.univ := hclopen.eq_univ ⟨0, rfl⟩
  intro t
  have hmem : t ∈ {t : ℝ | g t = g 0} := by rw [huniv]; exact Set.mem_univ t
  exact hmem

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ → BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (γ' : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hγ : HasDerivAt γ γ' t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, (γ τ x / (1 + x ^ 2)) ^ 2)
      (2 * ∫ x : ℝ, (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (γ' x / (1 + x ^ 2))) t

signature.name: bcf_weighted_energy_hasDerivAt
signature.statement:
(γ : ℝ → BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (γ' : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hγ : HasDerivAt γ γ' t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, (γ τ x / (1 + x ^ 2)) ^ 2)
      (2 * ∫ x : ℝ, (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (γ' x / (1 + x ^ 2))) t

proof.tactics:
by
  have hP : ∀ (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      ‖(f x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (g x / (1 + x ^ 2))‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖g‖ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro f g x
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + x ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
    have hf := f.norm_coe_le_norm x
    have hg := g.norm_coe_le_norm x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hf hg ⊢
    rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hp, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hinv : (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hp1
    have hinv0 : 0 ≤ (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hp.le
    have h1 : |f x| * |g x| ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖g‖ := mul_le_mul hf hg (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    calc |f x| * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (|g x| * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹)
        = (|f x| * |g x|) * ((1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) := by ring
      _ ≤ (‖f‖ * ‖g‖) * ((1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * 1) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv hinv0) (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = ‖f‖ * ‖g‖ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
  have hcont : ∀ f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ,
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (f x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (g x / (1 + x ^ 2))) := by
    intro f g
    have hp : ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) ≠ 0 := fun x => by positivity
    exact (f.continuous.div (by fun_prop) hp).mul (g.continuous.div (by fun_prop) hp)
  have hint : ∀ f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (f x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (g x / (1 + x ^ 2))) volume :=
    fun f g => Integrable.mono' (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (‖f‖ * ‖g‖))
      (hcont f g).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (hP f g))
  have hbd : ∀ f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ,
      ‖∫ x : ℝ, (f x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (g x / (1 + x ^ 2))‖ ≤ Real.pi * ‖f‖ * ‖g‖ := by
    intro f g
    have h := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (‖f‖ * ‖g‖))
      (ae_of_all _ (hP f g))
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq] at h
    linarith
  let L : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun f g => ∫ x : ℝ, (f x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (g x / (1 + x ^ 2)))
      (fun f₁ f₂ g => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
        rw [← integral_add (hint f₁ g) (hint f₂ g)]
        congr 1; funext x; ring)
      (fun c f g => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1; funext x; ring)
      (fun f g₁ g₂ => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
        rw [← integral_add (hint f g₁) (hint f g₂)]
        congr 1; funext x; ring)
      (fun c f g => by
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1; funext x; ring)
  let B := L.mkContinuous₂ Real.pi (fun f g => hbd f g)
  have hB : ∀ f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ,
      B f g = ∫ x : ℝ, (f x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (g x / (1 + x ^ 2)) := fun f g => rfl
  have h := ContinuousLinearMap.hasDerivAt_of_bilinear (B := B) hγ hγ
  have hfun : (fun τ : ℝ => B (γ τ) (γ τ)) = fun τ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, (γ τ x / (1 + x ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    funext τ
    rw [hB]
    congr 1; funext x; ring
  have hder : B (γ t) γ' + B γ' (γ t) =
      2 * ∫ x : ℝ, (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (γ' x / (1 + x ^ 2)) := by
    rw [hB, hB]
    have e : (∫ x : ℝ, (γ' x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2))) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, (γ t x / (1 + x ^ 2)) * (γ' x / (1 + x ^ 2)) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    rw [e]; ring
  rw [hfun] at h
  exact h.congr_deriv hder

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (M : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ (f g ω : ℝ → ℝ) (β : ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g →
      (∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |f x| ≤ M) → (∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |g x| ≤ M) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ω x) → (∀ x y : ℝ, ω x ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k * ω y) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, ω y * |f y - g y| ≤ β) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, ω x * |rgreen κ f x - rgreen κ g x| ≤ A * β ∧
        ω x * |rgreenR κ f x - rgreenR κ g x| ≤ A * β

signature.name: rgreen_weighted_lipschitz
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (M : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ (f g ω : ℝ → ℝ) (β : ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g →
      (∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |f x| ≤ M) → (∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |g x| ≤ M) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ω x) → (∀ x y : ℝ, ω x ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k * ω y) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, ω y * |f y - g y| ≤ β) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, ω x * |rgreen κ f x - rgreen κ g x| ≤ A * β ∧
        ω x * |rgreenR κ f x - rgreenR κ g x| ≤ A * β

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ y : ℝ, (1 + y ^ 2) * |f y| ≤ M) → ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b →
      |∫ y in a..b, f y| ≤ Real.pi * M := by
    intro f hM a b hab
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _)) (hM 0)
    have hpt : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖f y‖ ≤ M * (1 / (1 + y ^ 2)) := by
      intro y
      have hp : 0 < 1 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hp, mul_comm]
      exact hM y
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (μ := volume) hab
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y _ => hpt y))
      ((intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_one_div_one_add_sq (a := a) (b := b)).const_mul M)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_one_div_one_add_sq, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    have h2 := Real.arctan_lt_pi_div_two b
    have h3 := Real.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arctan a
    have h4 : M * (Real.arctan b - Real.arctan a) ≤ M * Real.pi :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hM0
    linarith
  
  have s2 : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → ∀ x : ℝ,
      Continuous (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, f y) ∧
        Continuous (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in x..(x + s), f y) := by
    intro f hf x
    have hII : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable f volume a b := fun a b => hf.intervalIntegrable a b
    have hP : Continuous (fun z => ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..z, f y) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hII 0
    constructor
    · have e : (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, f y) =
          fun s => (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, f y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(x - s), f y := by
        funext s
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hII 0 x) (hII 0 (x - s))]
      rw [e]
      exact continuous_const.sub (hP.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
    · have e : (fun s : ℝ => ∫ y in x..(x + s), f y) =
          fun s => (∫ y in (0:ℝ)..(x + s), f y) - ∫ y in (0:ℝ)..x, f y := by
        funext s
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hII 0 (x + s)) (hII 0 x)]
      rw [e]
      exact (hP.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).sub continuous_const
  
  have s3 : ∀ (f g ω : ℝ → ℝ) (β x s : ℝ), Continuous f → Continuous g → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ω x) →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, ω x ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k * ω y) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, ω y * |f y - g y| ≤ β) → 0 ≤ s →
      ω x * |(∫ y in (x - s)..x, f y) - ∫ y in (x - s)..x, g y| ≤
          2 ^ k * β * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k) ∧
        ω x * |(∫ y in x..(x + s), f y) - ∫ y in x..(x + s), g y| ≤
          2 ^ k * β * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k) := by
    intro f g ω β x s hf hg hω hωp hβ hs
    have hβ0 : 0 ≤ β := le_trans (mul_nonneg (hω 0) (abs_nonneg _)) (hβ 0)
    have key : ∀ y : ℝ, (x - y) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 →
        ‖ω x * (f y - g y)‖ ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k * β := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hω x)]
      have hA : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
      have hpow : (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k ≤ (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) k
      calc ω x * |f y - g y| ≤ (2 ^ k * (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k * ω y) * |f y - g y| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hωp x y) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = 2 ^ k * (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k * (ω y * |f y - g y|) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + (x - y) ^ 2) ^ k * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hβ y) hA
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k * β := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hβ0
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    have conv : ∀ a b : ℝ,
        ω x * |(∫ y in a..b, f y) - ∫ y in a..b, g y| = ‖∫ y in a..b, ω x * (f y - g y)‖ := by
      intro a b
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hf.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hg.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hω x)]
    constructor
    · rw [conv]
      have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (a := x - s) (b := x) (C := 2 ^ k * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k * β)
        (f := fun y => ω x * (f y - g y)) (fun y hy => by
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hy
          exact key y (by nlinarith))
      rw [show x - (x - s) = s by ring, abs_of_nonneg hs] at h
      calc _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k * β * s := h
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [conv]
      have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (a := x) (b := x + s) (C := 2 ^ k * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k * β)
        (f := fun y => ω x * (f y - g y)) (fun y hy => by
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hy
          exact key y (by nlinarith))
      rw [show x + s - x = s by ring, abs_of_nonneg hs] at h
      calc _ ≤ 2 ^ k * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k * β * s := h
        _ = _ := by ring
  
  have s4 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, n = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = (n.factorial : ℝ) / κ ^ n * Real.exp κ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψ : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => K * Real.exp ((-κ) * s)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (neg_neg_of_pos hκ) 0).const_mul K
    refine Integrable.mono' hψ (by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k))).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
    have hs0 : 0 < s := hs
    have hnn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k) := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hnn]
    have hb1 : s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k ≤ (1 + s) ^ n := by
      have e : (1 + s) ^ n = (1 + s) * ((1 + s) ^ 2) ^ k := by
        rw [hn, ← pow_mul, pow_succ]; ring
      rw [e]
      apply mul_le_mul (by linarith) (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith) k)
        (by positivity) (by linarith)
    have hκn : 0 < κ ^ n := pow_pos hκ n
    have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < n.factorial := Nat.cast_pos.2 (Nat.factorial_pos n)
    have hb2 : (1 + s) ^ n ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) / κ ^ n * Real.exp (κ + κ * s) := by
      have h := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (κ * (1 + s)) (by positivity) n
      rw [mul_pow, div_le_iff₀ hfac] at h
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hκn]
      have e : κ * (1 + s) = κ + κ * s := by ring
      rw [e] at h
      nlinarith
    have he : Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * Real.exp (κ + κ * s) =
        Real.exp κ * Real.exp ((-κ) * s) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-2 * κ * s)
    calc Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k)
        ≤ Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * ((n.factorial : ℝ) / κ ^ n * Real.exp (κ + κ * s)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb1.trans hb2) hE.le
      _ = (n.factorial : ℝ) / κ ^ n * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * Real.exp (κ + κ * s)) := by ring
      _ = K * Real.exp ((-κ) * s) := by rw [he, hK]; ring
  
  have s5 : ∀ (L D c : ℝ) (a b : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous a → Continuous b →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |a s| ≤ L) → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |b s| ≤ L) → 0 ≤ c →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → c * |a s - b s| ≤ D * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k)) →
      c * |(∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s)) -
          ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * b s)| ≤
        2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * D *
          ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k) := by
    intro L D c a b ha hb haL hbL hc hab
    have E : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → |Real.exp u - Real.exp v| ≤ Real.exp v * |u - v| := by
      intro u v huv
      have h1 : Real.exp u ≤ Real.exp v := Real.exp_le_exp.2 huv
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (u - v)
      have h3 : Real.exp v * Real.exp (u - v) = Real.exp u := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      have hv := Real.exp_pos v
      nlinarith
    have E' : ∀ u v w : ℝ, u ≤ w → v ≤ w →
        |Real.exp u - Real.exp v| ≤ Real.exp w * |u - v| := by
      intro u v w hu hv
      rcases le_total u v with h | h
      · exact (E u v h).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.2 hv) (abs_nonneg _))
      · rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_sub_comm u v]
        exact (E v u h).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.2 hu) (abs_nonneg _))
    have hdom : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * L) * Real.exp ((-2 * κ) * s))
        (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : -2 * κ < 0) 0).const_mul _
    have intF : ∀ a : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous a → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |a s| ≤ L) →
        IntegrableOn (fun s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro a ha haL
      refine Integrable.mono' hdom (by fun_prop : Continuous
        (fun s => Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s))).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have := (le_abs_self (a s)).trans (haL s hs)
      linarith
    have hF := intF a ha haL
    have hG := intF b hb hbL
    rw [← integral_sub hF hG]
    have h3 : c * |∫ s in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s) -
        Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * b s))| =
        ‖∫ s in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), c * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s) -
        Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * b s))‖ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc]
    rw [h3, ← integral_const_mul]
    refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (s4.const_mul _) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
    have hs0 : 0 < s := hs
    have ha1 := (le_abs_self (a s)).trans (haL s hs)
    have hb1 := (le_abs_self (b s)).trans (hbL s hs)
    have hE := E' (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s) (-2 * κ * s + 2 * b s) (-2 * κ * s + 2 * L)
      (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hd : (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s) - (-2 * κ * s + 2 * b s) = 2 * (a s - b s) := by ring
    rw [hd, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2),
      Real.exp_add (-2 * κ * s) (2 * L)] at hE
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc]
    have hP : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) := by positivity
    calc c * |Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * a s) - Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * b s)|
        ≤ c * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * Real.exp (2 * L) * (2 * |a s - b s|)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE hc
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (c * |a s - b s|) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (D * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hab s hs) hP
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * D * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k)) := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = Real.pi * |M| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : ℝ,
      I = ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * κ * s) * (s * (1 + s ^ 2) ^ k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hI0 : 0 ≤ I := by
    rw [hI]
    exact setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs =>
      mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hs) (by positivity)))
  refine ⟨2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * 2 ^ k * I, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro f g ω β hf hg hfM hgM hω hωp hβ x
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _)) (hfM 0)
  have hML : Real.pi * M ≤ L := by rw [hL, abs_of_nonneg hM0]
  have e : 2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * (2 ^ k * β) * I = 2 * Real.exp (2 * L) * 2 ^ k * I * β := by
    ring
  constructor
  · have h := s5 L (2 ^ k * β) (ω x) (fun s => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, f y)
      (fun s => ∫ y in (x - s)..x, g y) (s2 f hf x).1 (s2 g hg x).1
      (fun s hs => (s1 f hfM (x - s) x (by linarith)).trans hML)
      (fun s hs => (s1 g hgM (x - s) x (by linarith)).trans hML) (hω x)
      (fun s hs => (s3 f g ω β x s hf hg hω hωp hβ hs.le).1)
    rw [← hI, e] at h
    exact h
  · have h := s5 L (2 ^ k * β) (ω x) (fun s => ∫ y in x..(x + s), f y)
      (fun s => ∫ y in x..(x + s), g y) (s2 f hf x).2 (s2 g hg x).2
      (fun s hs => (s1 f hfM x (x + s) (by linarith)).trans hML)
      (fun s hs => (s1 g hgM x (x + s) (by linarith)).trans hML) (hω x)
      (fun s hs => (s3 f g ω β x s hf hg hω hωp hβ hs.le).2)
    rw [← hI, e] at h
    exact h

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hM : ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |f x| ≤ M) :

signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ)

    (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (rgreenR κ f) (2 * (κ - f x) * rgreenR κ f x - 1) x) ∧
