proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hint : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → (∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) * |g x| ≤ M) →
      Integrable g (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro g hg hgM
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul M) hg.aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    linarith [hgM x, mul_comm (1 + x ^ 2) |g x|]
  
  have P1 : ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous w → Integrable w (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (rgreen κ w) (2 * (w x - κ) * rgreen κ w x + 1) x := by
    intro w hwc hwi x
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, W t = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, w y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y, F y = Real.exp (2 * κ * y - 2 * W y) :=
      ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, E t = Real.exp (-2 * κ * t + 2 * W t) :=
      ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, J t = ∫ y in Set.Iic t, F y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ y, ‖w y‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hii : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun y => w y) volume a b :=
      fun a b => hwc.intervalIntegrable a b
    have hWf : W = fun t => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, w y := funext hW
    have hWd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt W (w t) t := by
      intro t
      rw [hWf]
      exact (hwc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 t).hasDerivAt
    have hWc : Continuous W := by
      rw [hWf]
      exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive hii 0
    have hFf : F = fun y => Real.exp (2 * κ * y - 2 * W y) := funext hF
    have hFc : Continuous F := by
      rw [hFf]
      exact Real.continuous_exp.comp
        ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).sub (continuous_const.mul hWc))
    have hWb : ∀ y, |W y| ≤ A := by
      intro y
      rw [hW, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, hA]
      refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm_uIoc).trans ?_
      exact setIntegral_le_integral hwi.norm (ae_of_all _ fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    have hFint : ∀ c : ℝ, IntegrableOn F (Set.Iic c) := by
      intro c
      refine Integrable.mono'
        ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * κ) c).const_mul
          (Real.exp (2 * A)))
        hFc.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
      rw [hF, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.abs_exp, ← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have := (abs_le.1 (hWb y)).1
      linarith
    have hJd : HasDerivAt J (F x) x := by
      have hJf : J = fun t => J 0 + ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, F y := by
        funext t
        have := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hFint 0) (hFint t)
        rw [hJ t, hJ 0]
        linarith
      rw [hJf]
      exact ((hFc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt).const_add _
    have hEd : HasDerivAt E (E x * (-2 * κ + 2 * w x)) x := by
      have hEf : E = fun t => Real.exp (-2 * κ * t + 2 * W t) := funext hE
      have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun t => -2 * κ * t + 2 * W t) (-2 * κ + 2 * w x) x :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul (-2 * κ)).add ((hWd x).const_mul 2)).congr_deriv
          (by ring)
      rw [hEf]
      exact h0.exp
    have hEF : E x * F x = 1 := by
      rw [hE, hF, ← Real.exp_add,
        show (-2 * κ * x + 2 * W x) + (2 * κ * x - 2 * W x) = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    have hclosed : ∀ t, rgreen κ w t = E t * J t := by
      intro t
      have h1 : ∀ s : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * s + 2 * ∫ y in (t - s)..t, w y) =
          E t * F (t - s) := by
        intro s
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hii 0 t) (hii 0 (t - s)), ← hW, ← hW,
          hE, hF, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      have h2 : rgreen κ w t = ∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), E t * F (t - s) := by
        unfold rgreen
        congr 1
        funext s
        exact h1 s
      have h3 : (∫ s in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), F (t - s)) = ∫ u in Set.Iic (0 : ℝ), F (t + u) := by
        have := integral_comp_neg_Ioi (0 : ℝ) (fun u => F (t + u))
        simp only [neg_zero] at this
        rw [← this]
        congr 1
      have h4 : (∫ u in Set.Iic (0 : ℝ), F (t + u)) = ∫ y in Set.Iic t, F y := by
        rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic, ← integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic]
        rw [← integral_add_right_eq_self (fun y => (Set.Iic t).indicator F y) t]
        congr 1
        funext u
        simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_Iic]
        by_cases hu : u ≤ 0
        · rw [if_pos hu, if_pos (by linarith), add_comm]
        · rw [if_neg hu, if_neg (by linarith)]
      rw [h2, integral_const_mul, hJ, h3, h4]
    have hfun : rgreen κ w = fun t => E t * J t := funext hclosed
    rw [hclosed x, hfun]
    exact (hEd.mul hJd).congr_deriv (by rw [hEF]; ring)
  
  have refl : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ), rgreenR κ g x = rgreen κ (fun y => g (-y)) (-x) := by
    intro g x
    unfold rgreenR rgreen
    congr 1
    funext s
    have e := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (a := -x - s) (b := -x) g
    rw [neg_neg, show -(-x - s) = x + s by ring] at e
    rw [e]
  
  have Z : ∀ x : ℝ, rgreen κ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro x
    unfold rgreen
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : -2 * κ < 0) 0, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    field_simp
  
  refine ⟨fun x => P1 f hf (hint f hf hM) x, ?_, Z, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    have hg : Continuous (fun y => f (-y)) := hf.comp continuous_neg
    have hgM : ∀ y : ℝ, (1 + y ^ 2) * |f (-y)| ≤ M := fun y => by
      have := hM (-y)
      rwa [neg_sq] at this
    have H := (P1 _ hg (hint _ hg hgM) (-x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_neg' x)
    have hfun : rgreenR κ f = (rgreen κ (fun y => f (-y))) ∘ (fun x => -x) :=
      funext fun x => refl f x
    have H2 : HasDerivAt (rgreenR κ f)
        ((2 * (f (-(-x)) - κ) * rgreen κ (fun y => f (-y)) (-x) + 1) * (-1)) x := by
      rw [hfun]
      exact H
    refine H2.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [refl f x, neg_neg]
    ring
  · intro x
    rw [refl]
    exact Z (-x)

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, RegN 0 φ ↔ ((∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (φ t)) ∧ TimeGood φ)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN (n + 1) φ ↔
      (TimeGood φ ∧ (∀ t x : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ t) x) ∧
        RegN n (fun t x => deriv (φ t) x))) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN (n + 1) φ → RegN n φ) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN n φ → RegN n ψ →
      RegN n (fun t x => a * φ t x + b * ψ t x)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN n φ → RegN n ψ → RegN n (fun t x => φ t x * ψ t x))

signature.name: regN_algebra
signature.statement:
(∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, RegN 0 φ ↔ ((∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (φ t)) ∧ TimeGood φ)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN (n + 1) φ ↔
      (TimeGood φ ∧ (∀ t x : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ t) x) ∧
        RegN n (fun t x => deriv (φ t) x))) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN (n + 1) φ → RegN n φ) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN n φ → RegN n ψ →
      RegN n (fun t x => a * φ t x + b * ψ t x)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN n φ → RegN n ψ → RegN n (fun t x => φ t x * ψ t x))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have TL : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TimeGood φ → TimeGood ψ →
      TimeGood (fun t x => a * φ t x + b * ψ t x) := by
    intro a b φ ψ hφ hψ T k
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hφ T k
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hψ T k
    refine ⟨|a| * |A| + |b| * |B|, fun s t hs ht x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have hw : 0 ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
      have hA1 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ t x| ≤ |A| := (hA s t hs ht x).1.trans (le_abs_self A)
      have hB1 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |ψ t x| ≤ |B| := (hB s t hs ht x).1.trans (le_abs_self B)
      have e : |a * φ t x + b * ψ t x| ≤ |a| * |φ t x| + |b| * |ψ t x| := by
        calc |a * φ t x + b * ψ t x| ≤ |a * φ t x| + |b * ψ t x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |a| * |φ t x| + |b| * |ψ t x| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |a * φ t x + b * ψ t x|
          ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * (|a| * |φ t x| + |b| * |ψ t x|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e hw
        _ = |a| * ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ t x|) + |b| * ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |ψ t x|) := by ring
        _ ≤ |a| * |A| + |b| * |B| :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA1 (abs_nonneg a))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB1 (abs_nonneg b))
    · have hw : 0 ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
      have hA2 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ s x - φ t x| ≤ |A| * |s - t| :=
        (hA s t hs ht x).2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self A) (abs_nonneg _))
      have hB2 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |ψ s x - ψ t x| ≤ |B| * |s - t| :=
        (hB s t hs ht x).2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self B) (abs_nonneg _))
      have e : |a * φ s x + b * ψ s x - (a * φ t x + b * ψ t x)| ≤
          |a| * |φ s x - φ t x| + |b| * |ψ s x - ψ t x| := by
        calc |a * φ s x + b * ψ s x - (a * φ t x + b * ψ t x)|
            = |a * (φ s x - φ t x) + b * (ψ s x - ψ t x)| := by congr 1; ring
          _ ≤ |a * (φ s x - φ t x)| + |b * (ψ s x - ψ t x)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |a| * |φ s x - φ t x| + |b| * |ψ s x - ψ t x| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |a * φ s x + b * ψ s x - (a * φ t x + b * ψ t x)|
          ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * (|a| * |φ s x - φ t x| + |b| * |ψ s x - ψ t x|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e hw
        _ = |a| * ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ s x - φ t x|) +
              |b| * ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |ψ s x - ψ t x|) := by ring
        _ ≤ |a| * (|A| * |s - t|) + |b| * (|B| * |s - t|) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA2 (abs_nonneg a))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB2 (abs_nonneg b))
        _ = (|a| * |A| + |b| * |B|) * |s - t| := by ring
  
  have TM : ∀ (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), TimeGood φ → TimeGood ψ →
      TimeGood (fun t x => φ t x * ψ t x) := by
    intro φ ψ hφ hψ T k
    obtain ⟨Ak, hAk⟩ := hφ T k
    obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ := hφ T 0
    obtain ⟨Bk, hBk⟩ := hψ T k
    obtain ⟨B0, hB0⟩ := hψ T 0
    refine ⟨|Ak| * |B0| + |A0| * |Bk|, fun s t hs ht x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have h1 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ t x| ≤ |Ak| := (hAk s t hs ht x).1.trans (le_abs_self _)
      have h2 : |ψ t x| ≤ |B0| := by
        have := (hB0 t t ht ht x).1
        rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at this
        exact this.trans (le_abs_self _)
      have h3 : 0 ≤ |A0| * |Bk| := by positivity
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ t x * ψ t x| = ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ t x|) * |ψ t x| := by
            rw [abs_mul]; ring
        _ ≤ |Ak| * |B0| := mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ |Ak| * |B0| + |A0| * |Bk| := le_add_of_nonneg_right h3
    · have hw : 0 ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
      have h1 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ s x - φ t x| ≤ |Ak| * |s - t| :=
        (hAk s t hs ht x).2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (abs_nonneg _))
      have h2 : |ψ s x| ≤ |B0| := by
        have := (hB0 s s hs hs x).1
        rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at this
        exact this.trans (le_abs_self _)
      have h3 : |φ t x| ≤ |A0| := by
        have := (hA0 t t ht ht x).1
        rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at this
        exact this.trans (le_abs_self _)
      have h4 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |ψ s x - ψ t x| ≤ |Bk| * |s - t| :=
        (hBk s t hs ht x).2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (abs_nonneg _))
      have e : |φ s x * ψ s x - φ t x * ψ t x| ≤
          |φ s x - φ t x| * |ψ s x| + |φ t x| * |ψ s x - ψ t x| := by
        calc |φ s x * ψ s x - φ t x * ψ t x|
            = |(φ s x - φ t x) * ψ s x + φ t x * (ψ s x - ψ t x)| := by congr 1; ring
          _ ≤ |(φ s x - φ t x) * ψ s x| + |φ t x * (ψ s x - ψ t x)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |φ s x - φ t x| * |ψ s x| + |φ t x| * |ψ s x - ψ t x| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ s x * ψ s x - φ t x * ψ t x|
          ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * (|φ s x - φ t x| * |ψ s x| + |φ t x| * |ψ s x - ψ t x|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e hw
        _ = ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |φ s x - φ t x|) * |ψ s x| +
              |φ t x| * ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |ψ s x - ψ t x|) := by ring
        _ ≤ (|Ak| * |s - t|) * |B0| + |A0| * (|Bk| * |s - t|) :=
            add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
              (mul_le_mul h3 h4 (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _))
        _ = (|Ak| * |B0| + |A0| * |Bk|) * |s - t| := by ring
  
  have hc0 : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((0 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f ↔ Continuous f := by
    intro f
    rw [Nat.cast_zero]
    exact contDiff_zero
  have hcs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f ↔
      (Differentiable ℝ f ∧ ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv f)) := by
    intro n f
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, -, h3⟩
      exact ⟨h1, h3⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h3⟩
      exact ⟨h1, fun h => absurd h (WithTop.natCast_ne_top n), h3⟩
  
  have A0 : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, RegN 0 φ ↔ ((∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (φ t)) ∧ TimeGood φ) := by
    intro φ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hcd, htg⟩
      refine ⟨fun t => (hc0 _).1 (hcd t), ?_⟩
      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using htg 0 le_rfl
    · rintro ⟨hc, htg⟩
      refine ⟨fun t => (hc0 _).2 (hc t), fun j hj => ?_⟩
      obtain rfl : j = 0 := Nat.le_zero.1 hj
      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using htg
  
  have A1 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN (n + 1) φ ↔
      (TimeGood φ ∧ (∀ t x : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ t) x) ∧
        RegN n (fun t x => deriv (φ t) x)) := by
    intro n φ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hcd, htg⟩
      refine ⟨?_, fun t x => ((hcs n _).1 (hcd t)).1 x,
        fun t => ((hcs n _).1 (hcd t)).2, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      · simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using htg 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      · have := htg (j + 1) (by omega)
        simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ'] using this
    · rintro ⟨htg, hd, hcd', htg'⟩
      refine ⟨fun t => (hcs n _).2 ⟨fun x => hd t x, hcd' t⟩, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      rcases j with _ | i
      · simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using htg
      · have := htg' i (by omega)
        simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ'] using this
  
  have A2 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN (n + 1) φ → RegN n φ := by
    rintro n φ ⟨hcd, htg⟩
    refine ⟨fun t => (hcd t).of_le ?_, fun j hj => htg j (by omega)⟩
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n
  
  have A3 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN n φ → RegN n ψ →
      RegN n (fun t x => a * φ t x + b * ψ t x) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro a b φ ψ hφ hψ
      obtain ⟨cφ, tφ⟩ := (A0 φ).1 hφ
      obtain ⟨cψ, tψ⟩ := (A0 ψ).1 hψ
      exact (A0 _).2 ⟨fun t => (continuous_const.mul (cφ t)).add (continuous_const.mul (cψ t)),
        TL a b φ ψ tφ tψ⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a b φ ψ hφ hψ
      obtain ⟨tφ, dφ, rφ⟩ := (A1 n φ).1 hφ
      obtain ⟨tψ, dψ, rψ⟩ := (A1 n ψ).1 hψ
      have hder : (fun t x => deriv (fun x => a * φ t x + b * ψ t x) x) =
          fun t x => a * deriv (φ t) x + b * deriv (ψ t) x := by
        funext t x
        exact (((dφ t x).hasDerivAt.const_mul a).add ((dψ t x).hasDerivAt.const_mul b)).deriv
      refine (A1 n _).2 ⟨TL a b φ ψ tφ tψ,
        fun t x => ((dφ t x).const_mul a).add ((dψ t x).const_mul b), ?_⟩
      show RegN n (fun t x => deriv (fun x => a * φ t x + b * ψ t x) x)
      rw [hder]
      exact ih a b _ _ rφ rψ
  
  have A4 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), RegN n φ → RegN n ψ →
      RegN n (fun t x => φ t x * ψ t x) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro φ ψ hφ hψ
      obtain ⟨cφ, tφ⟩ := (A0 φ).1 hφ
      obtain ⟨cψ, tψ⟩ := (A0 ψ).1 hψ
      exact (A0 _).2 ⟨fun t => (cφ t).mul (cψ t), TM φ ψ tφ tψ⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro φ ψ hφ hψ
      obtain ⟨tφ, dφ, rφ⟩ := (A1 n φ).1 hφ
      obtain ⟨tψ, dψ, rψ⟩ := (A1 n ψ).1 hψ
      have hφn := A2 n φ hφ
      have hψn := A2 n ψ hψ
      have hder : (fun t x => deriv (fun x => φ t x * ψ t x) x) =
          fun t x => 1 * (deriv (φ t) x * ψ t x) + 1 * (φ t x * deriv (ψ t) x) := by
        funext t x
        have h := ((dφ t x).hasDerivAt.mul (dψ t x).hasDerivAt).deriv
        rw [show (fun x => φ t x * ψ t x) = φ t * ψ t from rfl, h]
        ring
      refine (A1 n _).2 ⟨TM φ ψ tφ tψ, fun t x => (dφ t x).mul (dψ t x), ?_⟩
      show RegN n (fun t x => deriv (fun x => φ t x * ψ t x) x)
      rw [hder]
      exact A3 n 1 1 _ _ (ih _ _ rφ hψn) (ih _ _ hφn rψ)
  exact ⟨A0, A1, A2, A3, A4⟩

signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (F u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (hF : RegN m F)
    (hu : ∀ t x : ℝ, u t x = g x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, F s x) :
    RegN m u ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m → ∀ t x : ℝ,

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have C1 : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, TimeGood φ →
      (∀ x : ℝ, Continuous fun s : ℝ => φ s x) ∧
        ∀ T : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, |φ s x| ≤ C := by
    intro φ hφ
    refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun T => ?_⟩
    · rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro s₀
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hφ (|s₀| + 1) 0
      rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have hC1 : 0 < |C| + 1 := by positivity
      refine ⟨min 1 (ε / (|C| + 1)), lt_min one_pos (div_pos hε hC1), fun s hs => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hs ⊢
      have hs1 : |s - s₀| < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_left _ _)
      have hs2 : |s - s₀| < ε / (|C| + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_right _ _)
      have hsT : |s| ≤ |s₀| + 1 := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub s s₀
        linarith
      have h := (hC s s₀ hsT (by linarith [abs_nonneg s₀]) x).2
      rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at h
      have h3 : (|C| + 1) * |s - s₀| < (|C| + 1) * (ε / (|C| + 1)) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs2 hC1
      have h4 : (|C| + 1) * (ε / (|C| + 1)) = ε := by field_simp
      have h5 : C * |s - s₀| ≤ |C| * |s - s₀| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (abs_nonneg _)
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (s - s₀)]
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hφ T 0
      refine ⟨C, fun s hs x => ?_⟩
      have h := (hC s s hs hs x).1
      rwa [pow_zero, one_mul] at h
  
  have SFT : ∀ a b σ T : ℝ, |a| ≤ T → |b| ≤ T → σ ∈ Set.uIoc a b → |σ| ≤ T := by
    intro a b σ T ha hb hσ
    rw [Set.mem_uIoc] at hσ
    rw [abs_le]
    rcases hσ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · constructor
      · linarith [neg_abs_le a]
      · linarith [le_abs_self b]
    · constructor
      · linarith [neg_abs_le b]
      · linarith [le_abs_self a]
  
  have C2 : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |h x| ≤ C) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, Continuous fun s : ℝ => φ s x) → TimeGood φ →
      TimeGood (fun t x => h x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ s x) := by
    intro h φ hh hc hφ T k
    rcases lt_or_ge T 0 with hT | hT
    · refine ⟨0, fun s t hs ht x => ?_⟩
      exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt ((abs_nonneg t).trans ht) hT) (lt_irrefl 0)
    obtain ⟨Ch, hCh⟩ := hh k
    obtain ⟨Cφ, hCφ⟩ := hφ T k
    have hT0 : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ T := by rw [abs_zero]; exact hT
    have hCh0 : 0 ≤ Ch := le_trans (by positivity) (hCh 0)
    have hCφ0 : 0 ≤ Cφ := le_trans (by positivity) (hCφ 0 0 hT0 hT0 0).1
    refine ⟨Ch + (T + 1) * Cφ, fun s t hs ht x => ?_⟩
    have hw : 0 ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
    have hpt : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a| ≤ T → |b| ≤ T →
        (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |∫ σ in a..b, φ σ x| ≤ Cφ * |b - a| := by
      intro a b ha hb
      have e : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |∫ σ in a..b, φ σ x| =
          ‖∫ σ in a..b, (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * φ σ x‖ := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw]
      rw [e]
      refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun σ hσ => ?_)
      have hσT := SFT a b σ T ha hb hσ
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw]
      exact (hCφ σ σ hσT hσT x).1
    beta_reduce
    constructor
    · have h1 := hpt 0 t hT0 ht
      have h2 := hCh x
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |h x + ∫ σ in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ σ x|
          ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * (|h x| + |∫ σ in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ σ x|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_add_le _ _) hw
        _ = (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |h x| + (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |∫ σ in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ σ x| := by ring
        _ ≤ Ch + Cφ * |t - 0| := add_le_add h2 h1
        _ ≤ Ch + (T + 1) * Cφ := by
            rw [sub_zero]
            nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hCφ0]
    · have e : h x + (∫ σ in (0 : ℝ)..s, φ σ x) - (h x + ∫ σ in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ σ x) =
          ∫ σ in t..s, φ σ x := by
        rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left
          ((hc x).intervalIntegrable 0 s) ((hc x).intervalIntegrable 0 t)]
      rw [e]
      have h1 := hpt t s ht hs
      calc _ ≤ Cφ * |s - t| := h1
        _ ≤ (Ch + (T + 1) * Cφ) * |s - t| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) (abs_nonneg _)
  
  have C3 : ∀ (φ ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ y : ℝ, Continuous fun s : ℝ => φ s y) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, Continuous fun s : ℝ => ψ s y) →
      (∀ T : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ T → ∀ y : ℝ, |ψ s y| ≤ C) →
      (∀ s y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (φ s) (ψ s y) y) → ∀ t x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ s y) (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, ψ s x) x := by
    intro φ ψ hφc hψc hψb hd t x
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hψb |t|
    have hT0 : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ |t| := by rw [abs_zero]; exact abs_nonneg t
    exact (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (F := fun y s => φ s y) (F' := fun y s => ψ s y) (bound := fun _ => C)
      Filter.univ_mem
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (hφc y).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ((hφc x).intervalIntegrable 0 t)
      ((hψc x).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun σ hσ y _ => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC σ (SFT 0 t σ |t| hT0 le_rfl hσ) y)
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun σ _ y _ => hd σ y)).2
  
  have C4 : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ y : ℝ, Continuous fun s : ℝ => φ s y) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (φ s)) →
      (∀ T : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ T → ∀ y : ℝ, |φ s y| ≤ C) → ∀ t : ℝ,
      Continuous fun x => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ s x := by
    intro φ hcs hcx hb t
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb |t|
    have hT0 : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ |t| := by rw [abs_zero]; exact abs_nonneg t
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_of_dominated_interval (F := fun x s => φ s x)
      (bound := fun _ => C)
      (fun x => (hcs x).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (fun x => MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun σ hσ => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC σ (SFT 0 t σ |t| hT0 le_rfl hσ) x)
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun σ _ => hcx σ)
  
  have C5 : ∀ j : ℕ,
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ))
        (iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) x) x) ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ) x| ≤ C := by
    intro j
    refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have hD : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ)) :=
        (g.smooth ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)).differentiable_iteratedDeriv j
          (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self j)
      exact (hD x).hasDerivAt
    · refine ⟨2 ^ (2 * k) * ((Finset.Iic (2 * k, j)).sup
        fun m => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ m.1 m.2) g, fun x => ?_⟩
      have h1 := SchwartzMap.one_add_le_sup_seminorm_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (m := (2 * k, j))
        (k := 2 * k) (n := j) le_rfl le_rfl g x
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      have h2 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (2 * k) := by
        rw [pow_mul]
        apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg x, sq_abs x]
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ) x|
          ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (2 * k) * |iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ) x| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ _ := h1
  
  obtain ⟨hFc, hFt⟩ := hF
  have Φc : ∀ j, j ≤ m → ∀ y : ℝ, Continuous fun s => iteratedDeriv j (F s) y :=
    fun j hj => (C1 _ (hFt j hj)).1
  have Φb : ∀ j, j ≤ m → ∀ T : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ T → ∀ y : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (F s) y| ≤ C :=
    fun j hj => (C1 _ (hFt j hj)).2
  have Φx : ∀ j, j ≤ m → ∀ s, Continuous (iteratedDeriv j (F s)) :=
    fun j hj s => (hFc s).continuous_iteratedDeriv j (by exact_mod_cast hj)
  have hdF : ∀ j, j < m → ∀ s y : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv j (F s)) (iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (F s) y) y := by
    intro j hj s y
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    exact ((hFc s).differentiable_iteratedDeriv j (by exact_mod_cast hj) y).hasDerivAt
  have D : ∀ j, j < m → ∀ t x : ℝ, HasDerivAt
      (fun y => iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ) y + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv j (F s) y)
      (iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (g : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (F s) x)
      x := by
    intro j hj t x
    exact ((C5 j).1 x).add (C3 (fun s y => iteratedDeriv j (F s) y)
      (fun s y => iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (F s) y)
      (Φc j hj.le) (Φc (j + 1) hj) (Φb (j + 1) hj) (hdF j hj) t x)
  have P : ∀ j, j ≤ m → ∀ t, iteratedDeriv j (u t) =
      fun x => iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv j (F s) x := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro _ t
      funext x
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      exact hu t x
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj t
      have hj' : j < m := by omega
      rw [show iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (u t) = deriv (iteratedDeriv j (u t)) from
        iteratedDeriv_succ, ih hj'.le t]
      funext x
      exact (D j hj' t x).deriv
  have S4 : ∀ t, ContDiff ℝ m (u t) := by
    intro t
    refine (contDiff_iff_iteratedDeriv (n := (m : ℕ∞))).2 ⟨fun j hj => ?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    · have hj' : j ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hj
      rw [P j hj' t]
      exact (continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => ((C5 j).1 x).continuousAt).add
        (C4 (fun s y => iteratedDeriv j (F s) y) (Φc j hj') (Φx j hj') (Φb j hj') t)
    · have hj' : j < m := by exact_mod_cast hj
      rw [P j hj'.le t]
      exact fun x => (D j hj' t x).differentiableAt
  have S5 : ∀ j, j ≤ m → TimeGood (fun t x => iteratedDeriv j (u t) x) := by
    intro j hj
    have e : (fun t x => iteratedDeriv j (u t) x) =
        fun t x => iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv j (F s) x :=
      funext fun t => funext fun x => congrFun (P j hj t) x
    rw [e]
    exact C2 (iteratedDeriv j (g : ℝ → ℝ)) (fun s x => iteratedDeriv j (F s) x) (C5 j).2
      (Φc j hj) (hFt j hj)
  exact ⟨⟨S4, S5⟩, fun j hj t x => congrFun (P j hj t) x⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have step : ∀ (w G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ω β : ℝ → ℝ) (a A t : ℝ),
      (∀ t x : ℝ, w t x = v₀ x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, G s x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, Continuous fun s : ℝ => G s x) →
      Continuous β → 0 ≤ t → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ω x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, ω x * |v₀ x| ≤ a) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → ∀ x : ℝ, ω x * |G s x| ≤ A * β s) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, ω x * |w t x| ≤ a + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, A * β s := by
    intro w G ω β a A t hiw hGc hβ ht hω h0' hFβ x
    have e : ω x * |∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, G s x| = |∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, ω x * G s x| := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hω x)]
    have hI : ω x * |∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, G s x| ≤ ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, A * β s := by
      rw [e]
      refine (intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs ht).trans ?_
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on ht ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact ((continuous_const.mul (hGc x)).abs).intervalIntegrable 0 t
      · exact (continuous_const.mul hβ).intervalIntegrable 0 t
      · intro s hs
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hω x)]
        exact hFβ s hs.1 hs.2 x
    rw [hiw t x]
    calc ω x * |v₀ x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, G s x|
        ≤ ω x * (|v₀ x| + |∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, G s x|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_add_le _ _) (hω x)
      _ = ω x * |v₀ x| + ω x * |∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, G s x| := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (h0' x) hI
  
  have gron : ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a A B T : ℝ), 0 ≤ a →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, u t x ≤ B) →
      (∀ (β : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ), Continuous β → 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T →
        (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → ∀ y : ℝ, u s y ≤ β s) →
        ∀ x : ℝ, u t x ≤ a + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, A * β s) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, u t x ≤ a * Real.exp (A * t) := by
    intro u a A B T ha hB hstep
    have iden : ∀ (t : ℝ) (m : ℕ), a + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t,
        A * (a * Real.exp (A * s) + B * (A * s) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) =
          a * Real.exp (A * t) + B * (A * t) ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro t m
      have hd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt
          (fun s => a * Real.exp (A * s) + B * (A * s) ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))
          (A * (a * Real.exp (A * s) + B * (A * s) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ))) s := by
        intro s
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => A * s) A s := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul A
        have h2 := ((h1.exp).const_mul a).add
          (((h1.pow (m + 1)).const_mul B).div_const ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))
        convert h2 using 1
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        have hf : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        push_cast
        field_simp
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hd s)
        (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)]
      have hz : (0 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) = 0 := zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m)
      simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, hz, zero_div, add_zero, mul_one]
      ring
    have P : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ,
        u t x ≤ a * Real.exp (A * t) + B * (A * t) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro t ht0 htT x
        have h1 := hB t ht0 htT x
        have h2 : 0 ≤ a * Real.exp (A * t) := mul_nonneg ha (Real.exp_pos _).le
        simp only [pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one, mul_one]
        linarith
      | succ m ih =>
        intro t ht0 htT x
        rw [← iden t m]
        exact hstep _ t (by fun_prop) ht0 htT (fun s hs0 hst y => ih s hs0 (hst.trans htT) y) x
    intro t ht0 htT x
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ => a * Real.exp (A * t) + B * ((A * t) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (a * Real.exp (A * t) + B * 0)) :=
      ((FloorSemiring.tendsto_pow_div_factorial_atTop (A * t)).const_mul B).const_add _
    rw [mul_zero, add_zero] at hlim
    exact ge_of_tendsto' hlim (fun m => by rw [← mul_div_assoc]; exact P m t ht0 htT x)
  
  have fwd : ∀ (w G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t x : ℝ, w t x = v₀ x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, G s x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, Continuous fun s : ℝ => G s x) →
      (∀ T : ℝ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, |w t x| ≤ M) →
      (∀ (T : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ (Λ β s : ℝ), 0 ≤ Λ → |s| ≤ T →
        (∀ y : ℝ, min ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ k) Λ * |w s y| ≤ β) →
        ∀ x : ℝ, min ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k) Λ * |G s x| ≤ A * β) →
      ∀ (T : ℝ) (k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |w t x| ≤ C := by
    intro w G hiw hGc hbw hFw T k
    rcases lt_or_ge T 0 with hT | hT
    · exact ⟨0, fun t ht0 htT x => absurd (ht0.trans htT) (not_le.2 hT)⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbw T
    obtain ⟨A, hA0, hA⟩ := hFw T k
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h0 k
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := le_trans (by positivity) (ha 0)
    refine ⟨a * Real.exp (A * T), fun t ht0 htT x => ?_⟩
    have hΛ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
    have hω : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ min ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ k) ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k) :=
      fun y => le_min (by positivity) hΛ
    have key := gron (fun τ y => min ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ k) ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k) * |w τ y|) a A
      ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * M) T ha0
      (fun τ hτ0 hτT y => by
        calc min ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ k) ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k) * |w τ y| ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |w τ y| :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * M :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM τ (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hτ0]; exact hτT) y) hΛ)
      (fun β τ hβ hτ0 hτT hβ' x' =>
        step w G (fun y => min ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ k) ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k)) β a A τ hiw hGc hβ hτ0 hω
          (fun y => (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (abs_nonneg _)).trans (ha y))
          (fun s hs0 hsτ x'' => hA ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k) (β s) s hΛ
            (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs0]; linarith) (fun y => hβ' s hs0 hsτ y) x'') x')
      t ht0 htT x
    simp only [min_self] at key
    calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |w t x| ≤ a * Real.exp (A * t) := key
      _ ≤ a * Real.exp (A * T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htT hA0)) ha0
  
  have hir : ∀ t x : ℝ, v (-t) x = v₀ x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, -F (-s) x := by
    intro t x
    have hc := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (a := 0) (b := t) (fun s => F s x)
    simp only at hc
    rw [hi (-t) x, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, hc, neg_zero,
      intervalIntegral.integral_symm]
  intro T k
  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp⟩ := fwd v F hi hFc hbd hF T k
  obtain ⟨Cm, hCm⟩ := fwd (fun t x => v (-t) x) (fun s x => -F (-s) x) hir
    (fun x => ((hFc x).comp continuous_neg).neg)
    (fun T' => by
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hbd T'
      exact ⟨M, fun t ht x => hM (-t) (by rwa [abs_neg]) x⟩)
    (fun T' k' => by
      obtain ⟨A, hA0, hA⟩ := hF T' k'
      refine ⟨A, hA0, fun Λ β s hΛ hs hyp x => ?_⟩
      show min ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k') Λ * |-F (-s) x| ≤ A * β
      rw [abs_neg]
      exact hA Λ β (-s) hΛ (by rwa [abs_neg]) hyp x)
    T k
  have hCb : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |v t x| ≤ max Cp Cm := by
    intro t ht x
    rcases le_or_gt 0 t with h | h
    · exact (hCp t h ((le_abs_self t).trans ht) x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · have h1 := hCm (-t) (by linarith) (by rw [abs_of_neg h] at ht; exact ht) x
      simp only [neg_neg] at h1
      exact h1.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨A, hA0, hA⟩ := hF T k
  have hFb : ∀ σ : ℝ, |σ| ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |F σ x| ≤ A * max Cp Cm := by
    intro σ hσ x
    have h1 := hA ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k) (max Cp Cm) σ (by positivity) hσ
      (fun y => (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (abs_nonneg _)).trans
        (hCb σ hσ y)) x
    rwa [min_self] at h1
  have lip : ∀ s t : ℝ, |s| ≤ T → |t| ≤ T → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |v s x - v t x| ≤ A * max Cp Cm * |s - t| := by
    intro s t hs ht x
    have e : v s x - v t x = ∫ σ in t..s, F σ x := by
      rw [hi s x, hi t x, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left ((hFc x).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((hFc x).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have hw : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
    have e2 : (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |∫ σ in t..s, F σ x| =
        ‖∫ σ in t..s, (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * F σ x‖ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw]
    rw [e, e2]
    refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun σ hσ => ?_)
    have hσ' := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hσ
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at hσ'
    have hσT : |σ| ≤ T := by
      rw [abs_le] at hs ht ⊢
      rcases hσ' with h | h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw]
    exact hFb σ hσT x
  refine ⟨max (max Cp Cm) (A * max Cp Cm), fun s t hs ht x =>
    ⟨(hCb t ht x).trans (le_max_left _ _),
      (lip s t hs ht x).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (abs_nonneg _))⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ n : ℕ, RegN n u) (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, RegN n F)
    (hform : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t x : ℝ), iteratedDeriv n (u t) x =
      iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (F s) x) :
    ∃ V : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ t x : ℝ, V t x = u t x) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt V W t ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, W x = F t x

signature.name: schwartz_curve_of_regN
signature.statement:
(g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ n : ℕ, RegN n u) (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, RegN n F)
    (hform : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t x : ℝ), iteratedDeriv n (u t) x =
      iteratedDeriv n (g : ℝ → ℝ) x + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (F s) x) :
    ∃ V : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ t x : ℝ, V t x = u t x) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt V W t ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, W x = F t x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hwt : ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ), |x| ^ k ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := fun x k =>
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x)
      (by nlinarith [sq_abs x, sq_nonneg (|x| - 1), abs_nonneg x]) k
  
  have hslice : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℕ, RegN n φ) → ∀ t : ℝ,
      ∃ V : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, V x = φ t x := by
    intro φ hφ t
    refine ⟨SchwartzMap.mk (φ t) (contDiff_infty.2 fun n => (hφ n).1 t) ?_, fun x => rfl⟩
    intro k n
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hφ n).2 n le_rfl |t| k
    refine ⟨C, fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h := (hC t t le_rfl le_rfl x).1
    simp only at h
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hwt x k) (abs_nonneg _)) h
  choose V hV using hslice u hu
  choose W hW using hslice F hF
  
  have s5b : ∀ (c : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (c' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ), (∀ k n : ℕ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (c s - c t - (s - t) • c'))) (nhds t) (nhds 0)) →
      HasDerivAt c c' t := by
    intro c c' t hc
    have G : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - t)⁻¹ • (c s - c t - (s - t) • c'))
        (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds _ 0]
      rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
      filter_upwards [(hc k n).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with s hs
      rw [sub_zero]
      exact hs
    have h2 : (fun s : ℝ => c s - c t - (s - t) • c') =o[ℝ; nhds t] (fun s => s - t) := by
      rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul]
      · exact G
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
        have hst : s = t := sub_eq_zero.mp hs
        subst hst
        simp
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
    exact (hasFDerivAtFilter_iff_isLittleOTVS _ _ _ _).2
      (by simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] using h2)
  have crit : ∀ (c : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (c' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ),
      (∀ k n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| ≤ 1 →
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - t)⁻¹ • (c s - c t - (s - t) • c')) ≤ C * |s - t|) →
      HasDerivAt c c' t := by
    intro c c' t h
    apply s5b c c' t
    intro k n
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h k n
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => C * |s - t|) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have hc : Continuous fun s : ℝ => C * |s - t| := by fun_prop
      simpa using hc.tendsto t
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in nhds t, |s - t| ≤ 1 := by
      have hc : Continuous fun s : ℝ => |s - t| := by fun_prop
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => |s - t|) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using hc.tendsto t
      exact h0.eventually (eventually_le_nhds one_pos)
    refine squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => apply_nonneg _ _) ?_ hlim
    filter_upwards [hev] with s hs
    exact hC s hs
  
  have alg : ∀ (d a w B C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → a ≤ w → w * |B| ≤ C * |d| * |d| →
      a * |d⁻¹ * B| ≤ C * |d| := by
    intro d a w B C hC haw h
    rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with h0 | h0
    · subst h0; simp
    · have hd : 0 < |d| := abs_pos.2 h0
      have hd' : |d| ≠ 0 := hd.ne'
      rw [abs_mul, abs_inv]
      have h1 : a * |B| ≤ C * |d| * |d| :=
        le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right haw (abs_nonneg _)) h
      calc a * (|d|⁻¹ * |B|) = |d|⁻¹ * (a * |B|) := by ring
        _ ≤ |d|⁻¹ * (C * |d| * |d|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
        _ = C * |d| := by field_simp
  
  refine ⟨V, hV, fun t => ⟨W t, ?_, hW t⟩⟩
  apply crit V (W t) t
  intro k n
  have hφ : TimeGood (fun σ x => iteratedDeriv n (F σ) x) := (hF n).2 n le_rfl
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hφ (|t| + 1) k
  
  have hcont : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous fun σ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (F σ) x := by
    intro x
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro s₀
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hφ (|s₀| + 1) 0
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have hK1 : 0 < |C₀| + 1 := by positivity
    refine ⟨min 1 (ε / (|C₀| + 1)), lt_min one_pos (div_pos hε hK1), fun s hs => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hs ⊢
    have hs2 : |s - s₀| < ε / (|C₀| + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_right _ _)
    have hs1 : |s - s₀| < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hs (min_le_left _ _)
    have hsT : |s| ≤ |s₀| + 1 := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub s s₀
      linarith
    have h := (hC₀ s s₀ hsT (by linarith [abs_nonneg s₀]) x).2
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at h
    have h3 : (|C₀| + 1) * |s - s₀| < (|C₀| + 1) * (ε / (|C₀| + 1)) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs2 hK1
    have h4 : (|C₀| + 1) * (ε / (|C₀| + 1)) = ε := by field_simp
    have h5 : C₀ * |s - s₀| ≤ (|C₀| + 1) * |s - s₀| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [le_abs_self C₀]) (abs_nonneg _)
    linarith
  refine ⟨max C₁ 0, fun s hs => ?_⟩
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ max C₁ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  
  have hinc : ∀ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k *
      |∫ σ in t..s, (iteratedDeriv n (F σ) x - iteratedDeriv n (F t) x)| ≤
        max C₁ 0 * |s - t| * |s - t| := by
    intro x
    have hw0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k := by positivity
    have hb : ∀ σ ∈ Set.uIoc t s,
        ‖(1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * (iteratedDeriv n (F σ) x - iteratedDeriv n (F t) x)‖ ≤
          max C₁ 0 * |s - t| := by
      intro σ hσ
      have hσt : |σ - t| ≤ |s - t| := by
        rcases Set.mem_uIoc.1 hσ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ σ - t),
            abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s - t)]
          linarith
        · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : σ - t ≤ 0), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : s - t ≤ 0)]
          linarith
      have hσT : |σ| ≤ |t| + 1 := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub σ t
        linarith
      have h := (hC₁ σ t hσT (by linarith [abs_nonneg t]) x).2
      simp only at h
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw0]
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) ^ k * |iteratedDeriv n (F σ) x - iteratedDeriv n (F t) x|
          ≤ C₁ * |σ - t| := h
        _ ≤ max C₁ 0 * |σ - t| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ max C₁ 0 * |s - t| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσt hC0
    have hI := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw0] at hI
    exact hI
  have hcs := (hu n).1 s
  have hct := (hu n).1 t
  have hcF := (hF n).1 t
  have hEfun : (⇑((s - t)⁻¹ • (V s - V t - (s - t) • W t)) : ℝ → ℝ) =
      fun z => (s - t)⁻¹ * (u s z - u t z - (s - t) * F t z) := by
    funext z
    simp only [SchwartzMap.smul_apply, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, hV, hW]
  refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound ℝ k n _ (mul_nonneg hC0 (abs_nonneg _)) (fun x => ?_)
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, hEfun]
  have hd1 : iteratedDeriv n (fun z => (s - t)⁻¹ * (u s z - u t z - (s - t) * F t z)) x =
      (s - t)⁻¹ * (iteratedDeriv n (u s) x - iteratedDeriv n (u t) x
        - (s - t) * iteratedDeriv n (F t) x) := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul ((hcs.sub hct).sub (contDiff_const.mul hcF)).contDiffAt,
      iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (hcs.sub hct).contDiffAt (contDiff_const.mul hcF).contDiffAt,
      iteratedDeriv_fun_sub hcs.contDiffAt hct.contDiffAt,
      iteratedDeriv_const_mul hcF.contDiffAt]
  have hB : iteratedDeriv n (u s) x - iteratedDeriv n (u t) x
      - (s - t) * iteratedDeriv n (F t) x =
        ∫ σ in t..s, (iteratedDeriv n (F σ) x - iteratedDeriv n (F t) x) := by
    have hi : ∀ a b : ℝ,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun σ => iteratedDeriv n (F σ) x) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      fun a b => (hcont x).intervalIntegrable a b
    rw [hform n s x, hform n t x,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hi t s) (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable t s),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hi 0 s) (hi 0 t)]
    ring
  rw [hd1, hB]
  exact alg (s - t) (|x| ^ k) ((1 + x ^ 2) ^ k) _ (max C₁ 0) hC0 (hwt x k) (hinc x)

signature.statement:
(c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (a b : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ l : ℝ, 0 < l → ∀ f g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f → Integrable f (volume : Measure ℝ) →
      Continuous g → (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |g x| ≤ C) →
      ∃ z : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt z ((-l + f x) * z x + g x) x) ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |z x| ≤ C := by
    intro l hl f g hf hfi hg hdec
    have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := hl.ne'
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hdec 0
    have hg0 : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ C₀ := fun y => by simpa using hC₀ y
    have hC₀0 : 0 ≤ C₀ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hg0 0)
    have hkc : Continuous (fun y => Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) := by fun_prop
    have hint : ∀ x : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) (Set.Iic x) volume := by
      intro x
      refine Integrable.mono' ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic hl x).const_mul C₀)
        hkc.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (abs_nonneg _)),
        mul_comm C₀]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg0 y) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    
    have hdecK : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
        |x| ^ k * (Real.exp (-l * x) * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) ≤ K := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨Ck, hCk⟩ := hdec k
      have hCk0 : 0 ≤ Ck :=
        le_trans (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) (abs_nonneg _)) (hCk 0)
      have h2l : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 / l) ^ k := pow_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hl.le) k
      obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ, F = (k.factorial : ℝ) * (2 / l) ^ k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hF0 : 0 ≤ F := by rw [hF]; exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) h2l
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 2 ^ (k - 1) * (Ck + C₀ * F) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hpow : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (k - 1) := by positivity
      have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
        rw [hD]; exact mul_nonneg hpow (add_nonneg hCk0 (mul_nonneg hC₀0 hF0))
      refine ⟨2 * D / l, fun x => ?_⟩
      have hpt : ∀ y ∈ Set.Iic x, |x| ^ k * (Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) ≤
          D * Real.exp (l / 2 * x) * Real.exp (l / 2 * y) := by
        intro y hy
        have hy' : y ≤ x := hy
        have ht : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
        have hax : |x| ≤ |y| + (x - y) := by
          have h := abs_add_le y (x - y)
          rw [show y + (x - y) = x by ring, abs_of_nonneg ht] at h
          exact h
        have hpe : |x| ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (k - 1) * (|y| ^ k + (x - y) ^ k) :=
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) hax k).trans (add_pow_le (abs_nonneg y) ht k)
        have hlt : 0 ≤ l * (x - y) := mul_nonneg hl.le ht
        have hfac : (x - y) ^ k ≤ F * Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2) := by
          have h1 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (l * (x - y) / 2) (div_nonneg hlt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) k
          have hf : (0 : ℝ) < k.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos k
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hf] at h1
          have h2 : (l * (x - y) / 2) ^ k = (l / 2) ^ k * (x - y) ^ k := by
            rw [← mul_pow]; ring
          have h3 : (2 / l) ^ k * (l / 2) ^ k = 1 := by
            rw [← mul_pow, show 2 / l * (l / 2) = 1 by field_simp, one_pow]
          calc (x - y) ^ k = (2 / l) ^ k * ((l / 2) ^ k * (x - y) ^ k) := by
                rw [← mul_assoc, h3, one_mul]
            _ ≤ (2 / l) ^ k * (Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2) * k.factorial) := by
                rw [← h2]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h2l
            _ = F * Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2) := by rw [hF]; ring
        have hA : |x| ^ k * |g y| ≤ 2 ^ (k - 1) * (Ck + C₀ * F * Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2)) := by
          have h0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpe (abs_nonneg (g y))
          have h1 : |y| ^ k * |g y| ≤ Ck := hCk y
          have h2 : (x - y) ^ k * |g y| ≤ (F * Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2)) * C₀ :=
            mul_le_mul hfac (hg0 y) (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hF0 (Real.exp_pos _).le)
          calc |x| ^ k * |g y| ≤ 2 ^ (k - 1) * (|y| ^ k + (x - y) ^ k) * |g y| := h0
            _ = 2 ^ (k - 1) * (|y| ^ k * |g y| + (x - y) ^ k * |g y|) := by ring
            _ ≤ 2 ^ (k - 1) * (Ck + (F * Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2)) * C₀) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h1 h2) hpow
            _ = _ := by ring
        have hd : Real.exp (l * y) = Real.exp (l * x) * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y))) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        have h12 : Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2) * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y))) =
            Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)) / 2) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        have h23 : Real.exp (-(l * (x - y))) ≤ Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)) / 2) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
          linarith
        have h3P : Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)) / 2) * Real.exp (l * x) =
            Real.exp (l / 2 * x) * Real.exp (l / 2 * y) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        have hP := Real.exp_pos (l * x)
        have he2 := Real.exp_pos (-(l * (x - y)))
        have hCe := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h23 hCk0
        calc |x| ^ k * (Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|)
            = (|x| ^ k * |g y|) * (Real.exp (l * x) * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)))) := by
              rw [hd]; ring
          _ ≤ (2 ^ (k - 1) * (Ck + C₀ * F * Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2))) *
                (Real.exp (l * x) * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA (mul_pos hP he2).le
          _ = 2 ^ (k - 1) * (Ck * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y))) + C₀ * F *
                (Real.exp (l * (x - y) / 2) * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y))))) *
                Real.exp (l * x) := by ring
          _ = 2 ^ (k - 1) * (Ck * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y))) + C₀ * F *
                Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)) / 2)) * Real.exp (l * x) := by rw [h12]
          _ ≤ 2 ^ (k - 1) * (Ck * Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)) / 2) + C₀ * F *
                Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)) / 2)) * Real.exp (l * x) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hP.le
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hpow
              linarith
          _ = D * (Real.exp (-(l * (x - y)) / 2) * Real.exp (l * x)) := by rw [hD]; ring
          _ = D * Real.exp (l / 2 * x) * Real.exp (l / 2 * y) := by rw [h3P]; ring
      have hl2 : 0 < l / 2 := half_pos hl
      have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on ((hint x).const_mul (|x| ^ k))
        ((integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic hl2 x).const_mul (D * Real.exp (l / 2 * x)))
        measurableSet_Iic hpt
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Iic hl2 x] at hmono
      have hE := Real.exp_pos (-l * x)
      have h1 : Real.exp (-l * x) * (Real.exp (l / 2 * x) * Real.exp (l / 2 * x)) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, show -l * x + (l / 2 * x + l / 2 * x) = 0 by ring,
          Real.exp_zero]
      calc |x| ^ k * (Real.exp (-l * x) * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|)
          = Real.exp (-l * x) * (|x| ^ k * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) := by
            ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-l * x) * (D * Real.exp (l / 2 * x) * (Real.exp (l / 2 * x) / (l / 2))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hE.le
        _ = D * (Real.exp (-l * x) * (Real.exp (l / 2 * x) * Real.exp (l / 2 * x))) * (2 / l) := by
            ring
        _ = 2 * D / l := by rw [h1]; ring
    
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, A t = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, f y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α : ℝ, α = ∫ y, ‖f y‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hAf : A = fun t => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, f y := funext hA
    have hAd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt A (f t) t := by
      intro t; rw [hAf]; exact (hf.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 t).hasDerivAt
    have hAc : Continuous A := by
      rw [hAf]; exact intervalIntegral.continuous_primitive (fun u v => hf.intervalIntegrable u v) 0
    have hAb : ∀ y, |A y| ≤ α := by
      intro y
      rw [hA, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, hα]
      refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm_uIoc).trans ?_
      exact setIntegral_le_integral hfi.norm (ae_of_all _ fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ y, F y = Real.exp (l * y - A y) * g y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have hFf : F = fun y => Real.exp (l * y - A y) * g y := funext hF
    have hFc : Continuous F := by rw [hFf]; fun_prop
    have hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ Real.exp α * (Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) := by
      intro y
      rw [hF, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, Real.abs_exp, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      have := (abs_le.1 (hAb y)).1
      linarith
    have hFint : ∀ x, IntegrableOn F (Set.Iic x) := fun x =>
      Integrable.mono' ((hint x).const_mul (Real.exp α)) hFc.aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ hFb)
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, J t = ∫ y in Set.Iic t, F y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have hJd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt J (F x) x := by
      intro x
      have hJf : J = fun t => J 0 + ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..t, F y := by
        funext t
        have := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hFint 0) (hFint t)
        rw [hJ t, hJ 0]
        linarith
      rw [hJf]
      exact ((hFc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt).const_add _
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t, E t = Real.exp (-l * t + A t) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have hEf : E = fun t => Real.exp (-l * t + A t) := funext hE
    have hEd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt E (E x * (-l + f x)) x := by
      intro x
      have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun t => -l * t + A t) (-l + f x) x :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul (-l)).add (hAd x)).congr_deriv (by ring)
      rw [hEf]
      exact h0.exp
    have hEF : ∀ x, E x * Real.exp (l * x - A x) = 1 := by
      intro x
      rw [hE, ← Real.exp_add, show -l * x + A x + (l * x - A x) = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    refine ⟨fun t => E t * J t, fun x => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · exact ((hEd x).mul (hJd x)).congr_deriv (by rw [hF]; linear_combination (g x) * hEF x)
    · obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hdecK k
      refine ⟨Real.exp α * Real.exp α * K, fun x => ?_⟩
      show |x| ^ k * |E x * J x| ≤ Real.exp α * Real.exp α * K
      have hJb : |J x| ≤ Real.exp α * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y| := by
        rw [hJ, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← integral_const_mul]
        exact norm_integral_le_of_norm_le ((hint x).const_mul _) (ae_of_all _ hFb)
      have hEb : E x ≤ Real.exp α * Real.exp (-l * x) := by
        rw [hE, ← Real.exp_add]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
        have := (abs_le.1 (hAb x)).2
        linarith
      have hEpos : 0 < E x := by rw [hE]; exact Real.exp_pos _
      have hzb : |E x * J x| ≤ Real.exp α * Real.exp α *
          (Real.exp (-l * x) * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hEpos]
        calc E x * |J x| ≤ (Real.exp α * Real.exp (-l * x)) *
              (Real.exp α * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|) :=
            mul_le_mul hEb hJb (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = _ := by ring
      have hxk : 0 ≤ |x| ^ k := by positivity
      have hM : 0 ≤ Real.exp α * Real.exp α := by positivity
      calc |x| ^ k * |E x * J x| ≤ |x| ^ k * (Real.exp α * Real.exp α *
            (Real.exp (-l * x) * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzb hxk
        _ = Real.exp α * Real.exp α * (|x| ^ k *
            (Real.exp (-l * x) * ∫ y in Set.Iic x, Real.exp (l * y) * |g y|)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp α * Real.exp α * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hK x) hM
  
  have hS : ∀ s : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |s x| ≤ C := by
    intro s k
    obtain ⟨C, -, hC⟩ := s.decay k 0
    refine ⟨C, fun x => ?_⟩
    have := hC x
    rwa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hc with hneg | hpos
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hzd⟩ := key (-c) (by linarith) a b a.continuous (a.integrable (μ := volume))
      b.continuous (hS b)
    refine ⟨z, fun x => ?_, hzd⟩
    have := hz x
    rwa [neg_neg] at this
  · have hbd : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ^ k * |(fun y => -b (-y)) x| ≤ C := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hS b k
      refine ⟨C, fun x => ?_⟩
      have := hC (-x)
      rw [abs_neg] at this
      simpa only [abs_neg] using this
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZd⟩ := key c hpos (fun y => -a (-y)) (fun y => -b (-y))
      (a.continuous.comp continuous_neg).neg ((a.integrable (μ := volume)).comp_neg.neg)
      (b.continuous.comp continuous_neg).neg hbd
    refine ⟨fun x => Z (-x), fun x => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · have h := (hZ (-x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_neg x)
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [neg_neg]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hZd k
      refine ⟨C, fun x => ?_⟩
      have := hC (-x)
      rwa [abs_neg] at this

    (hzbot : Filter.Tendsto z Filter.atBot (nhds 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκne : κ ≠ 0 := hκ.ne'
  have hdecay : ∀ F : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (⇑F) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (⇑F) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    intro F
    have h := F.toZeroAtInfty.zero_at_infty'
    rw [cocompact_eq_atBot_atTop, Filter.tendsto_sup] at h
    exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  have ode_zero : ∀ (m v u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous m → (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt v (u x) x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt u (m x * u x) x) → Filter.Tendsto v Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto v Filter.atBot (nhds 0) → ∀ x : ℝ, v x = 0 := by
    intro m v u hm hv hu htop hbot
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt P (m x) x :=
      ⟨fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, m t, fun x => (hm.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 x).hasDerivAt⟩
    have hΦ : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => u y * Real.exp (-P y)) 0 x := by
      intro x
      have := (hu x).mul ((hP x).neg.exp)
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hconst : ∀ x : ℝ, u x * Real.exp (-P x) = u 0 * Real.exp (-P 0) := by
      intro x
      exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hΦ y).differentiableAt)
        (fun y => (hΦ y).deriv) x 0
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = u 0 * Real.exp (-P 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, u x = c * Real.exp (P x) := by
      intro x
      have h1 := hconst x
      have h2 : Real.exp (-P x) * Real.exp (P x) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
      calc u x = u x * Real.exp (-P x) * Real.exp (P x) := by rw [mul_assoc, h2, mul_one]
        _ = c * Real.exp (P x) := by rw [h1, hc]
    intro x
    rcases le_total 0 c with hc0 | hc0
    · have hmono : Monotone v := monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun y => (hv y).differentiableAt)
        (fun y => by rw [(hv y).deriv, hu_eq y]; exact mul_nonneg hc0 (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      have h1 := hmono.ge_of_tendsto htop x
      have h2 := hmono.le_of_tendsto hbot x
      linarith
    · have hanti : Antitone v := antitone_of_deriv_nonpos (fun y => (hv y).differentiableAt)
        (fun y => by
          rw [(hv y).deriv, hu_eq y]
          exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hc0 (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      have h1 := hanti.le_of_tendsto htop x
      have h2 := hanti.ge_of_tendsto hbot x
      linarith
  have hde : deriv (⇑e) = ⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e) :=
    funext fun x => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ e x).symm
  have hdDe : deriv (⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e)) =
      ⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e)) :=
    funext fun x => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ _ x).symm
  have e2 : iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e) =
      ⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e)) := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hde, hdDe]
  have e3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (⇑e) = deriv (iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e)) := iteratedDeriv_succ
  have hf : ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => deriv (⇑e) y - 2 * (ρ y - κ) * e y
          - 2 * z y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y))
        (iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e) x - 2 * (ρ x - κ) * deriv (⇑e) x
          - 2 * (q x + 2 * κ * ρ x - ρ x ^ 2) * e x
          - 2 * f x * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q x) - 2 * z x) x ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun y => iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e) y - 2 * (ρ y - κ) * deriv (⇑e) y
          - 2 * (q y + 2 * κ * ρ y - ρ y ^ 2) * e y
          - 2 * f y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y) - 2 * z y)
        (-2 * (ρ x - κ) * (iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e) x - 2 * (ρ x - κ) * deriv (⇑e) x
          - 2 * (q x + 2 * κ * ρ x - ρ x ^ 2) * e x
          - 2 * f x * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q x) - 2 * z x)) x := by
    intro x
    have he1 : HasDerivAt (⇑e) (deriv (⇑e) x) x := (e.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have he2 : HasDerivAt (deriv (⇑e)) (iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e) x) x := by
      rw [e2, hde]
      have := ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e).differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
      rwa [hdDe] at this
    have he3 : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e)) (iteratedDeriv 3 (⇑e) x) x := by
      rw [e3, e2]
      exact ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ
        (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e)).differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have hq : HasDerivAt (⇑q) (deriv (⇑q) x) x := (q.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have hfd : HasDerivAt (⇑f) (deriv (⇑f) x) x := (f.differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have hG : HasDerivAt (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) (deriv (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) x) x :=
      ((greenOffset κ q).differentiableAt (x := x)).hasDerivAt
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y)
        (deriv (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) x) x := hG.const_add _
    have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun y => ρ y ^ 2)
        (2 * ρ x * (q x + 2 * κ * ρ x - ρ x ^ 2)) x := by
      convert (hρd x).mul (hρd x) using 1
      · funext y; show ρ y ^ 2 = ρ y * ρ y; ring
      · ring
    have hW : HasDerivAt (fun y => q y + 2 * κ * ρ y - ρ y ^ 2)
        (deriv (⇑q) x + 2 * κ * (q x + 2 * κ * ρ x - ρ x ^ 2)
          - 2 * ρ x * (q x + 2 * κ * ρ x - ρ x ^ 2)) x :=
      (hq.add ((hρd x).const_mul (2 * κ))).sub hsq
    have hG1 : deriv (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) x =
        2 * (ρ x - κ) * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q x) + 1 := by
      rw [hlink x]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hqe : deriv (fun y => q y * e y) x = deriv (⇑q) x * e x + q x * deriv (⇑e) x :=
      (hq.mul he1).deriv
    have hfg : deriv (fun y => f y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y)) x =
        deriv (⇑f) x * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q x) +
          f x * deriv (⇑(greenOffset κ q)) x :=
      (hfd.mul hg).deriv
    have hL := hlin x
    rw [hqe, hfg, hG1] at hL
    constructor
    · have h := (he2.sub ((((hρd x).sub_const κ).const_mul 2).mul he1)).sub
        (((hzd x).const_mul 2).mul hg)
      convert h using 1
      rw [hG1]
      ring
    · have h := ((((he3.sub ((((hρd x).sub_const κ).const_mul 2).mul he2)).sub
        ((hW.const_mul 2).mul he1)).sub ((hfd.const_mul 2).mul hg)).sub ((hzd x).const_mul 2))
      convert h using 1
      rw [hG1]
      linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * hL
  have e0 : (0 : ℝ) - 2 * (0 - κ) * 0 - 2 * 0 * (1 / (2 * κ) + 0) = 0 := by ring
  have htop : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => deriv (⇑e) y - 2 * (ρ y - κ) * e y
      - 2 * z y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    rw [hde]
    have h := (((hdecay (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e)).1.sub
      (((hρtop.sub_const κ).const_mul 2).mul (hdecay e).1)).sub
      ((hztop.const_mul 2).mul ((hdecay (greenOffset κ q)).1.const_add (1 / (2 * κ)))))
    rw [e0] at h
    exact h
  have hbot : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => deriv (⇑e) y - 2 * (ρ y - κ) * e y
      - 2 * z y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y)) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
    rw [hde]
    have h := (((hdecay (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ e)).2.sub
      (((hρbot.sub_const κ).const_mul 2).mul (hdecay e).2)).sub
      ((hzbot.const_mul 2).mul ((hdecay (greenOffset κ q)).2.const_add (1 / (2 * κ)))))
    rw [e0] at h
    exact h
  have hm : Continuous (fun x => -2 * (ρ x - κ)) :=
    continuous_const.mul (hρc.sub continuous_const)
  have hv0 := ode_zero (fun x => -2 * (ρ x - κ))
    (fun y => deriv (⇑e) y - 2 * (ρ y - κ) * e y
      - 2 * z y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y))
    (fun y => iteratedDeriv 2 (⇑e) y - 2 * (ρ y - κ) * deriv (⇑e) y
      - 2 * (q y + 2 * κ * ρ y - ρ y ^ 2) * e y
      - 2 * f y * (1 / (2 * κ) + greenOffset κ q y) - 2 * z y)
    hm (fun x => (hf x).1) (fun x => (hf x).2) htop hbot
  intro x
  have := hv0 x
  simp only at this
  linarith
